title: Customer Support Associate with Danish & English – Sofia, Bulgaria
description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions
    Resolve customer concerns efficiently and aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible
    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Danish – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

title: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Pædagog til Eventyrhuset - Børnehave i Dragør
description:
Brænder du for nærvær, fællesskab og faglighed?
Drømmer du om en hverdag, hvor du kan gøre en forskel - og samtidig have tid og rum til at udvikle din pædagogiske praksis? Så læs videre!

Vi søger en engageret og fagligt stærk pædagog til vores børnehave i Eventyrhuset - en privat, integreret daginstitution i smukke Dragør. Hos os får du ikke bare et arbejde, men en arbejdsplads med hjerte, højt til loftet og stor mulighed for både medbestemmelse og udvikling.

Om Eventyrhuset

Eventyrhuset består af to afdelinger med i alt ca. 110 børn - ca. 44 vuggestuebørn og ca. 66 børnehavebørn. Vores personalegruppe tæller omkring 30 dedikerede medarbejdere: pædagoger, medhjælpere, køkkenpersonale, gårdmand og administration.

Eventyrhuset har som privat institution en institutionsbestyrelse med det øverste ansvar for driften, økonomien og personalet, samt en engageret forældrebestyrelse som sikrer forældrenes stemme i beslutningsprocesserne og står for de sociale aktiviteter som sommerfest, julefest mm.

Børnehaven - hvor tryghed, leg og læring går hånd i hånd

I vores børnehave er der tre grupper med, hver med en normering på 22 børn. Hver gruppe har en fast stab bestående af to pædagoger og to medhjælpere.

Vi prioriterer fællesskab og samarbejde - både mellem børn og voksne og på tværs af stuerne. Hos os kender alle børn alle voksne, og det giver en tryg og tillidsfuld atmosfære i hverdagen.

Vi arbejder løbende med at styrke vores pædagogiske praksis, og vi har et fælles fokus på relationer, nærvær og det enkelte barns trivsel og udvikling.

Din rolle som pædagog

Som pædagog i Eventyrhusets børnehave bliver du en del af en fast gruppe, hvor du - sammen med dine 3 stuekollegaer - får ansvaret for ca. 22 børn.

Vi tror på, at kvalitet kræver tid og forberedelse. Derfor har du som pædagog hos os hver uge 2 timer afsat til "andet arbejde", som f.eks. planlægning, refleksion og dokumentation - uden børn.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok og hjælper hinanden på tværs af stuer og faggrupper.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

·       Har en uddannelse som pædagog.

·       Er professionel, omsorgsfuld og initiativrig.

·       Brænder for relationer, leg og nærvær i det pædagogiske arbejde.

·       Er god til at samarbejde og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.

·       Har IT-kompetencer på brugerniveau (fordel, men ikke et krav).

Hvad får du hos os?

·       Mulighed for selv at vælge ugentligt timeantal.

·       2 timers forberedelsestid hver uge.

·       Betalt madordning med sund og lækker frokost.

·       Firma-betalt sundhedsforsikring - også for dine hjemmeboende børn.

·       Betalt ICDP-kursus, hvis du ikke allerede er uddannet.

·       En hverdag i skønne omgivelser med masser af udeliv.

·       Et sted, hvor nytænkning og faglig udvikling er en del af kulturen.

·       Ingen lukkedage i sommerferien, så du er selv med til at styre hvornår du holder ferie.

Ansættelsesvilkår

·       Stillingen er på det antal timer, som passer dig bedst.

·       Start: Hurtigst muligt - men vi venter gerne på den rette.

·       Løn og vilkår efter overenskomst med BUPL og Børneringen.

·       Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest og referencer som en del af processen.

Klar til nye eventyr?

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller er nysgerrig på stillingen, så kontakt os endelig. Vi giver gerne en rundvisning, så du kan mærke stemningen selv. Du kan også læse mere om Eventyrhuset på vores hjemmeside: www.eventyrhuset.info.

Send din ansøgning og CV til post@eventyrhuset.info eller kontakt os på tlf. 28760260, hvis du vil besøge os først.

Vi holder samtaler løbende, og lukker annoncen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Eventyrhuset… Her bliver hverdagens øjeblikke til noget helt særligt

title: Lindebjerg A/S søger en Mekaniker til teknisk klargøring
description:
VIL DU VÆRE EN DEL AF EN LANDSDÆKKENDE SUCCES?

Er du en praktisk anlagt person med hænderne godt skruet på – og har du lyst til at blive en vigtig del af et stærkt team i vækst? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi søger en effektiv og engageret mekaniker til vores afdeling i Middelfart, hvor du bliver en del af et dedikeret team, der sikrer høj kvalitet i vores produkter – både før og efter levering til kunderne.

️ Hvad skal du lave?

Som mekaniker får du en alsidig hverdag med både klargøring og tekniske opgaver. Dine primære arbejdsområder vil være:

 

  • ✅ Reparation og servicering af kundescootere

  • ✅ Teknisk klargøring af nye og brugte scootere

  • ✅ Montering af ekstraudstyr

  • ✅ Kvalitetssikring og slutkontrol

  • ✅ Vedligeholdelse og orden i værkstedet sammen med dine kollegaer

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har teknisk snilde og evt. erfaring fra værksted eller lignende

  • Er mødestabil, struktureret og går op i kvalitet

  • Trives med både rutineprægede og varierende opgaver

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungerer godt i et team

  • Er fleksibel og klar til at tage fat, når der er travlt

Erfaring med el-køretøjer eller reparation er en fordel – men ikke et krav. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En spændende hverdag med masser af ansvar og variation

  • Et uformelt og hjælpsomt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer

  • Gode arbejdsforhold og en arbejdsplads i vækst

  • Mulighed for at blive en del af en landsdækkende virksomhed med ambitioner

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og CV med billede til job@lindebjerg.dk. Skriv "Mekaniker" i emnefeltet.

Der afholdes løbende samtaler, så vi opfordrer interesserede kandidater til at søge snarest muligt.

Om Lindebjerg

DEN GODE SERVICE ER DET VIGTIGSTE FOR OS
Det er vores fornemste opgave at have tilfredse kunder. Dette opnår vi ved at sætte vores kunder i centrum ved altid at være service minded, have top engagerede og kompetente medarbejdere, sælge kvalitetsprodukter, samt altid at være omstillingsparate, så vi kan tilpasse os vores kunders behov.

Lindebjerg er blandt landets absolut førende leverandører af el-køretøjer indenfor vores branche. Vi har solgt mere end 15000 køretøjer, som i dag kører på de danske landeveje.

Virksomheden er landsdækkende. Vores hovedkontor er placeret i Middelfart og lokationen råder over hele 2600 kvadratmeter fordelt på showroom, lager, værksted og administration. Udover vores hovedkontor, har vi showrooms fordelt i hele Danmark, derved kan vi altid være tæt på vores kunder. Vi er netop i gang med åbning af to nye showrooms, herudover har vi lokationer i Aabenraa, Esbjerg, Holstebro, Aalborg, Aarhus, Odense, Sorø, Hillerød og København.

Hos Lindebjerg sætter vi en ære i at omsætte ideer til handling og sidder derfor også med helt fremme i bussen når det handler om at forretningsudvikle, inden for branchen. 
I dagligdagen tilbyder vi stor frihed under ansvar og vægter det sunde arbejdsmiljø og godt kollegaskab, i et uformelt miljø, højt.

title: Ledig graverstilling
description:

Den ledende graver skal varetage følgende opgaver på vore tre kirker i Tvede, Linde og Mellerup samt sognehuset og arealerne omkring præstegården i Tvede.

  • Varetage indledende registrering af gravsteder, opdatere gravstedsbreve, legater og udskrive fakturaer
  • Udføre kirketjeneste ved kirkelige handlinger på skift og sammen med gravermedhjælper
  • Samarbejde med øvrige kirkelige myndigheder
  • Varetage periodevis rengøring af kirker og kontorer m.m.
  • Bistå præster og samarbejde med andre ansatte med løsning af diverse opgaver omkring kirkelige arrangementer

Vi forventer at du:
  • Er pligtopfyldende, effektiv og mødestabil
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også indgå i fælles opgaver og samarbejder
  • Kan tilrettelægge opgaver og administrere arbejdstiden over hele året
  • Kan håndtere diverse små maskiner, flere arbejdssteder og mangeartede opgaver
  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsparat på kort tid til uforudsete opgaver
  • Er udadvendt og imødekommende for folk, der kommer på kirkegårdene
  • Har kørekort og kan stille bil til rådighed for kørsel mellem kirkegårdene
  • Kan medvirke ved afvikling af kirkelige handlinger
  • På alle måder har overskud til at skabe et sundt og godt miljø for graverteamet

Kirkerne har automatiske ringeanlæg.

Der er ikke krav om gartnerisk uddannelse, men det vil ses som en fordel.

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og OAO-S samt organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver og det tilhørende protokollat for gravere.

Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk

Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for gravere gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start.

Stillingen indplaceres i løngruppe 1, hvis der ikke er gartnerisk uddannelse.
Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 342.523 kr. - 421.573 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026 for 37 timer ugentlig).
Stillingen indplaceres i løngruppe 2, ved gartnerisk uddannelse.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 350.435 kr. - 438.259 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026 for 37 timer ugentlig).

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Der ydes rådighedstillæg efter gældende overenskomst. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 16.297 - 27.246,56 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026)
Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og FAKK

Pension kommer oveni efter overenskomstens bestemmelser.

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og FAKK

Er der spørgsmål vedr. stillingen, kan man rette henvendelse til menighedsrådsformand Laila Hjorth Fournais Clausen på tlf. 40105820

title: Senior Information Security Specialist
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Are you passionate about making a meaningful impact on businesses in developing countries and experienced in implementing security frameworks? Join our team as Senior Information Security Specialist at Impact Fund Denmark (IFDK).

At IFDK, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh. 

 

Here is what you get with us

  • A leading role in shaping and strengthening our information security

  • Collaboration with highly skilled IT professionals in a friendly and inclusive culture 

  • Access to the full suite of Microsoft enterprise tools in a modern and tech-driven environment 

 

The job

We are on a mission to continue strengthening our information security efforts.

Reporting to the SVP Technology & Operations, you will address critical security questions and strengthen the management of information security, incl. risk mitigation, regulatory compliance, building of awareness culture, and strengthening of detect, response and continuity capabilities. The information security effort has strong support from the board and executive management, emphasizing its business-critical nature.

You will work closely together with the Technology team to implement relevant security measures, and you will join an international organisation on a vital mission with a unique opportunity to elevate the organisation’s information security to the next level. Your contributions will be central to empowering IFDK to achieve its goals and successfully navigate the challenges of the future.

 

Main tasks and responsibilities

  • Threat & data management: Identify critical security risks and develop proactive strategies to manage and protect critical data.

  • Conduct risk assessments and report: Perform continuous risk assessments to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities and present findings to executive stakeholders

  • Implement security controls: Deploy security controls to mitigate identified risks and continuously monitor the effectiveness of these controls to ensure they remain compliant and adapted to emerging threats.

  • Train and educate: Stay up to date with the latest security trends and facilitate ongoing training and awareness programs for all employees. Help ensure they understand their roles in the information security ecosystem to promote greater ownership and a security culture.

 

Your qualifications and experience

  • Experience from a position where you successfully have led complex changes or projects regarding cyber and information security – preferably within the financial sector e.g. as a consultant.

  • Knowledge of relevant legal and security frameworks e.g., ISO27001/2, DORA etc.

  • Relevant experience in information security management, risk assessment and executive security reporting

  • Relevant technical skills and knowledge about the Microsoft 365 security stack (Entra ID, Defender, Purview), security monitoring and incident response.

 

Personal competences

  • Independent, proactive and self-driven

  • Outgoing and a natural relationship builder 

  • Ability to communicate across levels, from technical to C-level

  • Positive team player

 

Ready to build the digital foundation for global impact? 

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. Please submit it via the apply button today or no later than September 18th, 2026. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply. 

CVs not submitted via the apply button will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate. 

 

We look forward to hearing from you!

Vi er en del af CRH – en international koncern – men i Roust er vi et lokalt team med stærkt sammenhold, uformel tone og fokus på sikkerhed. Vi hjælper hinanden, vi udvikler hinanden, og vi får tingene gjort.

Klar til at blive en del af holdet i Roust

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag. Vi holder samtaler løbende, indtil vi har fundet den rette.

Om CRH Products

CRH Products har ca. 150 medarbejdere på seks lokationer i Danmark og leverer alt fra fliser, belægning og støttemure til rør- og brøndsystemer, bygværker og plansiloer. Vi er en del af CRH i Danmark, der samlet har ca. 1.500 ansatte på 19 lokationer inden for råhusbyggeri, råstoffer, belægning og rørsystemer. Vores mål er at udvikle løsninger, der bygger, forbinder og forbedrer verden.

Læs mere på www.crhproducts.dk.

title: Daglig Leder til Beni Burger i Carlsbergbyen
description:
Beni er en ny burgerbar i Carlsberg Byen, skabt i samarbejde mellem Norrlyst Koncernen og Casper Drømme. Vi har rygende travlt og søger derfor en dygtig og engageret daglig leder, der har lyst til at være en central del af den daglige drift og udviklingen af Beni.

Som daglig leder bliver du den, der sikrer, at restauranten spiller – både foran gæsterne og bag kulisserne. Du får et tæt samarbejde med teamet og ledelsen og kommer til at have ansvar for den daglige drift af Front of House.

DINE PRIMÆRE ANSVARSOMRÅDER

  • Daglig drift – sikre, at restauranten fungerer optimalt fra åbning til luk.

  • Personaleplanlægning – udarbejdelse af vagtplaner, koordinering af medarbejdere og sikring af det rette hold på gulvet.

  • Varebestilling – holde styr på lager, forbrug og bestilling af varer, så vi altid er klar til service.

  • Floor management – være synlig og nærværende på gulvet, lede teamet under service og sikre den gode gæsteoplevelse.

Stillingen er en kombination af administrative opgaver og hands-on drift i restauranten. Du skal derfor både trives foran computeren med planlægning og koordinering og på gulvet, hvor tempoet er højt, og beslutningerne skal træffes hurtigt.

VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU

Har erfaring fra en lignende rolle i restaurantbranchen – gerne fra et koncept med højt tempo, mange gæster og fokus på både kvalitet og effektiv drift.

Du er struktureret og kan bevare overblikket, når der er travlt. Du tager ansvar, går forrest og har naturlig autoritet uden at være bange for selv at tage fat, når der skal gives gas på gulvet.

Du har blik for både gæster, kolleger og driften og forstår, at den gode restaurantoplevelse skabes af et stærkt team, tydelig ledelse og godt købmandskab.

VI TILBYDER

  • En fuldtidsstilling som daglig leder på Beni.

  • En central rolle i et nyt og ambitiøst burgerkoncept.

  • Mulighed for at være med til at forme og udvikle restauranten fra starten.

  • Et stærkt team og en arbejdsplads med højt tempo, godt humør og masser af energi.

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig sammen med Norrlyst Koncernen.

Stillingen er med start hurtigst muligt.

Hvis du kan se dig selv stå i spidsen for den daglige drift på Beni, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

title: Autolakerer til Odense
description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

Hvad skal du lave? 

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens 

Hvad får du? 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi betaler for talent! 
  • Gode kollegaer, der kan deres kram (og deler værkstedshistorier i pauserne) 
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med 
  • Mulighed for udvikling 
  • En arbejdsplads med humor, godt humør og højt til loftet  

 Hvad gør du nu? 

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads! 

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige medarbejder med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette. 

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme.  

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com. 

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte

title: Lastbilchauffører søges til dag- og natkørsel – Nordline Transport ApS

Ansættelse: Fuldtid

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

Nordline Transport ApS

title: Business Development Manager til Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed
description:
CenSec – Center for Defence, Space & Security 

Vil du arbejde med at styrke vækst, innovation og internationalisering inden for den danske forsvarssektor? Og være med til at udvikle Danmarks nationale innovations- og erhvervsklynge for aktører inden for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed?   

  

Om stillingen 

CenSecs mission er at være drivkraften bag et stærkt dansk SMV-økosystem, der former fremtidens løsninger inden for forsvar, sikkerhed og rum – og som Business Development Manager kommer du til at spille en vigtig rolle her.   

Du kommer til at arbejde primært med klyngens forsvarsdomæne og med et særligt fokus på droner, autonome enheder og internationalt samarbejde. 

En del af arbejdet udføres på tværs af projekter, hvor du vil få ansvaret for leverancerne heri, som bl.a. indbefatter dialog med industrien.  

Du får til opgave at planlægge og afvikle forskellige klyngeaktiviteter, lige fra mindre netværksmøder til større konferencer. Klyngeaktiviteterne skal hjælpe CenSecs medlemmer med at få ny viden, skabe samarbejde på tværs og øge medlemmernes kommercielle udvikling. Aktiviteterne har både nationalt og internationalt fokus. 

Udover arbejdet med klyngeaktiviteterne får du til opgave at rekruttere nye medlemmer, være kontaktperson for medlemsvirksomheder og deltage i interne udviklingsopgaver- og processer.  

Arbejdet med udvikling af klyngen omfatter også en del administration, opgaver relateret til formidling og kommunikation, samt samarbejde med andre aktører i det forsvarsindustrielle økosystem på både nationalt og europæisk niveau.  

 

Din profil 

Der kan være mange indgangsvinkler til denne stilling, og vi stiller derfor ikke krav til en særlig baggrund. Vigtigst er det at du er en “do’er”, som har vilje og evne til at omsætte input og viden til konkret værdi for vores medlemmer og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forventer en høj grad af selvstændighed og professionalisme, og at du kan varetage det ansvar og mandat, der medfølger at være ansat i den nationale klyngeorganisation for forsvarsindustrien. 

Derudover er du ekstrovert, kommunikativt stærk, omstillingsparat, fleksibel og taler og skriver engelsk på højt niveau. 

 

Vi tilbyder 

En betydningsfuld rolle i en internationalt anerkendt klyngeorganisation, som skaber innovation, vækst og arbejdspladser. Du får opgaver og muligheder, der medfører faglig og personlig udvikling i et internationalt miljø med ansvar efter evner og ambitioner.  

Dine kollegaer er ambitiøse, humoristiske og uformelle, og trods forskellige ansvarsområder, arbejder vi sammen som et team og hjælper hinanden.  

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsuge med to ugentlige fremmødedage på vores kontor i Viborg og hjemmearbejde de resterende ugedage.  

 

Arbejdstid og løn m.m. 

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt på funktionærvilkår. 

I forbindelse med projekt- og klyngeaktiviteter i ind- og udland vil der være nogen rejseaktivitet, som altid aftales på forhånd og i god tid. 

Løn efter kvalifikationer og evner til at skabe værdi for CenSec. 

 

Læs mere om CenSec her: www.censec.dk  

 

Om CenSec 

CenSec er Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed.  

Som national klynge er vores mandat at samle og styrke hele økosystemet, heriblandt virksomheder, videninstitutioner og myndigheder. 

Vi har en dyb forståelse af økosystemet og en dybdegående viden om vores medlemmer. Vores ambition er at være et omdrejningspunkt hvor alle aktører ser os som den primære drivkraft til at fremme samarbejde på tværs og øge innovation i industrien.  
  
Vi er en tillidsbaseret og stærk medlemsorganisation. Siden 2004 har vi arbejdet for at styrke netværk, samarbejds- og forretningsmuligheder på tværs af sektorer og grænser, gennem facilitering af nationale og internationale netværksaktiviteter.  
  
CenSec – skaber innovation, vækst og robusthed for Danmark.  

  

Ansøgning 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt venligst Anders Laustsen, på tlf. 52 13 15 42 eller skriv til anders@censec.dk  

Vi ser frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og CV til samme mailadresse snarest muligt og senest den 27. september 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført løbende med henblik på ansættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi forbeholder os ret til at ansætte før deadline, hvis vi finder den rette kandidat.

title: VVS-Montør søges
description:
Erfaren VVS-montør søges

Vil du være en del af en veldrevet virksomhed med høj faglighed, stor frihed og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab?

Niels Mølgaard ApS søger en dygtig og engageret VVS-montør, der er klar til nye udfordringer og ønsker at blive en del af et professionelt team med fokus på kvalitet, service og godt håndværk.

Trives du i en hverdag med afvekslende opgaver, ansvar og tæt kontakt til kunder? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om stillingen

Med reference til afdelingslederen bliver du en del af en veletableret og dynamisk VVS-installationsvirksomhed, hvor kvalitet, faglig stolthed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er centrale værdier.

Hos os er medarbejderne vores vigtigste ressource. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på godt kollegaskab, sammenhold, humor og en positiv omgangstone i hverdagen. Du får primært arbejdsområde i Aarhus og omegn, hvor du kommer til at servicere både private- og erhvervskunder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du vil få en alsidig hverdag med spændende opgaver inden for:

• Service- og reparationsarbejde for private kunder, erhvervskunder og boligforeninger

• Renoverings- og ombygningsprojekter

• Energioptimering og energirenoveringer

• Mindre entrepriser

• Fejlfinding, vedligeholdelse og kundeservice

Arbejdet udføres hovedsageligt i Aarhus og omegn.

Vi tilbyder

• Et spændende og fast job i en solid virksomhed med ordnede forhold

• Stor grad af frihed under ansvar i et velfungerende team af kompetente og erfarne kolleger

• En flad organisation med kort vej fra idé til handling og solid administrativ opbakning i hverdagen

• Attraktiv lønpakke efter kvalifikationer, firmabil og smartphone til rådighed

• Moderne værkstedsfaciliteter, herunder komplet blikkenslagerværksted

• Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling gennem kurser og efteruddannelse

• Sociale arrangementer og et stærkt fællesskab

Vi forventer, at du

• Er uddannet VVS-montør og gerne kompetent erfaring

• Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst

• Har fokus på kvalitet og god service

• Er samarbejdsvillig og bidrager positivt til teamet

• Bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag

• Har almindeligt kørekort (kategori B)

Tiltrædelse

Efter aftale, gerne hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@nmvvs.dk med emnet "VVS-montør".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig og måske byde dig velkommen som vores nye kollega hos Niels Mølgaard ApS.

Om virksomheden

Niels Mølgaard ApS er en familieejet virksomhed, etableret i 1984, og er i dag blandt Østjyllands førende specialister inden for VVS, energi og blik. Virksomheden løser opgaver for både private kunder, erhverv og entrepriser og har stor fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og godt håndværk. Med ca. 30 medarbejdere og løbende efteruddannelse af alle ansatte tilbyder Niels Mølgaard ApS et professionelt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø. Virksomheden har adresse i Højbjerg ved Aarhus og omfatter desuden søsterselskaberne NME Ejendomsadministration og VVS-shoppen.dk

title: Rengøringstekniker søges
description:
Rengøringstekniker søges – gerne med erfaring i gulv- og murbehandling

Vi søger en dygtig og kvalitetsbevidst rengøringstekniker, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team. Vi lægger vægt på godt håndværk, grundighed og høj service – og vi ser meget gerne, at du har erfaring med specialrengøring, gulvbehandling og behandling af murværk/facader.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil variere og kan blandt andet omfatte:

  • Daglig og periodisk rengøring

  • Hovedrengøring og specialrengøring

  • Gulvbehandling, herunder grundrens, skuring, polish og pleje af forskellige gulvtyper

  • Maskinel gulvrengøring

  • Mur- og facadebehandling, herunder afrensning og rengøring af forskellige overflader

  • Klargøring og efterbehandling af overflader

  • Anvendelse af professionelle rengøringsmaskiner, produkter og metoder

  • Kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde

  • Dialog og god service over for kunder

Vi forestiller os, at du

Har erfaring som rengøringstekniker eller med professionel rengøring. Det er en stor fordel, hvis du har praktisk erfaring med gulvbehandlinger og mur-/facadebehandlinger og er vant til at arbejde med maskiner og professionelle rengøringsmidler.

Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og går op i at levere et flot resultat. Samtidig forventer vi, at du er stabil, fleksibel og serviceminded og kan indgå positivt i et team.

Relevant uddannelse eller kurser inden for rengøring og overfladebehandling er en fordel, men praktisk erfaring og den rette indstilling vægter højt.

Kørekort B er en fordel

Vi tilbyder

Et alsidigt job med forskellige typer opgaver og mulighed for at bruge dine faglige kompetencer inden for både almindelig rengøring og specialopgaver.

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, ordentlighed og godt samarbejde. Vi tilbyder gode kolleger, grundig introduktion til opgaverne og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Ansøgning

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Send en kort ansøgning og gerne dit CV. Fortæl gerne om din erfaring med professionel rengøring og særligt, hvis du har arbejdet med gulvbehandling, specialrengøring eller mur-/facadebehandling.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Kok/Cater søges
description:

title: Forretningsudvikler Søges

title: General worker Pick & Pack
description:
Mission

Newrest is looking for General Workers in our Pick & Pack department who will be responsible for putting together the food trolleys for our airline client. This will include placing beverages and snacks into the food trolleys, organizing utensils and provisions and placing them in the food trolleys. This will also include organizing beverages per instructions. This individual will be standing all day. Newrest values promoting people from within. If an individual shows capability and commitment, there is opportunity for this individual to experience a career within Newrest.

Responsibilities:

  • Load carts and trolleys with platters, dishes, utensils, and containers.

  • Collect serving trays and dispose of plates in trays by following the instructions and guidelines.

  • When loading trays into the trolleys, ensure they are placed appropriately within the frame of the rack.

  • Assist in setting up and packaging special meals and ingredients.

  • Complete the defined packaging schedule as assigned by supervisor or manager.

  • Edit and organize labels outside and inside for the scheduled production of the day.

  • Perform proper food packaging and storing based on safety requirements and customer instructions.

  • Tag every rack, tray, and trolley according to the company’s standards and processes.

  • Ensure that left-over ingredients and packaging material are properly labelled and returned in the dry storage, cooler or packaging material storage.

  • Follow all process control documentation.

  • Bring trays and packaging material from the warehouse and waiting area.

  • Ensure proper and timely recording of activities.

  • Report any unsanitary practice and/or unsafe condition.

  • Make sure trolleys are properly identified, secured, and moved away from chemicals and hazardous substances.

  • Load airline equipment with trays, dishes, utensils, and containers according to specifications provided.

  • Handle airline equipment and dispose of items in trays by following the instructions and guidelines.

  • Complete packing production of items assigned by supervisor or manager.

  • Follow all process control documentation.

  • Report any unsanitary practice and/or unsafe condition.

  • Make sure trolleys are properly identified, secured, and moved away from chemicals and hazardous substances.

  • Follow all food safety, health and safety, company rules and standards.

  • Regular and timely attendance is expected for the position.

  • Follow all food safety, health and safety, company rules and standards.

  • Regular and timely attendance is expected for the position.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable requirements related to product and service quality, environmental standards, food safety, and health and safety regulations.

  • Promote a safe and healthy work environment by preventing work-related injuries and illnesses, eliminating hazards, and reducing health and safety risks.

  • Compliance with Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP)/General manufacturing practices (GMP) guidelines for personal hygiene and observe security precautions as mandated by unit management.

  • Satisfactory and punctual attendance are expected.

Qualifications:

  • Ability to lift items/packages (up to 30 lbs)

  • Team oriented

  • Ability to handle pressure in a fast paced environment

  • Attendance, diligence, punctuality, reliability

  • Good work ethic

  • Ability to work any shift depending on operational needs.

  • English- and/or Danish speaking is a must

  • Living in Denmark or Sweden is mandatory

  • You must have a permit to work in Denmark

  • You must be able to pass a security approval process

Benefits:

  • Monthly pay

title: Technical Sales Support Engineer to EYKON, Denmark or Mälardalen, Sweden
description:
EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.

Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.

Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?

EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.

In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

The Role

As Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
    Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.
    Working in close cooperations with order management team
     Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.
    Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation
    Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.
    Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.
    Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.
    Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.
    Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.

This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.

The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.

Is this you?

To be successful in this role, you have experience from a customer-facing B2B environment involving technical sales, customer support, sales support, application support, pre-sales or similar technical-commercial responsibilities. You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders is important, as is the ability to support quotations, tenders and customer-related projects. You understand how hardware, software and services interact within a broader solution environment and are able to translate technical topics into practical customer value. Professional proficiency in English together with Swedish and/or Danish language skills is required in the role, as the position involves daily collaboration with colleagues and customers across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

Experience from the energy sector, utilities, smart metering, infrastructure, automation or related technical industries is considered an advantage, but we welcome candidates from a broad range of technical and technical-commercial environments. The most important factor is your ability to learn, build relationships and create value for customers.

In this recruitment, your personal qualities will be of great importance. We are looking for a proactive, structured and customer-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and driving activities forward. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable operating in the intersection between commercial and technical discussions. As a person, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that things get done. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by building relationships, solving problems and supporting both customers and colleagues.

title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor
description:
About the position

Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities
  • Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
  • Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
  • Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
  • Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
  • Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
  • Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.
  • Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.
  • Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
  • Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance
  • Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
  • Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
  • Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.

Your professional background
  • You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar. Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.
  • You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.
  • Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.
  • You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.
  • You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.
  • You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.
  • You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.

Personal qualities
  • You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.
  • You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.
  • You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.
  • You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.
  • You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.

We offer
  • A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.
  • A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.
  • The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.
  • Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.
  • An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.
  • Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.


Practical information

Work location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.
Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.
Employment: Permanent position.

Application
Please send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project at The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
description:
The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applicants for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working within the field of environmental epidemiology and public health. The project aims to investigate new and previously suspected toxicants to risk of Parkinsons Disease.

The PhD project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative “Connecting the environmental exposome to PD risk and disease pathology” funded by Michael J Fox Foundation. Through this grant, a 3-year PhD position has been funded. The larger project includes four work packages (WPs), where the PhD project is part of the WP with the title “Toxicant-wide association studies for PD”, which also includes funding for two part time researchers.


Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at the National Institute of Public Health within the research group in Geographical and Register-based Epidemiology in Copenhagen. Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll will be the principal supervisor, researcher Stine Kloster and researcher Kirstine Wodschow will be co-supervisors. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the research team in the larger project. Together, the larger team provides an interdisciplinary research environment with close integration of public health, in vivo and in vitro experimental research, neurology, register-based research and environmental epidemiology. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about the research initiative here:  https://www.michaeljfox.org/grant/connecting-environmental-exposome-pd-risk-and-disease-pathology. 

 

Project description

The PhD project will focus on associations between toxicants and risk for Parkinsons Disease. The association between toxicant exposure at residential location and incidence of Parkinsons Disease will be investigated for the entire Danish adult population through access to Danish national registers. Toxicants will include pesticides in drinking water, airborne pesticides exposure from fields and larger chemical pollutions.

Together with the researchers in WP4 the PhD student will:

  • Establish the study population of the entire Danish adults 

  • Derive toxicant exposure at an individual level

  • Analyze associations between toxicant exposure and risk of Parkinsons Disease

  • Prepare and publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have demonstrated an interest in research within epidemiology, environmental medicine, or data science

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in public health, epidemiology, data science or related fields

  • Experience with programming using statistical software (such as SAS, Stata or R) is considered a strength but not a requirement

  • Preferably prior experience with register-based and/or environmental epidemiology

  • An interest in working with quantitative analyses and large datasets

  • Excellent communications skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll

The National Institute of Public Health 

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Phone: +45 65507775   E-mail: ake@sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date October 9th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Private healthcare and life insurance

What we're about

A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
