title: Kotisiivooja Vantaa
description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 14,17-16,17 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

title: Forklift Driver (trukkikuski) to Föglö, Åland Islands for the Fish Industry, Permanent Position , AX- Föglö
description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for a forklift driver for a permanent position in the natural paradise of Föglö, Åland Islands (a temporary position is possible if desired).

The job involves operating a forklift in various stages of production and storage, such as moving products, loading and unloading cargo, and ensuring the smooth flow of materials in the production area. The forklift in use is a counterbalanced electric forklift (brand: Linde). The work requires good precision, initiative, and the ability to operate safely in a busy environment. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. You will also drive the forklift on a slightly sloped yard. If necessary, you can also participate in other production-supporting tasks. At Kalaneuvos, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
We are looking for a communicative person who is capable of working independently and is not afraid to take initiative. Previous experience in operating a forklift is a requirement for this job. You will receive comprehensive training on the specific forklift model and the work environment. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: full-time: 37.5h/week
- Salary: approx. 13-14.50 EUR/h, depending on experience
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt
- Start date: flexible according to agreement
- The role has possibility to advance into bigger role

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has K-extra, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two- or three-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Kalaneuvos:
Kalaneuvos is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Haemme nyt trukkikuskia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen luonnonhelmaan Ahvenanmaan Föglön saareen (halutessasi määräaikaisuus on mahdollinen).

Työtehtäviin kuuluu trukin käyttö tuotannon ja varaston eri työvaiheissa, kuten tuotteiden siirtäminen, kuormien lastaus ja purku, sekä materiaalivirran sujuvuuden varmistaminen tuotantoalueella. Käytössä oleva trukki on vastapainoinen sähkötrukki (merkki: Linde). Työ vaatii hyvää tarkkuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä toimia turvallisesti kiireisessä ympäristössä. Työskentelytilat ovat viileät, noin +2 – +6°C, joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Ajat trukkia myös hieman kaltevalla pihalla. Tarpeen mukaan voit osallistua myös muihin tuotantoa tukeviin työtehtäviin. Kalaneuvoksella pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todellakin yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa "työperhettä".

Kenelle työ sopii?
Etsimme kommunikaatiotaitoista ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää henkilöä, joka ei pelkää tarttua toimeen. Aiempi kokemus trukin käytöstä on vaatimuksena tälle työlle. Saat toki kattavan perehdytyksen kyseiseen trukkimalliin sekä työympäristöön. Työ sopii luonnon läheiselle henkilölle, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella, saaristomaisemissa. Puhuthan englantia, jotta kommunikaatio työporukassa sujuu ongelmitta.

- Työtunnit: täydet tunnit: 37,5h/vko
- Palkkaus: n. 13-14,50eur/h, kokemuksen mukaan
- Työehtosopimus: Elintarvikealan TES
- Työsuhde: Boltin kautta
- Aloitus joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan
- Roolissa on hyvä mahdollisuus edetä

Tietoa työskentelypaikkakunnasta ja käytännön järjestelyissä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupungin palveluita: saarella on K-extra, kirjasto ja kuntosali, ja muutoin kaupungin palvelut löytyvät esim. Maarianhaminasta, 35min lauttamatkan ja 30min ajomatkan päästä. Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka on lähellä majoitusta ja Maarianhaminaan pääsee bussilla. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: majoitut tyypillisesti toisen työntekijän kanssa rivitalokaksiossa tai -kolmiossa, ja vuokra on n. 300-450eur, ja sisältää, tai ei sisällä sähköä / vettä, riippuen asunnosta (saat tarkan tiedon työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Tietoa Kalaneuvoksesta:
Kalaneuvos on Suomen kalateollisuuden suurin toimija ja alan edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, kalatukkukaupassa, kalan tuonnissa ja viennissä sekä kalankasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuoden ajan panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin sekä henkilöstön hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändin alta löytyy laaja valikoima herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

title: Doctoral Researcher position in regeneration and ageing biology, group Pentinmikko
description:
Pentinmikko laboratory invites applications for a 3-year DOCTORAL RESEARCHER position in regeneration and ageing biology under the supervision of Dr. Nalle Pentinmikko. The successful applicant will join the research group located at the Institute of Biotechnology, HiLIFE, and enrol in one of the doctoral programs at the University of Helsinki. The work is scheduled to start in January 2027 or as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

Position description

The Research Council of Finland funded PhD project aims to discover how inflammatory conditions and ageing affect the function and regenerative capacity of liver tissue. Your work will involve the use of research animals to investigate cell-cell interactions during regenerative processes and to developed new in vitro organoid models. You are expected to discuss your work in regular group meetings, to present your findings in scientific conferences, prepare funding applications for travel grants, as well as lead the writing of manuscripts for publication in international scientific journals. You will have shared responsibilities in management of the facilities of the research group.

Requirements

Motivated candidates with a M.Sc. degree or equivalent in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, or other related fields are encouraged to apply. Prior experience in laboratory work is required. Experience in working with research animals and organotypic cell cultures is advantageous, but most importantly you should have a strong motivation to learn new methods, contribute ideas, and possess the ability to conduct your research independently while being an active member of an international research environment. Good written and oral communication skills in English will be needed. The selected candidate must meet the eligibility requirements for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/admissions-and-education/apply-doctoral-programmes) and prepare and apply for a doctoral study right within the trial period of 6 months.

Five percent of the working time is expected to be devoted to teaching and undergraduate student supervision.

The chosen applicant is expected to reside in Finland while employed by the University of Helsinki.

Salary and benefits

The salary will be in accordance with the University salary system (for teaching and research personnel, starting level 2). In addition, the appointee will be paid a salary component based on personal performance. The starting salary will be approximately 2600 €/month.

The University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/about-us/careers/welcome-finland-information-arriving-staffy) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.

How to apply

Applications shall be submitted through the University of Helsinki´s recruitment system and include the following documents: a CV (maximum 2 pages), a copy of your transcript records, and a letter (maximum 1 page) with a description of your research interests and why you would be a suitable candidate for the project and the contact information of two referees to provide reference letters upon request. Please send us an application that you have crafted yourself, reflecting your own capability and thoughts.


The deadline for applications is October 6, 2026. However, we encourage to apply as soon as possible as the role will be filled when a suitable candidate is found. Top candidates will be interviewed in October 2026.

A diverse and equitable study and work culture is important to the University of Helsinki. That is why we do our best to promote an inclusive university community. We encourage all qualified applicants from different gender identities, linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and minorities to apply for the position. You can read about the accessibility and inclusivity of our university via this link.

About the Institute of Biotechnology

Institute of Biotechnology BI, a part of HiLIFE, is an internationally renowned research institute with an inclusive and curiosity-driven working culture. The research activities are carried out in research groups joined into three multidisciplinary research programs. The Institute hosts several shared research infrastructures, including cutting-edge facilities for cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM), light microscopy, sequencing, and proteomics. For more information, please visit https://www.helsinki.fi/hilife/bi

Additional information

For further inquiries regarding the position, please contact Dr. Nalle Pentinmikko (nalle.e.pentinmikko@helsinki.fi).

Support with the recruitment system may be obtained from University of Helsinki HR Specialists at recruitment@helsinki.fi.

title: People & Culture Generalist
description:
At IKEA Tampere, people are at the heart of everything we do. As our Unit P&C Generalist, you will be a trusted HR partner who helps leaders and co-workers thrive, supports a healthy and inclusive workplace, and turns People & Culture plans into practical everyday actions. You will work close to the business, because the best people solutions are built together, where everyday life happens.

**Who you are**

You are an experienced, people-centred HR professional who combines sound judgement with a warm, practical way of working. You enjoy being a reliable partner to leaders and co-workers, take ownership of your work, and bring people together to find solutions that support both wellbeing and business results. You can move confidently between employment relations, work ability management and everyday HR processes, while helping change happen in a clear and respectful way.

- You have several years of broad HR experience and can provide practical, trusted support to leaders, co-workers and the business.

- You have expertise in work ability management and a relevant educational background in education, psychology or a related field, supported by hands-on experience.

- You understand collective agreements and employment relations, ideally the Finnish Commerce Collective Agreement or another collective agreement you have applied in your work.

- You know how to work closely with occupational health partners and use wellbeing insights to support sustainable everyday working life.

- You build trust through approachable, clear and confidential communication, and you can document and explain HR matters accurately to different audiences.

- You take responsibility for moving agreed actions forward, stay calm when priorities change and work independently while actively asking for and offering support.

- You have ability to embrace different IT solutions and use them in your daily tasks.

- You are fluent in both Finnish and English and enjoy bringing people together across the Tampere unit to make change practical, inclusive and meaningful.


**What you'll be doing day to day**

As a Unit P&C Generalist, you will make a real difference to everyday working life at IKEA Tampere. You will partner with leaders and co-workers to make our People & Culture plans happen in practice, strengthening wellbeing, capability and a workplace where everyone can contribute. Your work brings together hands-on HR support, employment relations and organisational development. You will listen, give clear advice and turn insights into simple actions that help the unit grow through people.

- You will partner with unit leaders to plan, deliver and follow up local People & Culture actions that support business priorities and a positive co-worker experience.

- You will provide practical HR advice and coaching to leaders and co-workers on employment relations, policies, procedures and everyday people matters.

- You will coordinate work ability management and occupational health collaboration, helping to find timely, respectful and sustainable solutions for co-workers.

- You will support leaders in developing their leadership capabilities and help co-workers build the skills needed today and tomorrow also executing trainings and on-boarding process for co-workers and managers

- You will contribute to fair and constructive cooperation with employee representatives and ensure that local practices follow applicable collective agreements, legislation and IKEA ways of working.

- You will execute operational people related tasks and daily routines on unit level, e.g. on- and offboarding related tasks.

- You will use people data, feedback and everyday observations to identify opportunities, improve HR processes and make clear recommendations that lead to action.

- You will help strengthen IKEA Tampere as an attractive employer by supporting talent, inclusion, internal growth and a culture where people trust, support and challenge one another.


**Together as a team**

IKEA is all about people, and our team make sure to bring the best people on board to keep our strong spirit of togetherness. We believe that different experiences and backgrounds collectively make us wiser and stronger, and we ensure that our co-workers bloom into their best selves as they contribute to our business.

**Apply now!**

This position is full time 37,5 h/week and fixed term until 17.9.2027. Starting in the role by agreement, but no later than 2.11.2026.

In this role your working hours may vary from 08.00 - 18.00 based on business needs. Main working location is IKEA Tampere store.

The salary for the position starts at 3099 €/month and will be specified during the recruitment process based on the selected candidates experience, skills, and the final content of the role.

You can apply by clicking the Apply now button and attach an updated CV with your application and salary request latest on 24.9.2026, so we can get to know you better.

We are interviewing the applicants during the weeks 39 and 40. We will communicate about the progress of the recruitment process via email, so keep on eye your inbox.

If you have any questions about the role, Tampere Unit People & Culture Manager Petra Aalto will be happy to answer them. You can reach her at petra.aalto@ingka.ikea.com in either English or Finnish.

Need adjustments? If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruitment.ikea.fi@ikea.com. Were happy to help.

**IKEA AS EMPLOYER**

Working at IKEA is more than just a job – with us you are part of an equal and diverse working community. A sense of belonging is important to our employees, and team spirit is at the heart of what we do. IKEA offers a variety of career paths and opportunities to develop yourself in roles that are right for you. We give you the opportunity to bring your ideas to the table to help us develop our work, and to create new IKEA success!

In addition to your salary, you will also enjoy a wide range of comprehensive staff benefits, including flexible Epassi saldo, staff discounts on our products, healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch menus at very low prices in our staff restaurants, One IKEA Bonus, gifts on special days and at Christmas, and much more!

title: Merimajan päiväkoti Kotkassa hakee 2-3 varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa!
description:
Merimajan päiväkoti etsii joukkoonsa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen kokeneita ja motivoituneita varhaiskasvatuksen opettajia, jotka haluavat olla mukana rakentamassa lasten turvallista, lämminhenkistä ja merkityksellistä arkea.

Meillä Merimajassa arvostetaan rauhallista, sensitiivistä työotetta ja yhteisöllistä tekemisen kulttuuria. Toimintaamme ohjaavat kristilliset arvot, kuten lähimmäisenrakkaus, oikeudenmukaisuus ja kunnioitus.

Työ, jossa jokainen päivä on merkityksellinen

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana olet tärkeä osa lasten kasvun ja oppimisen polkua. Toimit kasvattajana, ohjaajana ja tiimin pedagogisena suunnannäyttäjänä. Meillä saat toteuttaa laadukasta, leikkiin ja oppimisen iloon pohjautuvaa pedagogiikkaa yhdessä osaavan ja välittävän työyhteisön kanssa.

Etsimme sinua, joka

- omaat varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuuden (Varhaiskasvatuslaki 6 luku §26, varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukainen kelpoisuus, huomioiden 74 § ja 75 § voimaantulon ja siirtymäsäännökset)


- työskentelet lapsilähtöisesti, sensitiivisesti ja ammatillisesti


- arvostat tiimityöskentelyä, yhteisöllisyyttä, avointa vuorovaikutusta ja kehittämistä


- osaat kohdata lapset, huoltajat ja työtoverit lämpimästi ja kunnioittavasti


- haluat olla mukana luomassa hyvän arjen kokopäiväpedagogiikkaa, jossa jokainen tuleenähdyksi ja kuulluksi.


Tarjoamme sinulle

- sitoutuneen ja välittävän työyhteisön, jossa huumori, arvostus ja yhdessä tekeminen näkyvät arjessa


- mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kasvuun ja kouluttautumiseen


- hyvinvointia tukevan ilmapiirin, jossa työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa arvostetaan


- riittävät resurssit ja varhaiskasvatuslain mukaiset ryhmäkoot


- työterveyshuollon Mehiläisessä, vaaterahan, tyhypäivät 2x/vuosi ja ePassi-edun


Tule osaksi Merimajan yhteisöä!

Jos sydämesi sykkii lasten kasvulle, varhaiskasvatuksen laadulle ja arvopohjaiselle työlle, saatat olla juuri se, jota etsimme.

Työsuhteessa noudatetaan 6kk koeaikaa. Valitun henkilön on esitettävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote sekä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan. Tartuntatautilaki (55 §) velvoittaa alle kouluikäisten kanssa työskentelevien tuberkuloositartuntariskin selvittämisen.

Palkkaus 25E (3026,78- 3301,03e) riippuen kokemusvuosistasi.

Haku päättyy:27.09.2026, haastattelut aloitetaan jo haun ollessa käynnissä Työ alkaa:5.10.2026 ja 31.12.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Sijainti: Merimajan päiväkoti, Harjantauksentie 4, 48310 Kotka

title: Ympäristöasiantuntija, Keliber-litiumhanke
description:
Sibanye-Stillwaterin Keliber-litiumhanke on aloittanut Euroopan ensimmäisen omaan malmiin perustuvan akkulaatuisen litiumhydroksidin tuotannon vaiheittaisen käynnistämisen. Toiminta kattaa koko arvoketjun malminetsinnästä litiumhydroksidin jalostukseen ja vahvistaa Euroopan akkuarvoketjua. Rikastamo sijaitsee Kaustisen Päivänevalla ja litiumjalostamo Kokkolan suurteollisuusalueella (KIP).
Litiumhydroksidi on keskeinen raaka-aine litiumioniakuissa, jotka mahdollistavat sähköautot, energian varastoinnin ja monet digitaalisen arjen ratkaisut.
Keliber on kansainvälisen kaivos- ja metallinjalostusyhtiön Sibanye-Stillwaterin tytäryhtiö, ja sen toiseksi suurin omistaja on kotimaista akkuarvoketjua kehittävä Finnish Minerals Group.
Haluatko tarttua ainutlaatuiseen tilaisuuteen ja tulla luomaan uuden sukupolven suomalaista teollisuutta? Etsimme dynaamiseen ympäristöasiantuntijoiden joukkoomme

YMPÄRISTÖASIANTUNTIJAA

vastaamaan toimintamme ympäristötarkkailun toteuttamisesta ja kehittämisestä yhdessä tärkeimpien sisäisten ja ulkoisten sidosryhmiemme kanssa. Työnkuvaasi kuuluu tarkkailuohjelman mukainen näytteenotto (vesi, maa-ainekset ja kaivannaisjätteet), jätehuollon ohjeistus ja koordinointi tuotanto-osastoille sekä toiminnanharjoittajan laboratoriopalveluntarjoajan rajapinnalla toimiminen.
Toimit myös asiantuntijana ympäristöasioissa ja varmistat ympäristövelvoitteidemme huomioon ottamisen nyt hankkeen ylösajovaiheessa ja tuotannon käynnistyttyä. Raportoit työssäsi ympäristöpäällikölle.
Tärkeimmät vastuusi ovat:
-
toiminnan ympäristölupamääräysten ja velvoitteiden toteutumisen seuranta ja raportointi

-
vesien, kaivannaisjätteiden ja jätteiden hallinnan koordinointi

-
sidosryhmäyhteistyö (mm. ympäristökonsultit, viranomaiset)

-
tuotanto-osastojen ohjeistus ja opastus

-
viranomaismenettelyjen (YVA:t, lupamenettelyt, yms.) toteuttamisessa avustaminen.

Odotamme sinulta:
-
tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa (esim. AMK Ins., DI, FM)

-
vähintään 3 vuoden kokemusta teollisuuden ympäristötehtävistä tai teollisuuteen liittyvistä hankkeista, kokemus kaivosteollisuudesta sekä pätevyys vesinäytteiden ja kiinteiden näytteiden otossa luetaan eduksi

-
kokemusta teollisuuslaitoksen ympäristötarkkailun toteuttamisesta ja kehittämisestä sekä raportoinnista

-
kokemusta teollisen toiminnan ympäristövaikutusten arvioinnista sekä vesien ja jätteiden hallinnasta

-
kykyä ajatella kriittisesti, kehittymishalua ja yhteistyökykyä

-
hyvää raportointikykyä sekä sujuvaa englannin ja suomen kielen taitoa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa ympäristöpäällikkö Jaakko Saukkoriipi, puh. 050 439 0122 jaakko.saukkoriipi@sibanyestillwater.com tai henkilöstöjohtaja Asko Saastamoinen, puh. 040 614 7477 asko.saastamoinen@sibanyestillwater.com
Hae tehtävään 27.9.2026 mennessä.

Sibanye-Stillwaters Keliber lithium project has begun the phased ramp-up of Europes first battery-grade lithium hydroxide production based on its own ore. The operation covers the entire value chain from ore exploration to lithium hydroxide processing and strengthens Europes battery value chain. The concentrator is located in Päiväneva, Kaustinen, and the lithium refinery is in the Kokkola industrial park.
Lithium hydroxide is a key raw material in lithium-ion batteries, which power electric vehicles, energy storage, and many everyday digital solutions.
Keliber is a subsidiary of Sibanye-Stillwater, a multinational mining and metals processing Group, with Finnish Minerals Group as the second largest shareholder, a state-owned company developing the value chain of lithium-ion batteries.
Would you like to take on this unique chance and create new generations industry in Finland?
We are strengthening our environmental team and are now looking for an

ENVIRONMENTAL SPECIALIST
to take responsibility for implementing and developing environmental monitoring for our operations in collaboration with our key internal and external stakeholders. Your responsibilities will include sampling in accordance with the monitoring program (water, soil, and mining waste), providing guidance and coordination on waste management to production departments, and liaising with the operators laboratory service provider.
You are also an expert on environmental matters and ensure that our environmental obligations are taken into account both now, during the projects ramp-up phase, and once production begins. You will report to the Environmental Manager.
Your main responsibilities are:
-
Environmental permit regulations compliance monitoring and reporting

-
Coordinating the water management, mining waste and other waste management

-
Collaboration with stakeholders (e.g., environmental consultants, authorities)

-
Providing guidance and instruction to production departments

-
Assisting in the implementation of regulatory procedures (EIA, permitting processes etc.)


In order to succeed, we expect You to:
-
Have a suitable bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering or Arts

-
Have at least 3 years of experience in industrial environmental roles or industry-related projects; experience in the mining industry and proficiency in collecting water and solid samples are considered a benefit

-
Have experience in implementing, developing and reporting environmental monitoring at industrial facilities

-
Have experience in assessing environmental impacts of industrial operations, as well as in water and waste management

-
Be able to think critically, have cooperation skills and willingness to develop yourself

-
Have strong reporting skills and fluency in English and Finnish


For further information please contact Environmental Manager Jaakko Saukkoriipi, tel. +358 (0)50 439 0122, jaakko.saukkoriipi@sibanyestillwater.com or Chief HR Officer Asko Saastamoinen, tel. +358(0)40 614 7477, asko.saastamoinen@sibanyestillwater.com
Apply by 27 September 2026

title: Scrum Master
description:
For our client from banking industry, we are looking for a Scrum Master.

The Scrum Master acts as an Execution Leader responsible not only for facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching the team, but also for actively driving the successful delivery of strategic initiatives from idea to implementation. The role combines Agile leadership, project execution, stakeholder management, delivery management, and AI enablement.

Detailed description of work task to be carried out:
Agile Leadership and Team Coaching
 Facilitate and continuously improve Agile ways of working within the team, ensuring effective execution of Scrum and SAFe practices.
 Organize and lead sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, reviews, backlog refinement sessions, PI Planning, and other Agile ceremonies.
 Coach team members, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, continuous improvement, flow optimization, and value-driven delivery.
 Foster a high-performing, self-organizing, cross-functional team culture with strong collaboration, accountability, transparency, and psychological safety.
 Monitor and improve team health, engagement, predictability, quality, and delivery performance.

Initiative and Delivery Leadership:
 Take ownership of strategic initiatives, epics, features, and cross-team deliveries, acting as the primary execution leader throughout the delivery lifecycle.
 Create and maintain delivery plans, roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risk logs, and execution tracking mechanisms
 Drive execution proactively by identifying blockers, coordinating issue resolution, escalating risks, and ensuring timely decision-making.
 Coordinate complex deliveries involving multiple teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and technology organizations.
 Ensure initiatives progress according to agreed scope, timelines, quality expectations, governance requirements, and funding constraints.
 Maintain visibility of delivery status and drive actions needed to achieve committed business outcomes.

AI Leadership and Transformation:
 Continuously identify and drive AI opportunities that improve productivity, quality, speed, and operational efficiency. Work with teams to define, prioritize, and implement AI use cases, ensuring AI and automation opportunities are considered during feature refinement, sprint planning, PI Planning, and continuous improvement activities.
 Promote an AI-first mindset across the Software Development Lifecycle by leveraging AI to improve planning, backlog management, documentation, testing, reporting, stakeholder communication, and overall team effectiveness. Encourage teams to actively challenge existing ways of working and explore how AI can simplify, automate, and accelerate value delivery

Must-have knowledge and experience:
 Experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Project Manager, or Execution Leader in a technology-driven environment
 Strong delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-team coordination capabilities
 Good understanding of API-based architectures, cloud technologies, infrastructure concepts, DevOps, and modern software development practices
 Understanding of Open Banking, digital platforms, or financial services technology ecosystems is considered a strong advantage
 Ability to engage effectively with architects, engineers, and business stakeholders without requiring hands-on technical expertise
 Proven interest in AI-driven ways of working and the ability to identify and drive adoption of AI, automation, and productivity-enhancing solutions across teams

Nice-to-have knowledge and experience:
 Experience working in financial services, banking, payments, Open Banking, Embedded Banking

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately.

Start time: 1.10.2026

Working model: Hybrid (The person needs to follow the internals with office present from October 3 times a week)
Allocation: 100 %
Location: Helsinki

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application!

title: Software Engineering Productivity Lead
description:
We are looking for a passionate technologist to lead the ways of working across all of Bittium groups software development: about 300 developers building everything from firmware to web frontends. You will set the standard for how we build, review, test, document and ship software, and roll it out hands-on with the teams. You get real authority, direct access to R&D leadership and backing from group management.

You might be the person who

- argued the team into a better merge strategy, and was right.
- tried the new build tool the weekend it came out.
- replaced a team's creaking toolchain with something modern, and nobody wanted to go back.
- has been told no about a rewrite more than once.
- moved into a lead, architect or managerial role years ago and never stopped writing code or tinkering with the pipelines.
- has rolled a new way of working out across several teams, and knows the hard part was never the tooling.

If a couple of these sound like you, keep reading. Whether you are a senior engineer ready to take your first step into leading and owning change beyond your own team, or a leader who has done this before and still wants to get your hands dirty, this role is built for you.

What you will own

- You define what modern software engineering means at Bittium: the standard every team builds against, and you keep raising it as the industry moves.
- You set our group-wide engineering workflow: version control strategy, branching, code review and CI/CD, from commit to release, with room for what each product and team needs and built for agentic-first development.
- You decide the quality bar a release has to clear: what we require from test automation, documentation and review before software ships.
- You author an engineering handbook with our senior engineers: a practical guide to how we build software, clear enough that any team can pick it up and use it.
- You help shape how we measure engineering health.

Product teams choose the right technology for their product. You are the engineers' engineer: you define, and help build, the engineering infrastructure and ways of working they stand on: pipelines, quality gates, test and documentation tooling, ready to use and maintained like products. Adoption is supported, not dumped on the teams. The work does not end with the first rollout. The foundation keeps evolving, and you keep pushing it forward.

Your first six months

- Help write the first version of our engineering handbook: a practical guide to how we build software, in one place.
- Set the group's ways of working, starting with source control and CI/CD, with the first teams already building on it.
- Get the first shared pipeline, quality gates and documentation tooling live with real teams. Working, not a slide deck.
- Put the first release quality gates into production use.

Where we are headed

Our goal is simple: well-tested, well-documented software, built on a shared, modern development platform. Software development is shifting toward agentic workflows, and we want our codebases ready for that: modular, containerized and verifiable, so an agent can check one out, build it, run the tests and trust the result. You define what that readiness means in practice, together with our Head of AI. We are also investing heavily in hardware-in-the-loop test automation against real devices, and your standards set the bar there too.

What we ask

- A software engineering background strong enough to hold your own with our senior engineers.
- A track record of changing how teams work, whether as the engineer who pushed for better Git workflows and modern tooling and made it stick, or as the lead who ran that change across an organisation.
- Strong opinions and dirty hands. You prototype, build and fix things yourself, and you lead the change at the same time: you own the direction, carry it through and answer for the outcome.
- You know modern DevOps and the engineering platform behind it well: version control, CI/CD, test automation, developer documentation.
- Agentic software development has clicked for you. You work with coding agents daily, you see where this goes as agents take on whole tasks with less and less supervision, and you have opinions about what that demands from codebases, tests, environments and documentation.
- You can work across very different stacks. Ours include, among other things, C/C++, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, web frontends, embedded Linux and FPGA.
- Fluent Finnish and good English.
- Due to the nature of Bittiums business and our customers expectations, you are a Finnish citizen and able to pass security clearance conducted by the Finnish Security Intelligence Service (SUPO).

We do not count years of experience. Skill, will and passion decide.

What we offer

- Group-wide authority over engineering standards.
- Deep technology with real stakes, from military radios in national defence to ECG monitors in hospitals.
- Room to stay hands-on. Prototype, experiment, pick the best tools. IT supports the infrastructure.
- Hybrid work in Oulu, our headquarters software site, or Espoo. Flexible inside Finland. Competitive pay.

Interested?

Send us your application as soon as possible. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period.

About Bittium

Bittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provides healthcare technology products and services for biosignal measuring in the areas of cardiology and neurology. Net sales in 2025 were EUR 119.3 million and operating result was EUR 19.4 million. Bittium is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki

title: Regulatory/Scientific Support in Data Availability unit (A4), ECHA, Helsinki
description:

The Regulatory / Scientific administrative support staff member will assist the Data validation and completeness team in the tasks related to the scientific and operational activities of the European Chemicals Agency (ECHA). In particular, they will work in the area of the completeness check of REACH registration data and contribute to the activities to improve data availability for the Agencys processes.

Main duties:

- Perform checks on registration dossiers according to Article 20(2) of REACH to ensure that the administrative and scientific data provided by registrants is complete according to the REACH provisions

- Carry out administrative tasks to process the dossiers and document the decisions in the relevant system

- Continuously develop expertise in assessing regulatory and scientific information against defined criteria

- Support the further development and testing of the IUCLID data validation rules

- Provide company support by drafting answers to Helpdesk questions and placing company calls

The job starts 1.10.2026 and ends 31.12.2026. It´s possible that the work will continue after this.

We expect from you:

- Experience in assessing content of administrative, technical or scientific nature following written instructions and strict deadlines; an eye for details

- Experience in customer support/interaction

- Ability to communicate effectively in written and spoken English

- Proficiency in using MS Office tools and aptitude to learn new IT applications

- Ability to complete assigned tasks independently in a timely manner and with little direction

- Sense of initiative and flexibility

- Aptitude for teamwork and sharing information

- Strong interpersonal skills

- Minimum of one (1) year of professional experience, relevant to the job

Assets for this position:

- Education in a scientific discipline, e.g., environmental sciences, chemical engineering, pharmacy, IT, etc.

- Knowledge in chemicals regulations

- Experience or interest in the development and testing of the IT tools

We offer you:

- Interesting project in a multicultural environment
- Versatile tasks and great teams support
- Comprehensive induction

Instructions and additional information:

We will be contacting applicants during application period, hence do not hesitate to leave your CV for the position today! Please be prepare to tell us two references.

Please note that prior to appointment, successful applicant will be asked to produce an official document indicating that they do not have a criminal record.

Please leave your application and CV in Europass format:
https://europass.cedefop.europa.eu/editors/en/cv/compose


The European Chemicals Agency (ECHA)

The European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) is the driving force among regulatory authorities in implementing the EU's groundbreaking chemicals legislation for the benefit of human health and the environment as well as for innovation and competitiveness. ECHA helps companies to comply with the legislation, advances the safe use of chemicals, provides information on chemicals and addresses chemicals of concern.

title: Network Architect
description:
Are you an experienced network professional with a strong architectural mindset and passion for secure, resilient, and scalable network solutions?

**We are looking for a Network Architect** to take responsibility for the design, implementation, and strategic development of Outokumpus global network infrastructure.

**In this role**, you will ensure that our network solutions are aligned with business objectives, security standards, and future technology needs. You will provide technical guidance across network technologies and support both operational activities and transformation initiatives. **As a Network Architect**, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the overall view of Outokumpus network architecture, covering areas such as LAN, WLAN, WAN, firewalls, external access, IP services, and cloud connectivity.

You will work closely with IT teams, business stakeholders, partners, and projects to define target architecture, guide solution design, and ensure that global network standards and technologies are followed.

**In this role, you will:**

- Develop and maintain the current Network Architecture view, covering LAN, WLAN, WAN, firewalls, external access, and IP services

- Define network standards, policies, and best practices

- Create, maintain, and drive short-term and long-term network roadmaps aligned with IT and business needs

- Develop and uphold the target Outokumpu Network Architecture, identifying gaps and improvement opportunities

- Support key partners in designing and implementing network solutions

- Guide IT programmes and projects towards the agreed target architecture

- Define and maintain consistent processes to ensure global technologies and standards are followed

- Identify and evaluate new technologies and innovations in the network market

- Own network documentation and develop processes for its review and lifecycle management

- Ensure network designs comply with security standards and regulatory requirements

- Design network solutions across cloud platforms


We are looking for a candidate with strong technical expertise, architectural thinking, and the ability to translate business requirements into practical, secure, and cost-effective solutions.

**To succeed in this role, you should have:**

- More than 7 years of experience in network technologies, solutions, and security

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant field or equivalent experience

- In-depth knowledge of networking and network security concepts, protocols, and technologies

- Experience with traditional and cloud computing environments, including legacy technologies

- Experience with Microsoft Azure is considered an advantage

- Understanding of industry-specific production and OT environments

- Experience with Palo Alto and Aruba hardware and tools

- Ability to translate business requirements into cost-effective technical solutions

- Experience with Enterprise Architecture processes and tools

- Strong conceptual, functional, and technical skills

- Willingness and flexibility to travel based on business needs


**Why join us?** At Outokumpu, you will have the opportunity to work in an international environment and contribute to the development of secure, modern, and business-critical network services. You will play an important role in shaping the future of our global network architecture and supporting digital transformation across the company. If you are ready to take the next step in your career and make an impact in a global industrial environment, we would be happy to hear from you.

**Please submit your application and CV in English** before the 4th of October via our website.

**For more information about the role,** please contact Sam Kurdynowski, Head of Compute and Networks, Sam.Kurdynowski@outokumpu.com.

title: Projektmedarbetare till vårt arbete med barn och familjer
description:
Vi rekryterar en medarbetare till vårt team för förebyggande familjearbete i Pargas för perioden 1.10.26-31.7.27. Arbetets huvudsakliga uppgift är att arbeta inom projektet **Hav och Hem – föräldrafärdigheter för en trygg vardag och bättre barndom i skärgården**.

Vi erbjuder dig

- Ett intressant och mångsidigt arbete med fokus på att stärka föräldraskap, familjers välmående och barns uppväxtvillkor.

- Arbete är självständigt, men det finns ett mångprofessionellt team som du är del av.

- Varierande arbetsuppgifter.

Hav och Hem är ett tvåårigt utvecklingsprojekt (1.8.25-31.7.27) som stärker föräldraskap, familjers resiliens och tillgången till stöd i Pargas och på Kimitoön. Målet är att stärka familjers resurser i vardagen och bidra till en trygg barndom i skärgården. Projektet finansieras av Leadergruppen I samma båt rf och Svenska kulturfonden.

- genomföra individuell föräldrahandledning,

- planera och leda gruppverksamhet för föräldrar,

- samarbeta med professionella och aktörer i regionen,

- planera och genomföra informationstillfällen, nätverksträffar och familjeevenemang,

- dokumentera, följa upp och utvärdera verksamheten,

- delta i kommunikation och marknadsföring av projektet,

- delta i projektets avslutande skede och bidra till att resultat, erfarenheter och lärdomar tas tillvara.


**Vi förutsätter att du har**

- Lämplig högskoleutbildning inom social- och hälsovård.

- God samarbetsförmåga och goda kommunikationsfärdigheter.

- Förmåga att arbeta självständigt, strukturerat och initiativrikt.

- Ett professionellt och respektfullt bemötande i mötet med familjer och samarbetspartner.

- Berömliga muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i svenska och finska.


**Som merit räknas**

- Erfarenhet av arbete med barn, unga och familjer.

- Erfarenhet av föräldrastöd, handledning eller gruppverksamhet.

- Kunskap om eller erfarenhet av evidensbaserade föräldrastödsprogram.


Arbetsplatsen är Pargas, men arbetet är rörligt och utförs i Pargas och på Kimitoön, vilket förutsätter körkort och möjlighet att använda egen bil i arbetet.

Intervjuerna påbörjas under ansökningstiden och befattningen fylls genast då vi hittar en lämplig kandidat.

title: Production Coordinator, Konecranes
description:
**We are now looking for a Production Coordinator to join Konecranes' global delivery organization and support customer delivery projects worldwide.**

_Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with more than 16,000 professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs._

_Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment free from discrimination and where diversity, equity and inclusion are valued._

**Would you be our new Production Coordinator?**

As a Production Coordinator, you will play an important role in ensuring that materials, information and deliveries move smoothly throughout customer delivery projects. Working as part of an international team, you will collaborate closely with colleagues in engineering, procurement, logistics, quality and project management to keep projects progressing according to plan. The role offers a unique opportunity to gain a broad understanding of how global delivery projects are executed from planning and procurement to final delivery.

Your daily work includes creating purchase requisitions in SAP, maintaining bill of materials (BOM) structures, coordinating shipments and supporting material availability throughout project deliveries. As projects evolve, new requirements and unexpected situations naturally arise. Your role is to keep things moving forward by coordinating activities, communicating with stakeholders and proactively resolving potential issues.

You will also work with technical documentation such as drawings and parts lists. While you do not need to be an experienced engineer, you should feel comfortable interpreting technical information and understanding how different components fit together within a project.

This is a full-time and permanent position. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Konecranes. The role follows a flexible hybrid working model, combining remote work with regular weekly office days in Hyvinkää. Occasional international travel may be part of the role.

**What are we looking for?**

Whether you are a recent graduate or have already gained a few years of experience, this role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in project deliveries, logistics and supply chain operations within a global industrial company.

You may have gained experience through studies, internships or previous work in areas such as supply chain management, project coordination, logistics, production planning or procurement. A background in industrial engineering and management, mechanical engineering, logistics or another relevant field is beneficial, but we are primarily looking for motivation, learning agility and a proactive mindset.

To succeed in this role, you should have strong general IT skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems and tools. Strong communication skills in English are required, as English is the working language in this role. Additional language skills are considered an advantage.

As a person, you are organized, curious and solution-oriented. You enjoy coordinating multiple tasks, taking ownership of your work and finding practical solutions when plans change. You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment and collaborating with stakeholders from different backgrounds and cultures.

**Why us?**

This role offers a great opportunity to learn how global customer delivery projects and supply chains operate in practice. You will gain exposure to multiple business functions and develop valuable expertise while working alongside experienced professionals in an international environment.

At Konecranes, you will be supported by a collaborative team culture where questions are encouraged, knowledge is shared openly and colleagues help each other succeed. The role also provides excellent opportunities for future career development across the company.

**Have we got your interest?**

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 30.9.2026. We process applications and start interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Saija Salter, Recruitment Consultant via email at **saija.salter@biisoni.fi**

title: Senior Project Planner
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

Hitachi Energy is looking for a Senior Project Planner to join our Project Controls team within the Nordic Operating Unit of our Grid Integration business. The position is based in Vaasa, Finland or Västerås, Sweden, with hybrid working possibilities.

As a Senior Project Planner, you will play a critical role throughout the entire lifecycle of our most complex electrical substation projects, from tendering to project handover in the field of planning and scheduling. Your expertise and proactive approach will ensure consistency and alignment of scope, time, cost, and progress, ultimately contributing to the success and satisfaction of our customers.

In this role, you will be in the driving seat, ensuring projects have robust, dynamic, and well-structured schedules that meet contractual objectives and provide clear roadmaps for the execution phase.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust, dynamic project schedules that align with contractual commitments and provide a clear framework for successful project execution.

You will work closely with various stakeholders making sure the project schedules are used for work coordination, predictable forecasting, proactive schedule risk management, cost management, resource management, and of course, team alignment. You will also conduct schedule and resource analysis and prepare schedule progress reporting materials both for external and internal purposes.

At Hitachi Energy, we know that great results are achieved together. As a Senior Project Planner, you will collaborate closely with Project Managers, Project Controllers, Lead Engineers, Project SCMs, Logistic Specialists, Site and Commissioning Managers and with our Customers. You will also become part of a highly experienced and supportive community of Project Planners. Together, we share knowledge, solve challenges, and support one another in delivering excellence in every project.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Take a leading role in planning and scheduling activities in complex projects and support project teams with schedule governance, analysis and decision making

· Develop, maintain, and analyze integrated project schedules in close collaboration with project teams

· Support predictable schedule forecasting by aligning time, cost, resources and progress

· Identify schedule deviations, risks, and opportunities early, and communicate them clearly to project stakeholders

· Prepare schedule reports and analyses, including S-curves, critical path analyses, resource histograms and On-Time-Delivery (OTD) milestones

· Actively communicate schedule information to stakeholders to keep everyone informed

· Support and prepare What-if schedule scenarios, delay mitigation plans and Extension of Time (EoT) claims together with the project team

· Promote planning and scheduling best practices across the organization, act as a role model and support less experienced planners

· Drive the use and continuous improvement of planning and scheduling methodologies and tools

**Your background**

· M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Electrical engineering or another relevant field

· Proven experience in planning and scheduling complex projects

· Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate, and inspire stakeholders across the project organization

· Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and good knowledge of schedule management theory

· The ability to prepare and maintain high quality, dynamic project schedules together with the project team

· A proactive and self-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

· A structured and goal-oriented approach to your work, with a focus on delivering results

· Project Management Certificate (PMP® and/or PMI-SP®) is considered an advantage

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of Finnish and/or Swedish is considered a plus

title: Safari Guide, Lapland Safaris Olos
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Safari Guides for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the winter season 2026–2027. We are looking for Safari Guides to work in Luosto, Levi, Saariselkä, Ylläs and Olos.**

As a Safari Guide, you get to introduce our international guests to the magnificent nature of Finnish Lapland and guide them through adventure activities. You may act as a guide, for example, on a snowshoe safari at the top of a fell, take the guests on a visit to a reindeer farm and a husky kennel, or snowmobile into the snowy forest to see the Northern Lights. In some of our destinations a part of safari guides job is to also guide various bus tours.

Your work tools can be snowmobiles, ice fishing gear, e-fatbikes, skis and snowshoes. As a guide, your workdays consist of preparing for the safari programs, meeting the guests before the safaris, as well as taking care of the clothing of your guests. You will help them dress up properly before each safari and after the activity you will take care of the clothes that you provided such as overalls, socks, boots and gloves. One of the most essential parts of the job is to help dress our guests with winter clothes, and all our safari guides work as part of our equipment team. After the safaris, cleaning and maintaining the equipment used on safaris is an important part of a safari guides daily routine as well. Whatever you do, every day you get to see the excitement on your guests faces as they prepare for new and unique experiences!

We are looking for people who enjoy being outdoors regardless of the weather and to maintain a positive attitude even on long and busy days. Your workdays are rarely the same, and a working day can consist of one or several different tasks, and a lot of work is also done in the evening. Changes to your daily tasks may come with short notice.

In addition to outdoor work, variation to your days comes from indoor clothing maintenance work. Work tasks and guest groups vary a little between destinations. The guides we are looking for are versatile and multi talented, with an open attitude towards different work tasks.

**In all our destinations,** knowledge of French language, is considered an advantage. We train our employees in first aid skills, but we value previously acquired first aid skills as well. At least a class B driver's license is an essential requirement for the job. BE driver's license and experience of driving a 9-seater vehicle in snowy conditions are considered advantageous, as well as knowledge of the area. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

**In Luosto,** the safari guides may act as elf guides during the Christmas season.

**In Luosto and Levi**, knowledge of French language (fluent) is a prerequisite.

**We expect from you:**

- Positive attitude and excellent cooperation and interaction skills

- Customer service-focused and group management skills

- Flexibility and ability to work under pressure

- Passion for outdoors and Interest in Finnish Laplands nature, culture and history

- Fluent English - knowledge of French, German, Italian or Spanish is considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Fun working days and a supportive team

- The opportunity to learn about the nature of the north

- Numerous leisure opportunities enjoying the real winter

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides for new employees a paid Arctic Guide -course at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and will last until the end of March 2027, in Rovaniemi a few positions end already mid-January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, minimum hourly wage between 10,80-13,60 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

Read the job descriptions and the workday stories from HERE.

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

title: Buffet Waiter/Waitress, Lapland Hotels Saaga, Ylläs
description:
Would you like to spend your winter in Lapland, surrounded by snowy landscapes, enchanted by the Northern Lights, skiing in your free time and enjoying a truly international atmosphere?

StaffPoint is currently seeking BUFFET WAITER/WAITRESS for Lapland Hotels Saaga for the winter season 2026-2027!

The employment will begin in November 19th and continue until approximately at the end of February. Alternatively, you can work only during the Christmas season from 19 November until 31 December 2026.

title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Lietoon
description:
**Lähihoitaja Lietoon Kreivinkotoon – kädet saveen, liikkeelle yhdessä ja musiikki soimaan!**

**Etsimme lähihoitajaa, joka ei pelkää laittaa itseään likoon – ja välillä laittaa myös musiikin soimaan.**

Kuulostaako siltä, että voisit viihtyä meidän porukassamme?

Kreivinkoto Lieto on ikäihmisten yhteisöllinen koti, jossa **ei vain hoideta, vaan eletään hyvää arkea yhdessä**. Meillä päivä voi sisältää lääkehoitoa ja hoitotyötä, mutta yhtä hyvin myös leivontaa, askartelua, ulkoilua, musiikkia, naurua ja kaikenlaista yhdessä tekemistä.

Etsimme nyt joukkoomme **lähihoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä työtä ihmisten kanssa – ei vain heidän puolestaan.

**Mitä työ Kreivinkodossa on?**

Olet tärkeä osa asukkaidemme jokapäiväistä elämää. Tuet heidän toimintakykyään, hyvinvointiaan ja itsenäisyyttään sekä olet mukana luomassa mielekästä arkea.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- kokonaisvaltaista hoitoa ja huolenpitoa

- lääkehoitoa

- asukkaiden ohjaamista ja toimintakyvyn tukemista

- päivätoiminnan ja yhteisen tekemisen toteuttamista

- ulkoilua, virikkeitä ja arjen pieniä iloja

- kohtaamisia asukkaiden ja heidän läheistensä kanssa

- yhteistyötä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.


**Ja kyllä – välillä tärkein työtehtävä voi olla istua hetkeksi alas, kuunnella ja olla läsnä.**

**Millainen tyyppi meille sopii?**

Toivomme, että olet:

- koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja

- lämmin ja helposti lähestyttävä

- oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen

- hyvä tyyppi tiimipelaajaksi

- kiinnostunut ikäihmisten hyvinvoinnista ja hyvästä arjesta

- valmis tarttumaan tekemiseen ja kokeilemaan uutta.


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea valmiiksi. **Asenne ratkaisee.**

Jos tuot mukanasi ripauksen huumoria, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja halun tehdä työsi sydämellä, saatat olla juuri se henkilö, jota etsimme.

**Miksi Kreivinkoto?**

Koska meillä saat olla **lähihoitaja, ihminen ja työkaveri**.

Meillä arvostetaan toisiamme ja tehdään töitä yhdessä. Saat mahdollisuuden käyttää omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja olla mukana kehittämässä asukkaidemme arkea.

Meille yhteisöllisyys tarkoittaa sitä, että **asukkaat ja työntekijät tekevät arkea yhdessä**.

Ja ehkä juuri siksi täällä ei ole kahta samanlaista työpäivää.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos ajattelet, että **tuonne minä haluaisin töihin**, älä jää vain ajattelemaan – laita hakemus tulemaan!

Kerro meille lyhyesti itsestäsi ja siitä, **miksi juuri sinä sopisit Kreivinkotoon.**

**Kreivinkodossa hyvä arki ei synny itsestään – tehdään se yhdessä.**

Aloitamme haastattelut jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä, joten hae heti, niin päästään tutustumaan. Haluatko osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa kaikilla on tärkeä tehtävä ja halu menestyä yhdessä? Laita hakemuksesi Annelle (anne.holmberg@kototiimi.fi)

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi

title: Sairaanhoitaja uuteen Keisarinnaan!
description:
**Sairaanhoitaja, haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa jotain uutta?**

**Nyt on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan heti alusta asti.**

Keisarinnan uusi palvelukoti avaa ovensa, ja etsimme joukkoomme **sairaanhoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, mutta myös vaikuttaa siihen, millainen työpaikka ja arki meillä rakentuu.

Keisarinnassa tuotetaan **yhteisöllistä asumispalvelua ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikäihmisille**. Me emme halua vain avata uutta yksikköä – haluamme rakentaa paikan, jossa on hyvä asua, hyvä tehdä töitä ja hyvä tulla kohdatuksi.

**Miksi juuri Keisarinna?**

Koska tässä työssä et astu valmiiseen muottiin.

Uuden yksikön käynnistyessä pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan siihen, **miten meillä tehdään asioita**. Saat tuoda pöytään omat ideasi, osaamisesi ja persoonasi.

Me haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa ei tarvitse miettiä:

_"Näin tämä on aina tehty."_

Vaan kysytään:

**"Voisiko tämän tehdä vielä paremmin?"**

Sairaanhoitajana olet tärkeässä roolissa sekä asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hoidon että turvallisen arjen rakentamisessa. Päivissä on vaihtelua, vastuuta, kohtaamisia ja ennen kaikkea mahdollisuuksia tehdä työ omalla ammattitaidollasi näkyväksi.

**Tässä työssä pääset**

- olemaan mukana käynnistämässä täysin uutta palvelukotia

- rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää työyhteisöä alusta asti

- hyödyntämään ja kehittämään omaa sairaanhoitajan osaamistasi

- kohtaamaan ikäihmiset yksilöinä – ei vain asiakkaina

- vaikuttamaan arjen toimintatapoihin ja niiden kehittämiseen

- tekemään työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä.


**Meille hyvä hoitotyö on muutakin kuin suorittamista**

Keisarinnassa asukkaiden elämä ei pysähdy siihen, että he muuttavat palvelukotiin.

Haluamme mahdollistaa **oman näköistä elämää, turvallisuutta, yhteisöllisyyttä ja hyviä hetkiä**. Siksi tarvitsemme hoitajia, joille ihminen tulee ennen rutiinia.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis paketti.

**Riittää, että olet ammattitaitoinen, utelias, vastuullinen ja valmis tekemään yhdessä.**

Arvostamme myös huumoria, hyvää energiaa ja sitä, että uskallat sanoa ääneen omat ajatuksesi.

**Tule tekemään tästä meidän näköisemme Keisarinna.**

Jos kaipaat työltäsi enemmän kuin valmista työvuorolistaa ja tuttua kaavaa, **Keisarinna saattaa olla juuri sinua varten.**

Täällä pääset näkemään oman kädenjälkesi.

**Uusi paikka. Uusi tiimi. Uudet mahdollisuudet.**

Ja ehkä juuri sinä olet yksi niistä ihmisistä, joiden ansiosta Keisarinnasta tulee paikka, jonne on maanantainakin kiva tulla töihin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos olet **sairaanhoitaja** ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa uutta palvelukotia alusta asti, **lähetä meille hakemuksesi!**

Kerro meille lyhyesti, kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea:

**Mitä sinä haluaisit tuoda Keisarinnaan?**

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan Keisarinnaa. Meillä on paikka sinulle.**

title: Technicien de maintenance itinérant F/H (H/F)
description:
Entreprise
Entreprise française, filiale du groupe KANADEVIA INOVA, nous sommes engagés dans la transition énergétique à travers des solutions innovantes, dédiées au secteur agricole.
Nous accompagnons les exploitants agricoles dans la valorisation de leurs déchets organiques en les aidant à produire une énergie renouvelable, tout en améliorant leur performance environnementale. Nous sommes spécialisés dans :
- La conception, l'exploitation, la maintenance et l'entretien d'unités de méthanisation et de production de biométhane, permettant la valorisation durable des déchets organiques.
- L'accompagnement technique de nos clients afin de garantir la performance, la fiabilité et la pérennité de leurs installations.
Acteurs de terrain, nous contribuons à la modernisation du monde agricole en aidant nos clients à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Guidés par notre conviction « Best Never Waste », nous œuvrons chaque jour pour valoriser durablement les ressources et contribuer à un avenir énergétique plus responsable.
Convaincus que la performance passe par l'humain, nous investissons continuellement dans la montée en compétences de nos équipes à travers un plan de formation conçu pour répondre aux besoins du terrain, aux exigences techniques et aux évolutions de notre secteur.
Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité dans le Grand Est, nous créons un poste de TECHNICIEN DE MAINTENANCE ITINÉRANT F/H
- Secteur Meurthe-et-Moselle (54)

Missions
Rattaché-e au Responsable Maintenance et au site de Neuves-Maisons (54), vous assurez la maintenance préventive et curative d'unités de méthanisation sur votre secteur. Vous garantissez la fiabilité et la disponibilité des installations tout en accompagnant nos clients au quotidien.

Plus particulièrement, vous :
- Réalisez les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les installations de méthanisation
- Intervenez sur des équipements variés à dominante mécanique (pompes, extracteurs, moteurs.), mais aussi sur les équipements électriques, hydrauliques, pneumatiques, d'automatisme et de métrologie
- Diagnostiquez les pannes sur site ou à distance ainsi que les problématiques rencontrées par les clients
- Rédigez les rapports d'intervention via les outils internes de l'entreprise et assurez le suivi administratif associé
- Préparez vos interventions et veillez au bon entretien de votre véhicule, de votre outillage et des consommables nécessaires à votre activité
- Appliquez et faites respecter les règles de sécurité, de qualité et d'environnement sur l'ensemble de vos interventions
- Entretenez une relation de proximité avec les exploitants agricoles et contribuez à leur satisfaction par la qualité de vos interventions

Profil
Issu-e d'une formation technique en maintenance industrielle, électromécanique ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans la maintenance d'équipements industriels et idéalement dans le secteur de la méthanisation, du biogaz, de l'agriculture ou des énergies renouvelables.
Vous disposez de solides compétences en mécanique ainsi que de bonnes bases en électricité industrielle et diagnostic technique.
Autonome, rigoureux-se et organisé-e, vous appréciez le terrain, les environnements techniques variés et le contact client.
Votre capacité à analyser les situations, à résoudre les problèmes et à intervenir en toute autonomie fera de vous un acteur clé du développement de notre activité dans le Grand Est.

Un environnement collaboratif valorisant le partage de pratiques et l'initiative.

Affecter le personnel habilité aux travaux à effectuer ;

Compétences et qualités requises :
Aptitude au management d'équipe, leadership et capacité à fédérer ;
Rigueur, méthode et organisation ;
Sensibilité aux exigences Qualité, Sécurité (en particulier le port des EPI), Sûreté, Environnement ;
Aisance dans la gestion de la relation client ;
Habilitations Risques Chimiques Niveau 2 et Réception Echafaudage en cours de validité ;
Mobilité géographique

Travailler au sein de l'entreprise OUVAROFF EST, c'est une aventure humaine collective unique, fondée sur une histoire familiale et des valeurs historiques fortes.

title: Technicien de maintenance itinérant F/H (H/F)
description:
Entreprise
Entreprise française, filiale du groupe KANADEVIA INOVA, nous sommes engagés dans la transition énergétique à travers des solutions innovantes, dédiées au secteur agricole.
Nous accompagnons les exploitants agricoles dans la valorisation de leurs déchets organiques en les aidant à produire une énergie renouvelable, tout en améliorant leur performance environnementale. Nous sommes spécialisés dans :
- La conception, l'exploitation, la maintenance et l'entretien d'unités de méthanisation et de production de biométhane, permettant la valorisation durable des déchets organiques.
- L'accompagnement technique de nos clients afin de garantir la performance, la fiabilité et la pérennité de leurs installations.
Acteurs de terrain, nous contribuons à la modernisation du monde agricole en aidant nos clients à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Guidés par notre conviction « Best Never Waste », nous œuvrons chaque jour pour valoriser durablement les ressources et contribuer à un avenir énergétique plus responsable.
Convaincus que la performance passe par l'humain, nous investissons continuellement dans la montée en compétences de nos équipes à travers un plan de formation conçu pour répondre aux besoins du terrain, aux exigences techniques et aux évolutions de notre secteur.
Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité dans le Grand Est, nous créons un poste de TECHNICIEN DE MAINTENANCE ITINÉRANT F/H
- Secteur Meurthe-et-Moselle (54)

Missions
Rattaché-e au Responsable Maintenance et au site de Neuves-Maisons (54), vous assurez la maintenance préventive et curative d'unités de méthanisation sur votre secteur. Vous garantissez la fiabilité et la disponibilité des installations tout en accompagnant nos clients au quotidien.

Plus particulièrement, vous :
- Réalisez les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les installations de méthanisation
- Intervenez sur des équipements variés à dominante mécanique (pompes, extracteurs, moteurs.), mais aussi sur les équipements électriques, hydrauliques, pneumatiques, d'automatisme et de métrologie
- Diagnostiquez les pannes sur site ou à distance ainsi que les problématiques rencontrées par les clients
- Rédigez les rapports d'intervention via les outils internes de l'entreprise et assurez le suivi administratif associé
- Préparez vos interventions et veillez au bon entretien de votre véhicule, de votre outillage et des consommables nécessaires à votre activité
- Appliquez et faites respecter les règles de sécurité, de qualité et d'environnement sur l'ensemble de vos interventions
- Entretenez une relation de proximité avec les exploitants agricoles et contribuez à leur satisfaction par la qualité de vos interventions

Profil
Issu-e d'une formation technique en maintenance industrielle, électromécanique ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans la maintenance d'équipements industriels et idéalement dans le secteur de la méthanisation, du biogaz, de l'agriculture ou des énergies renouvelables.
Vous disposez de solides compétences en mécanique ainsi que de bonnes bases en électricité industrielle et diagnostic technique.
Autonome, rigoureux-se et organisé-e, vous appréciez le terrain, les environnements techniques variés et le contact client.
Votre capacité à analyser les situations, à résoudre les problèmes et à intervenir en toute autonomie fera de vous un acteur clé du développement de notre activité dans le Grand Est.

Affecter le personnel habilité aux travaux à effectuer ;
Assurer l'encadrement et la gestion du personnel (planning, pointages, .) durant toute la période d'exécution des travaux ;
Détecter et signaler toute situation dangereuse en la faisant remonter à la direction et à notre service HSE ;
S'assurer du bon état, de la conformité et du bon usage du matériel, outillage et protections mis à disposition ;
S'assurer de l'entretien et du respect du port des équipements de protections individuels et collectifs ;
Veiller à la tenue du chantier (ordre, propreté, rangement, identification, stockage, .) et à la bonne application des consignes SSE ;
Effectuer des relevés de préfabrication ;
Suivre le dossier de chantier de l'ouverture à la clôture ;
Proposer des améliorations (poste de travail, procédures techniques et qualité, au client, .) ;
Etre en lien avec le HSE : ouverture et traitement de FNC, arbre des causes .

Formé(e) à la conduite de travaux (niveau Baccalauréat à minimum), vous justifiez d'une expérience significative d'au moins 5 ans en encadrement d'équipes et suivi de chantiers, dans le métier du Calorifuge idéalement.
Compétences et qualités requises :
Aptitude au management d'équipe, leadership et capacité à fédérer ;
Rigueur, méthode et organisation ;
Sensibilité aux exigences Qualité, Sécurité (en particulier le port des EPI), Sûreté, Environnement ;
Aisance dans la gestion de la relation client ;
