title: Spécialiste en communication visuelle (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Armée luxembourgeoise est une force militaire moderne et professionnelle. Composée d'hommes et de femmes dévoués, elle a pour mission principale de défendre la souveraineté et l'intégrité du Grand-Duché, de contribuer à la sécurité nationale et internationale, et de participer aux opérations de maintien de la paix sous l'égide de l'OTAN, de l'Union européenne et des Nations Unies. Engagée dans un environnement multinational, l'Armée luxembourgeoise offre un cadre de travail où l'esprit d'équipe et le sens du devoir occupent une place centrale. Rejoindre l'Armée luxembourgeoise, c'est: Servir son pays dans un cadre porteur de valeurs fortes : droiture, engagement et fiabilité; Développer ses compétences à travers une formation continue et personnalisée; Évoluer dans une carrier/ière riche en opportunité et missions variées. Missions Le Spécialiste en communication visuelle fait partie du Bureau des Relations publiques. Ses missions principales sont: Concevoir et réaliser des supports de communication visuelle, imprimés et digitaux, en cohérence avec l'identité et le positionnement de l'Armée luxembourgeoise; Élaborer des concepts créatifs et les décliner sur différents formats (affiches, brochures, flyers, présentations, supports web et réseaux sociaux), en veillant à leur adéquation aux publics cibles et aux objectifs institutionnels; Assurer la mise en page, le traitement iconographique et la préparation des fichiers pour impression ou diffusion numérique, dans le respect des standards de qualité; Veiller à l'application, à la structuration et à l'évolution de la charte graphique; Participer activement au développement des réseaux sociaux, à l'actualisation et à l'administration des médias print et digitaux, y compris le site internet et les plateformes de communication internes et externes; Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre de la stratégie de communication en coordonnant et en concevant des campagnes visant à promouvoir l'image, l'identité et les valeurs de l'Armée luxembourgeoise. Profil Compétences techniques Maîtrise des logiciels de la suite Adobe Creative Suite, notamment InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop et After Effects; Connaissances de base en Content Management System (CMS); Connaissances approfondies des outils informatiques usuels (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Outlook); Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles, d'analyse et de synthèse. Compétences comportementales Flexibilité et capacité à s'adapter rapidement à de nouvelles circonstances; Rigueur dans le travail avec un respect des échéances; Sens de l'organisation et de la structuration de son travail; Volonté de se familiariser avec les coutumes militaires; Discrétion. Atouts Connaissances des concepts de la Défense luxembourgeoise, de l'OTAN et de l'UE; Connaissances des milieux institutionnel, politique et culturel du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg; Connaissance des pratiques de référencement (SEO) et d'analyse du trafic sur internet (Google Analytics); Connaissance de Sharepoint. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État ou de l'employé de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission : Pour devenir fonctionnaire de l'État Pour changer d'administration en tant que fonctionnaire Pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un bachelor en graphisme ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 6 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Expérience Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine. Langues Applicable à l'employé et au fonctionnaire (hors changement d'administration) : Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe A2.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise. Le titulaire devra obtenir une habilitation de sécurité du niveau secret (loi modifiée du  juin  relative à la classification des pièces et aux habilitations de sécurité)

title: DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (H/F)
description: Afin de renforcer les équipes de DEEP au sein de Business Line Cloud, nous recherchons actuellement un(e) DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (m/f/n) à temps plein.Vos missions Concevoir et spécifier des architectures cloud complexes sur OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et, selon les besoins, OPCP, en garantissant leur performance, leur sécurité, leur résilience et leur conformité. Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Accompagner les projets de migration et de modernisation d'infrastructures et de plateformes applicatives vers OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et des approches cloud native basées sur Kubernetes et services managés. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Définir et faire appliquer les architectures de référence pour les environnements cloud native, incluant les aspects de déploiement, d'observabilité, de logging, de gestion des secrets, de sécurité et de cycle de vie des plateformes. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Votre profil Disposer d'une formation de niveau Master spécialisée en informatique, systèmes, réseaux et cloud, et/ou d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Disposer d'une expérience significative dans la conception, l'intégration ou l'évolution d'architectures cloud pour des clients, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer des solutions complexes. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Avoir une bonne connaissance dans les pratiques d'automatisation et d'Infrastructure as Code telles que Terraform, Ansible ou équivalents, ainsi que les approches CI/CD et GitOps. Être capable d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de gouvernance et d'exploitabilité dans les choix d'architecture. Disposer de solides compétences rédactionnelles pour formaliser les architectures, les dossiers techniques et les standards de mise en œuvre. Intéressé(e) ? title: Cartographe (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? La Bibliothèque nationale du Luxembourg (BnL) s'engage dans un nouveau programme visant à améliorer l'accessibilité de ses collections, en particulier celles des Fonds spéciaux, qui abritent des trésors patrimoniaux uniques : cartes historiques, plans, atlas, vues topographiques et documents cartographiques rares. Avec cartes et plans couvrant des représentations du monde, du Luxembourg et de ses territoires, cette collection se distingue comme l'une des plus remarquables du pays. Pourtant, cette collection reste non cataloguée, donc inaccessible en ligne. La BnL cherche à renforcer l'équipe patrimoniale avec un expert polyvalent, capable de gérer des tâches complexes liées à la préservation et à l'accessibilité du patrimoine. Missions Catalogage et valorisation des collections: Enrichir les métadonnées, référencer, cataloguer, indexer et exemplariser les documents des Fonds spéciaux, surtout les cartes, plans, atlas, vues, selon les normes en vigueur (SIGB Alma, RDA, Rameau, DDC); Structurer les critères de collection pour les documents cartographiques, en collaboration avec l'équipe patrimoniale; Établir une charte d'acquisition et une politique de conservation adaptées aux spécificités des fonds cartographiques; Contrôler la cohérence du développement du Fonds des cartes, plans et atlas, en veillant à son alignement avec les objectifs stratégiques de la BnL. Gestion et accessibilité numérique: Piloter la numérisation des collections cartographiques; Valoriser les collections à l'aide des nouvelles technologies (humanités numériques, outils de recherche scientifique) pour en faciliter l'accès au public et aux chercheurs; Collaborer avec les services IT pour intégrer les données cartographiques dans les plateformes numériques de la BnL (eluxemburgensia). Conservation et expertise: Assurer la préservation des documents (conditions de stockage, restauration si nécessaire); Participer à des projets de recherche en lien avec les collections, en collaboration avec des institutions nationales ou internationales. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience avérée en: Catalogage de documents patrimoniaux (normes RDA, Rameau, DDC); Gestion de SIGB (idéalement Alma); Numérisation et valorisation de collections spéciales; Maîtrise des outils de traitement d'images, de métadonnées et de bases de données bibliographiques; Connaissances en conservation préventive des documents anciens et fragiles; Rigueur et précision : capacité à travailler avec des documents uniques et parfois fragiles; Esprit d'initiative : proposition de solutions innovant/antes pour améliorer l'accessibilité des collections; Collaboration : travail en équipe avec les autres services de la BnL (patrimoine, IT, communication); Sens de la médiation : aptitude à rendre les collections compréhensibles et attractives pour le public. Compétences comportementales Conceptualiser : Vous pensez de façon abstraite à l'aide de concepts, vous modélisez et simulez le futur pour concevoir des solutions réalistes; Gérer les activités : Vous gérez les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs opérationnels clairs, vous gérez les ressources et suivez la mise en oeuvre des activités; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : Vous fournissez des conseils et développez une relation de confiance basée sur votre crédibilité, vous faites des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client-usager; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez constructif face à la critique et vous agissez de façon constant/ante malgré les difficultés; S'autodévelopper : Vous vous remettez en question de façon régulier/ière, vous apprenez de vos erreurs et vous apprenez continuellement; S'impliquer : Vous vous engagez pour générer des résultats, vous assumez la responsabilité et la qualité des actions entreprises, vous vous engagez pour le bien commun. Atouts Connaissance du contexte luxembourgeois (histoire, géographie, institutions culturelles); Expérience dans la gestion de projets liés au patrimoine ou à la numérisation. description:

Missions :

Assurer la préparation des opérations et la planification journalière des ressources nécessaires à l'activité
Contrôler le respect du planning et enregistrer les changements de personnel selon les procédures en vigueur. Selon les besoins de l'opération et les requêtes individuelles procéder aux ajustements du planning à court terme
Transmettre l'information et les directives nécessaires aux équipes du Ground Handling pour le bon déroulement des opérations et suivre les statuts des vols afin d'anticiper toute éventualité
Etre l'interlocuteur privilégié avec les autres services ainsi qu'avec les représentants des compagnies tierces
Signaler toute irrégularité et établir le srapport quotidien de fin de tournée
Proposer des actions correctives afin d'améliorer la qualité du service
Etre en étroite collaboration avec le Manager Passenger Assistance afin de participer au développement et suivi des ressources. Coordonner les besoins spécifiques/individuels avec le département Formation
Gérer les irrégularités du réseau Luxair et LuxairTours au départ et à l'arrivée de toutes les stations desservies en collaboration avec l'OCC et coordonner les plans d'actions avec les équipes et prestataires concernés
Rapporter toute anomalie à la Direction du Ground Handling

Profil requis:

Critères minimaux requis pour le poste

Etre détenteur d'un diplôme de fin d'études secondaires au Luxembourg ou équivalent
Maîtriser l'anglais, le français et/ou l'allemand (parlé & écrit)
Etre orienté clients, avoir une présentation soignée et respecter les procédures du port d'uniforme
Avoir une expérience confirmée de l'Assistance Passager ainsi que de l'encadrement d'équipes opérationnelles
Maintenir la stricte confidentialité des données
Etre précis, avoir le sens de l'organisation et des priorités et une grande résistance au stress
Savoir travailler de manière autonome et en équipe
Travail sur tournées
Le luxembourgeois et toute autre langue sera considérée comme un atout majeur à ce poste

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Profile

Ensure the preparation of operations and the daily planning of the resources required for the activity.
Monitor compliance with the schedule and record staff changes in accordance with the applicable procedures. Based on operational requirements and individual requests, make short-term adjustments to the schedule as necessary.
Communicate the information and instructions required by the Ground Handling teams to ensure the smooth running of operations, and monitor flight statuses in order to anticipate any potential issues.
Act as the main point of contact with other departments as well as with representatives of third-party airlines.
Report any irregularities and prepare the daily end-of-shift report.
Propose corrective actions to improve service quality.
Work closely with the Passenger Assistance Manager to contribute to the development and monitoring of resources.
Coordinate specific and individual needs with the Training Department.
Manage irregularities affecting the Luxair and LuxairTours network, both on departure and arrival at all stations served, in cooperation with the OCC, and coordinate action plans with the relevant teams and service providers.
Report any anomalies to Ground Handling Management.

Hold a Luxembourg secondary school leaving diploma or an equivalent qualification.
Have a good command of English, French and/or German, both spoken and written.
Be customer-oriented, maintain a professional appearance and comply with uniform-wearing procedures.
Have proven experience in Passenger Assistance as well as in supervising operational teams.Maintain strict confidentiality of information and data.
Be accurate, well-organised, able to prioritise effectively and highly stress-resistant.
Be able to work both independently and as part of a team.
Be willing to work shifts.
Luxembourgish and any other additional language will be considered a major asset for this position.

In this role, you will review whether the business is operating within our risk appetite, assess the effectiveness of technology-related controls, and support regulatory alignment. In this role, you will review whether the business is operating within risk appetite, assess the effectiveness of technology-related controls, support regulatory alignment, and help strengthen oversight of outsourced and intra-group technology and information security activities.

Promote ICT risk awareness and help strengthen risk culture across the organization.
Champion the effective and secure use of AI to support automation, efficiency, and scalable risk management practices.


What you bring:

8+ years of experience in cyber, technology, or ICT risk, with a strong understanding of second line oversight, control effectiveness, and independent challenge.
Experience in a highly regulated environment, ideally in financial services, including interaction with regulatory expectations and governance processes.
Strong understanding of ICT, cyber, and operational risks specific to cryptocurrency and digital asset businesses, including exchange and custody models, third-party dependencies, technology resilience, and heightened regulatory expectations.
Strong knowledge of relevant ICT and cyber regulatory requirements, including DORA, MiCA, EU AI Act, CSSF expectations, and related European frameworks.
Experience across technology risk, control assurance, incident response, and internal control environments; technology audit experience is a strong plus.
Ability to assess complex technology and security risks, provide practical challenge to first-line teams, and influence outcomes across business and technical stakeholders.
Experience in business continuity, identity and access management, secure software development.
Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, or CRISC are strongly preferred; ISO 27001, ISO 22301, or similar certifications are a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to build trusted relationships and operate effectively across functions.

Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact and bonus programs.

We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what's next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term)

BBH is currently recruiting a Depositary Services Senior Representative to join our dynamic Depositary Services team. In this key role you will be responsible for the coordination and performance of tasks relating to the supervision of assets of Real Estate, Private Debt and Private Equity funds. In addition, you will assess, analyze, and monitor risks and control issues for the products and services falling under the scope of the Depositary obligations.  You will have a high level of technical acumen and analytical skills in order to foster a solution orientated and consultative approach to performing our Depositary obligations

Key Responsibilities:

• Gather and review documentation received in relation to recordkeeping and verification of ownership of real assets (real estate, private debt, private equity, fund of funds) and proactively monitor the status and completion of those tasks and follow up to obtain required client documentation
• Build Strong relationships with Clients and have the knowledge and ability to explain the regulatory drivers behind these requirements
• Review and/or execute daily cash flow monitoring activities by gathering information and reviewing exceptions
• Support team in determining appropriate resolutions to new regulatory obligations.
• Monitor, report, define and document critical internal control processes.
• Formulate corrective actions, where applicable, to resolve identified exceptions.
• Coordinate internal and external projects in an efficient and thorough manner.
• Prepare and review documentation for regulators and external auditors
• Support Team on questions from clients, regulators, external auditors and/or BBH internal departments. Communicate clearly with business area contacts as well as other areas of the Bank
• Maintain effective working relationships at relevant levels with other departments
• Escalate within the team significant audit issues, set direction/communicate proposed manner of resolution of audit issues and concerns that have a significant impact
• Develop and maintain peer relationships to share best practices

Qualifications:

1. Education level and/ or experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting
• 2 to 4 years' experience working within the alternative funds industry or relevant business line experience
• Proficient Business level German skills are considered as an advantage

2. Knowledge and skills

• Excellent analytical, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to present complex and sensitive issues
• Technical skills in alternatives and regulation
• Good knowledge in European and local regulatory requirements
• Demonstrates Microsoft Office skills (with emphasis placed on Excel proficiency).
• Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and systems
• Ability to identify, escalate and resolve a problem.
• Ability to communicate professionally through effective verbal and written skills.
• Ability to manage time efficiently and effectively.
• Organizational skills and detail-oriented.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
• Ability to manage and inspire people

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn't meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development-so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice-creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often-pushing the boundaries of innovation.  As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

title: Research Facilitator (m/f)
description:
Research Facilitator

(Valid from 03/09/2026 to 18/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Research Support department

Job Number: UOL08436

Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Role Type: Open Position
Functions: Research support
Expertise: Research & Education Support
Job (internal): Research facilitator
Job Level: level 1

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The mission of the Research Support Department is to support the University's aim to pursuit research at the highest international standard, by working in partnership with its researchers to secure, manage and increase funding from external organisations globally, nationally and regionally. This Department communicates the University of Luxembourg's Research Strategy and Policy. The Research Support Department is responsible for providing an effective, efficient and proactive support structure to help and advice researchers on project acquisition, research execution, research management, result dissemination and exploitation. To that end, it gathers and distributes relevant information, proactively identifies sources of research funding, organises training, develops procedures and guidelines in line with the University of Luxembourg's research strategy, and develops and fosters relationships with funding agencies, other research organisations and potential sponsors.

Your role

As a Research Facilitator, you will join a collaborative team working closely with researchers and colleagues across the University. You will work within established processes and contribute to their continuous improvement to meet evolving funding, regulatory and institutional requirements.

Responsibilities:

• Support researchers in identifying national, European and international funding opportunities, e.g. FNR, Horizon Europe and other competitive funding schemes e.g. US funding, with a strong focus on quality control for national funding, e.g. FNR
• Provide a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle of research grants to provide guidance throughout the grant lifecycle, from proposal preparation to project implementation and reporting
• Produce guidelines, checklist for funding instruments and ensure regular updates and optimization of relevant communication channels and platforms
• Perform institutional validation, quality control and compliance reviews of funding applications, ensuring compliance with funders' and institutional requirements
• Contribute to the dissemination of funding opportunities, policies, procedures, and good practices within the research and research support community via relevant communication channels and platforms
• Support the optimization of digital service delivery for the performance of institutional validation, quality control, and compliance processes
• Support the organization of information sessions, workshops, training activities, and networking events
• Liaise with funding agencies, and relevant internal stakeholders and external stakeholders
• Support the institutional validation, monitoring and reporting of research projects and funding-related activities
• Maintain accurate records and contribute to the effective management of research information and data via various systems, e.g. Common Research Information System, Power BI Reports
• Contribute to the development, review and continuous improvement of processes, tools, and guidelines
• Work collaboratively with all central services, Research Facilitators across Faculties and Interdisciplinary Centres to share knowledge and promote best practices
• Contribute to the delivery of efficient, proactive, and service-oriented research facilitation services

Your profile

• Master's degree or equivalent experience
• Strong interest in research, research funding, grant management, process improvements, digital service delivery, and the higher education environment
• Service-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and meet deadlines
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively in a multicultural environment
• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team
• Ability to build constructive working relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
• Previous experience in research administration, project coordination, grant preparation and management, business process improvements , digital service delivery, and research funding would be considered an advantage
• Familiarity with research funding programmes such as FNR and Horizon Europe would be considered an asset
• Excellent command in English (C1) is required. Good working knowledge of French and/or German (B1) is considered an advantage

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply

Applications should include:

• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter

Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

title: Fund Operations Oversight Officer (m/f) (CDD until the end of January 2027)
description:
ING Solutions Investment Management (ISIM) is looking for a Fund Operation Oversight Officer to support the current and planned developments of its activities in Luxembourg.

Your working environment

ISIM is a subsidiary of ING Luxembourg. ISIM benefits from the status of a ?Super ManCo? as it has the licenses to manage both UCITS and Alternative Investment Fund (AIF).ISIM oversees Investment funds distributed by ING Group entities.Launched in 2014, ISIM is pursuing its development and its positioning as the Management Company (?ManCo?) of ING Group and is the key tool for Investment fund solutions within the Group.ISIM is looking for a Fund Operation Oversight Officer to reinforce its team.

As a Fund Operation Oversight Officer, you will oversee the activities of the Central Administrations and Depositary Banks of investment funds managed by ISIM. More specifically, you will perform the following controls:

Oversight and controls of delegated functions (Fund Administration, Depositary Bank)

• Perform initial and periodic due diligence on the delegates
• Review and analyse the Key Performance Indicators & Key Risk Indicators of the funds (monthly review/exceptions reports from delegates)
• Review and follow up the cash and asset reconciliations
• Oversee the coordination of the fund corporate life cycle (general meetings of shareholders, board circular resolutions, etc)
• Coordinate the funds? dividend payments
• Ensure that fund tax documentation is in place and accurate
• Coordinate and prepare the recurrent meetings with delegates and draft respective minutes
• Ensure day-to day monitoring of delegates and follow-up of incidents
• Work in close cooperation with Portfolio, Finance, Risk, Compliance and Legal

Financial Statements and other fund reporting

• Coordinate the entire funds? audit process with Central Administration and auditors
• Check the Financial Statements
• Review/coordinate all other fund reporting

Board reporting and meeting

• Organise the funds? board meetings
• Ensure the preparation of the board packs in collaboration with the various counterparties (Central Administration, Depositary Bank, auditors, Investment Manager)

Given the size of the team, the Fund Operation Oversight Officer will also have to ensure support/backup with regard to administrative tasks of the ManCo whenever needed.

Our offer

This position is a great opportunity to:

• Develop and benefit from training on-the-job thanks to an expert team
• Join the Management Company of one of the leading banks in Luxembourg within an international environment
• Have a contributing role in the development of the structure, allowing for a spirit of initiative
• Work in a convivial and dynamic environment of a human-size company but integrated within a large group
• Benefit from a wide range of tasks and some autonomy, including multiple contacts with internal and external representatives

Your profile

Knowledge and experience

• Master in economics / finance or equivalent
• Relevant experience in the fund industry (e.g. in relation with Fund Administration, Depositary Bank or audit of funds)

Skills

Knowledge of:

• regulatory requirements and fund organization applicable to both UCITS and AIF;
• fund accounting mechanisms and NAV calculation
• financial markets and products
• Excel proficiency and comfortable with numbers
• Flexible and eager to learn
• Rigorous and critical scepticism
• Sense of responsibility and autonomy
• Team player with good communication skills (both oral and written)
• Fluent in French and English is a must have.

Your work environment

ING is a global financial institution with a strong European footprint. The Group provides retail and wholesale banking services to approximately 41 million customers worldwide. With more than 60,000 employees, ING operates through an international network and offers a broad range of banking and financial services across numerous markets.In Luxembourg, ING serves private, professional and institutional clients through dedicated teams of banking specialists, benefiting from both local expertise and the resources of an international banking group.

A proven track record in a sales position
A strong network of private customers and financial intermediaries in France
An excellent knowledge of the products and services that Luxembourgish private customers and financial intermediaries based in Luxembourg could require (life insurance, wealth planning solutions, loan financing ..)

title: Project Manager (m/f)
description:
Your mission

As a Project Manager, you will lead selected cross-functional projects from initiation through to successful delivery.

Working closely with teams across R&D, Production, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, IT and other key functions, you will ensure that projects are delivered in line with their technical, quality, cost and timing objectives.

Your role will be to provide structure, coordination and leadership throughout the project lifecycle while anticipating risks, solving complex issues and ensuring effective communication between all stakeholders.


Your key responsibilities

Project planning and organization

You will be responsible for structuring and organizing projects to ensure clear objectives and efficient execution:

    Set up and maintain project structures, including project timelines, team organization, budgets and resource planning

    Develop detailed project plans covering milestones, work plans, critical paths, risk management, cost and benefit analysis, staffing requirements and budgets

    Define, agree on and cascade project objectives to all relevant stakeholders

    Lead and coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure that everyone works towards common objectives

    Organize project meetings and key review sessions, including technical reviews and launch readiness reviews

    Assign and coordinate the activities required from the different functions involved in the project

    Monitor project progress and follow up on the completion of actions to ensure the project is delivered on time


Project coordination and prioritization

In a dynamic environment where multiple requests and priorities may arise simultaneously, you will play a key role in ensuring that project resources are focused on the right activities:

    Analyze, filter and prioritize incoming requests based on project priorities, business needs and available resources

    Ensure that the prioritization of customer requests is aligned and agreed upon with the Sales team

    Manage competing priorities and support teams in maintaining focus on the most critical activities

    Coordinate the different departments involved in the project, including Manufacturing, Purchasing, Engineering, Quality, Finance, IT and Sales

    Ensure alignment between project requirements, operational capabilities and available resources


Project performance and risk management

You will actively monitor project performance and identify potential risks before they impact project delivery:

    Systematically identify, assess and manage technical, financial, operational and project-related risks

    Develop and coordinate appropriate mitigation and corrective action plans

    Monitor project performance against customer and internal targets

    Ensure compliance with technical specifications, quality requirements, development budgets, cost objectives and project milestones

    Manage project cost calculations in collaboration with Purchasing, Production and Controlling

    Monitor project profitability and contribute to the achievement of internal financial objectives

    Identify and resolve issues and conflicts within the project team whenever possible

    Escalate critical issues to management when they cannot be resolved within the project team

    Make informed decisions based on technical, financial, quality and timing considerations


Customer and supplier coordination

You will contribute to ensuring efficient coordination with external stakeholders while working closely with the relevant internal teams:

    Support customer communication regarding project timing, project status, changes and key milestones

    Coordinate customer-related actions in close collaboration with the Sales department

    Help ensure that customer expectations and requirements are clearly communicated internally

    Support the preparation of customer communications using the appropriate language and format

    Coordinate supplier-related activities and support communication with suppliers in collaboration with the Purchasing department

    Follow up on supplier-related actions that may impact project timing, cost, quality or technical requirements

    Communicate project objectives, priorities and progress to the project team and management

    Prepare and contribute to project reviews, progress reports and management updates

    Ensure that project documentation is complete, accurate and regularly updated

    Maintain project plans, action lists, risk assessments, meeting minutes and other key project records

    Record and distribute meeting minutes and ensure appropriate follow-up of agreed actions

    Use and maintain project management databases and centralized information systems to ensure reliable and consistent information

    Encourage the use of common project management tools and processes to maintain a single and reliable source of information

    Provide timely feedback on project team performance to the relevant functional managers when appropriate



Your profile

Education and technical background

    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical or Electromechanical Engineering, or an equivalent technical field

    A Master's degree would be considered an advantage

    Strong ability to understand, analyze and absorb technical information

    Knowledge of beverage systems would be a strong advantage

    Knowledge of valves and pressure regulators would also be highly appreciated


Professional experience

    At least 5 years of experience in project or program management

    Previous experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment

    Experience in sectors such as Medical, Automotive or Food & Beverage would be considered an advantage

    Proven experience managing complex and cross-functional projects

    Solid understanding of project management methodologies, tools and techniques

Technical and project management skills

    Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling and resource management

    Experience with risk management and problem-solving methodologies

    Ability to monitor project budgets, costs and profitability

    Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and MS Project

    Knowledge of financial management would be an advantage


Languages

    Fluent in English, both written and spoken

    French and/or German would be considered strong assets


Your professional strengths

    Excellent organizational and prioritization skills

title: Consultant Senior - Accountant  (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:
The Senior accountant will have the following responsibilities:

-Take ownership of selected legal entities, balance-sheet areas or accounting workstreams.
-Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments and account reconciliations.
-Ensure transactions are recorded accurately, completely and in the appropriate accounting period.
-Investigate unexpected movements and resolve accounting discrepancies.
-Prepare variance analyses and explanations of material balance movements.
-Support and improve monthly, quarterly and annual closing activities.
-Coordinate with Accounts Payable, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Group Accounting and local accounting providers.
-Analyse and account for complex, unusual or previously unresolved transactions.
-Prepare accounting position papers or technical memoranda when required.
-Support intercompany accounting, reconciliations and mismatch resolution.
-Investigate cash, bank-fee, foreign-exchange and transaction-flow discrepancies.
-Review historical balances and identify unsupported, unreconciled, duplicated or incorrectly classified items.
-Reconcile and remediate accounting data in SAP.
-Establish reliable opening balances and clear audit trails.
-Correct recurring posting, mapping and master-data issues.
-Help reinforce SAP as the primary accounting source of truth.
-Reconcile differences between the client's records and those maintained by local accounting providers.
-Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting evidence and accounting explanations.
-Respond directly and independently to external-auditor requests.
-Support statutory audits for European legal entities.
-Prepare or contribute to balance-sheet substantiation, going-concern assessments and other accounting papers.
-Maintain organised, complete and review-ready documentation.
-Document accounting procedures and month-end activities.
-Create or improve standard operating procedures, checklists and control evidence.
-Perform root-cause analysis of recurring accounting issues.
-Recommend and implement sustainable process improvements.
-Contribute to the development of the accounting control matrix.
-Use SAP and Excel for accounting operations, reconciliations and data analysis.
-Work effectively with large datasets and incomplete or imperfect source information.
-Identify accounting activities that can be standardised, simplified or automated.
-Use tools such as Power Query, SQL, automation platforms or AI where they provide a practical benefit.
-Document material automated processes so that they can be understood and maintained by the team.
-Reduce recurring errors, unnecessary manual work and operational dependencies.

Contraintes:
Extrait de casier judiciaire exigé

Études:
Niveau d'étude demandé egal Master (Bac+5)
Métier / domaine de formation:
Have at least 7 years of relevant financial accounting experience.
Demonstrate strong hands-on experience with month-end closing.
Demonstrate strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA (FI required; MM is a plus)
Have experience independently managing legal entities, material balance-sheet areas or accounting workstreams.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of accrual accounting, cut-off, reconciliations, intercompany accounting and financial controls.
Have experience investigating and resolving complex or historical accounting issues.
Have experience supporting statutory, group or external audits.
Demonstrate advanced Excel skills.
Operate effectively in multi-entity, multi-currency and complex environments.
Have experience managing local accounting and tax service providers.
Have knowledge of IFRS and European local statutory accounting frameworks.
Prepare technical accounting papers and audit documentation.
Work effectively with large datasets and incomplete information.

Autres compétences:
Be able to work independently in a fast-moving and changing environment.
Collaborate effectively with stakeholders located across Europe.
Experience in FinTech, payments, banking, financial services or another regulated industry is considered an advantage.
Experience in accounting remediation following an ERP implementation is considered an advantage.
A recognised accounting qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CPA, CIMA or an equivalent qualification is considered an advantage.
License or Master qualification in accounting, finance or equivalent
English speaking are mandatory, additional language is considered as an advantage

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet's banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

The main objective of this position is to perform in-depth analysis and checks on all types of investments in funds managed by FundPartner Solutions (FPS). The Valuer will play a key role in establishing and verifying valuation procedures, with a particular focus on Hedge Funds and Private Assets. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical skills, rigor, and a collaborative team spirit to analyze Audited Financial Statements and ensure the highest standards of accuracy and compliance.

• Audited Financial Statement Analysis: Analyze Audited Financial Statements of Hedge Funds and Private Assets to ensure accurate valuation and compliance with internal and regulatory standards.
• Drafting and Review: Experience in drafting or working on Audited Financial Statements is considered a strong asset.
• Audit and Client Requests: Respond to audit requests and client inquiries, providing detailed financial information or valuation methodologies to ensure compliance and client satisfaction.
• Risk Reporting Management: Manage risk reporting and conduct risk analysis through audited financial statements to identify areas of improvement or potential risks.
• Valuation Activities Reporting: Measure and report on valuation activities, ensuring excellent client service by providing accurate and timely reports.
• Back Testing Reporting: Present back testing reports to Conducting Officers or Boards as required, demonstrating the ability to clearly communicate findings and recommendations.

Your profile

• Master's degree in Economics or Finance
• Fluent in french and english
• 3 to 5 years experience in valuation, pricing, or corporate action, with a strong focus on analyzing Audited Financial Statements of Hedge Funds and Private Assets.

Experience in drafting or working on Audited Financial Statements is a plus.

Experience in the audit of alternative funds (Hedge Funds or Private Assets) is also considered a strong asset.

• Excellent knowledge of financial products and their valuation.
• Broad knowledge of funds regulation and fund administration.
• Experience with data vendors such as Bloomberg, Markit, ICE, Reuters.
• Proficient use of data and communication tools (e.g. MS Office suite, Business Object, Tableau, etc).
• Experience in the audit of alternative funds (Hedge Funds or Private Assets) is a plus.
• Experience with online collaboration tools and digital reporting platforms is an asset.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
• High level of rigor and organizational skills.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities.
• Strong team spirit and ability to collaborate effectively.
• Ability to present complex information clearly to senior management, Conducting Officers, or Boards, including back testing reports.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

What if it was you?

The PwC Actuarial and Risk Modelling Services (ARMS) team in Luxembourg is looking for a senior associate to join our local actuarial practice of over 20 actuaries and risk modellers. This is one of the largest actuarial consulting teams in Luxembourg. As part of our dynamic and diverse team, you will work on complex problems and challenges related to reserving, pricing, risk or capital related projects across the Luxembourg and broader European markets, as well as multidisciplinary projects in areas such as     reinsurance optimisation and business transactions.
  
Be a part of our team where you will:

• Provide actuarial consulting services.
• Perform reserving analysis and valuation with a strong focus on business drivers, ensuring reserve adequacy aligns with regulatory requirements and translate technical insights into actionable recommendations for management and stakeholders.
• Support/lead Solvency II reviews for insurers, including Solvency II balance sheets, QRTs and ORSAs.
• Support insurance regulation-related projects in insurance, such as local regulation, IFRS 17 accounting, transfer pricing, POG/VFM, etc.
• Work closely with audit teams to provide actuarial support to our audit practice with regard to Luxembourg-based insurers and reinsurers.
• Support the Corporate Finance, M&A and Strategy teams by providing expert support for business transactions, portfolio transfers, actuarial due diligence projects and reserves/provision certifications.
• Assist in the continued growth and development of PwC's actuarial practice.
• Supervise and coach junior actuarial staff.
  
Let's talk about you. We expect that …

• You have a university degree with a specialization in actuarial science, mathematics, or quantitative finance;
• You have at least 2 years of working experience as an actuary;
• You demonstrate solid understanding of standard life and/or non-life actuarial practices under Solvency II, complemented by expertise in one or more related areas such as Luxembourg GAAP, IFRS 17 reporting, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
• You enjoy working in a practical and creative manner, constantly analysing and solving new challenges.  
• You have good command of the English language. Fluency in French is considered an advantage.
• You enjoy working in a team. You want to develop, build relationships and bring out the best in yourself and your colleagues.
• You have the experience with specialised software in one of areas such as pricing, reserving, capital management (for example, URS, ResQ, Prophet or other recognised).
  
…so that you are the candidate we are looking for!

At PwC, we believe diversity is the representation of all the characteristics that make us both alike and unique. description:

Arendt Investor Services (AIS) is the investor services arm of Arendt. We help clients efficiently run the operational side of their business, bringing peace of mind to investors.
Equipped with the latest technology, our 300 experts provide clients with an integrated suite of fund and corporate services, delivered to the highest market standards.
Our services complement Arendt's legal expertise and regulatory & consulting services. We are a Professional of the Financial Sector (PFS), supervised by the CSSF and ISO 22301 certified.


The experts at AIS and AManco provide clients with:

• Corporate Services
• Fund Administration Services
• Governance Services
• Operational AML & Compliance Services
• Tax Compliance Services
• Depositary Services
• Third Party AIFM Services (provided by AManco S.A.)


Given the ongoing development of AIS, we are currently recruiting:


Senior Manager – Compliance, Regulatory & Data Protection

As Compliance & Regulatory Senior Manager, you will play a key role in overseeing and strengthening the firm's compliance framework within a regulated Luxembourg environment (PSFs).
You will act as a trusted advisor to senior management and, subject to confirmation, take on the role of Data Protection Officer (DPO).
This is a high-visibility position involving direct interactions with CNPD and senior governance bodies.


Your role:

• Oversee the Compliance Monitoring Plan (CMP).
• Lead the Compliance and AML/CFT risk assessment process.
• Track all regulatory correspondence.
• Perform ongoing regulatory watch and assess the impact of new regulations (e.g. AMLR, CSSF Circular 22/806).
• Oversee the outsourcing and delegation compliance framework.
• Act as the primary point of contact with the CNPD.
• Participate in the New Product Approval Process.
• Ensure compliance with GDPR.
• Prepare regular reporting to the Board and Management Committee.


Your profile:

• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Compliance, Regulatory or Legal.
• Solid experience within the Luxembourg financial sector (PSF, AIFM, ManCo or Banks).
• Hands-on experience interacting with the CNPD.
• Master's degree in Law.
• Strong knowledge of the Luxembourg regulatory framework (CSSF), AML/CFT law and regulation, GDPR and Data Protection.
• Fluent in English (mandatory) and a very good command of French.

title: Job på Malta - Vil du arbejde med administrativ kundeservice med Igaming? - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

description:
Are you passionate about gaming, customer service, and cutting-edge VR technology? We are looking for an energetic and reliable Arcade & VR Gaming Centre Operator to join our team! Be at the Center of Entertainment: You get to work in a vibrant, fast-paced environment where creating fun and memorable experiences for guests is the daily goal.
Hands-on Technology: You will gain experience operating and troubleshooting modern VR systems alongside arcade machinery.  
Dynamic Work Atmosphere: Every shift brings a variety of tasks from welcoming guests and running point of sale operations (kassa) to hosting VR sessions and guiding players.

Long-Term Growth: Start with flexible hours (24 to 40 hours per week) with the genuine potential to convert into a permanent contract as the company grows.

As a Reclaim & Screen Preparation Operator, you are a crucial and versatile link in our production process. title: Financial Controller A
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor de gemeente Sittard-Geleen een Financial Controller A

“Wij werken samen voor Sittard-Geleen” is de organisatievisie van gemeente Sittard-Geleen. Een van de actiepunten uit deze visie is de P&C-producten dienstbaar en meer van toegevoegde waarde te laten zijn voor zowel de gemeenteraad, het college van burgemeester en wethouders, en voor de organisatie. Het team Financiën voorziet in een betrouwbare (financiële) informatievoorziening en vertaalt deze in uitvoeringstaken van de P&C-cyclus. Als Financial Controller A ben je primair verantwoordelijk voor de betrouwbaarheid (tijdig, juist, volledig en controleerbaar) van de financiële gegevens. Als Financial Controller A vorm je samen met de andere P&C-medewerkers de basis voor de totstandkoming van P&C-producten. Daarnaast fungeer je als sparringpartner voor de collega’s binnen het team, ondersteun je de teamcontrollers en adviseer je collega’s uit de lijn.

De volgende werkzaamheden behoren onder andere tot je takenpakket:

  • Ondersteunen met betrekking tot de inrichting van de Planning & Control cyclus, de verbetering van de bedrijfsvoering en efficiency- en de effectiviteitsverbeteringen binnen het domein respectievelijk de diverse teams. Dit alles met jouw specialisme op het gebied van financiën
  • Het opstellen van financiële overzichten en deze uitwerken ten behoeve van de project- en/of teamcontroller en de betreffende budgethouders
  • Het signaleren van eventuele knelpunten inclusief het formuleren van een advies bij de project- en/of teamcontroller en de betreffende budgethouders
  • Het opstellen van memoriaalboekingen en begrotingswijzigingen, in overleg met de project- en/of teamcontroller
  • Ondersteunen teams bij het opstellen van de planning & control documenten en het verzorgen van de afstemming met de project- en/of teamcontroller
  • Fungeren als vraagbaak voor projectmanagers, projectleiders en productbeheerders voor dagelijkse en cyclische planning & control vraagstukken.

De werkzaamheden bestaan daarnaast in specifieke zin onder meer uit:

    • Definiëren en verankeren van Interne Beheersmaatregelen binnen (nieuwe financiële) processen
    • Definiëren van financiële managementinformatie voor de verschillende teams
    • Financiële managementinformatie bouwen / beheren binnen (te ontwikkelen) processen/ procesinrichting
    • Gevraagd en ongevraagd geven van financieel advies
    • Waarnemen van collega-adviseurs indien nodig.

Wie ben je?

Je bent een doortastende collega met oog voor kansen en een kritische kijk naar de toekomst: Doen we de juiste dingen en doen we de dingen goed? Daarnaast ben je analytisch sterk en je analyses monden uit in een helder financieel advies. Evenwicht, flexibiliteit en stressbestendigheid maken jou tot een solide teamplayer. Als Financial Controller A heb je een positieve grondhouding met een kritisch blik.

Leidend bij jouw adviezen is de operationele uitvoerbaarheid en het aanbieden van alternatieven. Vanzelfsprekend aangevuld met passende beheersmaatregelen.

Waar ben je goed in?

  • Je beschikt over een HBO werk- en denkniveau
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met vakgebied Planning & Control
  • Je bent proactief en kunt zelfstandig, planmatig en projectmatig werken
  • Je kunt aanstekelijk communiceren over jouw vakgebied als financieel deskundige
  • Gedegen kennis van Excel is een absolute must
  • Ervaring binnen een gemeentelijke werkomgeving is geen vereiste
  • Je hebt het vermogen om snel te schakelen tussen de verschillende projecten en teams die wij in de organisatie bedienen.

title: Product management assistant
description:
Als Product Management Assistant ondersteun je dagelijks het internationale Product Management team bij het beheren en de opvolging van producten. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het invoeren en up-to-date houden van productgegevens zodat deze correct en volledig beschikbaar zijn in onze interne systemen, op onze website en externe systemen. Je werkt nauw samen met interne teams (Product Management, Master Data, Marketing) en met onze leveranciers.

  • Werken met software zoals Beeyond en onze website back-end voor databeheer.

  • Eerste ervaring in een administratieve, ondersteunende of productdata-gerelateerde rol is een pré.
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels (zowel mondeling als schriftelijk). Kennis van Frans en/of Spaans is een pré.

Het werken met diverse geo- en gemeentelijke softwaresystemen.

Garderobemekka søker en positiv og engasjert salgskonsulent til vår butikk på i Drammen. Hos oss får du en variert arbeidshverdag med salg, kundekontakt og skreddersydde garderobeløsninger.

Garderobemekka tilbyr måltilpassede skyvedørsgarderober med stilfullt design og god kvalitet. Vi hjelper både privat- og bedriftskunder med å finne funksjonelle og flotte løsninger tilpasset deres ønsker, behov og rom. Som salgskonsulent følger du kunden fra første kontakt til ferdig løsning. Du vil samarbeide tett med både forretning og utvikling, og ha en viktig rolle i å sikre kvalitet, skalerbarhet og gjenbruk av våre løsninger. Vår portefølje spenner fra hyllevare til egenutviklede systemer, primært basert på Microsoft-teknologi.

Stillingen er plassert i IT-avdelingen, seksjon for systemutvikling. 


Arbeidsoppgaver

Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil bl.a. være å

  • Designe og videreutvikle direktoratets løsninger i tett samarbeid med forretning og tekniske team
  • Være en premissgiver og ansvarlig for etterlevelse av arkitekturprinsipper, arkitekturmønstre, teknologiutvikling, god praksis og styrende rammer
  • Ha ansvar for god arkitekturstyring, se helhet og bidra til innebygd kvalitet i alle ledd
  • Kommunisere og forankre arkitekturen på en tydelig og inspirerende måte
  • Gi teknisk rådgivning i prosjekter og bidra til å styrke vår arkitekturkompetanse      

Andre arbeidsoppgaver vil kunne bli tillagt stillingen

Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha:

  • Høyere relevant utdanning (minst bachelor). Lang og relevant erfaring kan kompensere for utdanningskravet
  • Relevant erfaring som teknisk arkitekt (løsningsarkitekt, system- eller integrasjonsarkitekt) i komplekse systemlandskap
  • God forretnings- og prosessforståelse
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig

Det er en fordel om du også har:

  • Erfaring med integrasjonsarkitektur og moderne integrasjonsmønstre
  • God kjennskap til relevante arkitekturprinsipper og rammeverk
  • God kjennskap til Microsoft-plattformen, herunder Azure og sentrale tjenester
  • Erfaring med analyse, kravspesifisering og endringshåndtering
  • Relevant erfaring fra større virksomheter og/eller offentlig sektor
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har høy faglig integritet og ønsker å være en faglig drivkraft
  • Evner å balansere strategi og detaljer, og kan navigere både i det tekniske og det forretningsmessige
  • Trives i samspill med andre og bygger tillit gjennom samarbeid
  • Har en praktisk tilnærming og får ting til å skje
  • Er nytenkende, løsningsorientert og opptatt av å skape verdi for brukerne

Dette inkluderer muligheten for delvis hjemmekontor, fleksitid med avspasering, betalt lunsj, sommertid, fem ukers ferie og betaling for overtid og reisetid utenom ordinær arbeidstid.
  • Det vil også bli lagt til rette for fysisk aktivitet med inntil to timer betalt trening i uken, eget treningsrom og gruppetimer i lokalene våre på Storo. Dette er i tillegg til sykkelparkering, garderobe og dusj. Videre er faglig utvikling en viktig del av arbeidshverdagen hos oss, og du får tilgang til kompetansefond, kurs, konferanser, ukentlige faglunsjer, samt fredagsseminarer.
  • Ikke nok med det, men som ansatt blir du medlem av Statens pensjonskasse, som tilbyr gode ordninger for pensjon, boliglån, forsikring og andre medlemsfordeler. Det vil dermed bli trukket to prosent av lønnen til pensjonsinnskudd, og vi betaler i tillegg arbeidsgiverpremien. Mer om dette kan du lese her: https://www.spk.no/alderspensjon/fodt-i-1963-eller-etter/slik-tjener-du-opp-til-alderspensjon/)
  • Denne stillingen som seniorrådgiver (stillingskode 1364), har en årslønn fra 850 000 til 1 050 000 kroner, avhengig av hvilke erfaring og kvalifikasjoner du har. 


Verd å merke seg før du søker
Vi er mest interessert i din kompetanse, erfaring og hva du kan bidra med – ikke hvor god du er til å skrive en søknad. Derfor har vi laget noen konkrete spørsmål som vi ber deg svare på når du søker. Svarene dine, sammen med din CV, vil danne grunnlaget for vår vurdering av kandidater til intervju. Husk å legge ved relevante vitnemål, karakterutskrifter og attester.

Omvendt referansesjekk
Du skal føle deg helt trygg når du takker ja til jobb hos oss, og vi tilbyr deg derfor omvendt referansesjekk. Hvis du er aktuell for stillingen, vil du få mulighet til å ringe noen av våre medarbeidere og stille dem akkurat de spørsmål du måtte ha.

Dette gir deg mulighet for å få positiv særbehandling dersom du er kvalifisert for stillingen.

description:

Vi er nå i en fase hvor avdelingen formes, med fokus på å skape et godt miljø både for våre beboere og ansatte. Det er viktig for oss at beboerne våre opplever mestring og god livskvalitet. 

Vi holder til i nærheten av Solbråtan, med kort vei til offentlig transport. 

Vi kan tilby en variert arbeidshverdag med utfordringer hvor du vil oppleve mestring, og en avdeling med fokus på arbeidsmiljøet. Vi er en avdeling som tar i bruk ny helseteknologi.

Vi søker etter deg som har evne og vilje til samarbeid og fleksibilitet. Det er viktig at du bidrar til gode holdninger i arbeidsmiljøet. Du er også ansvarsbevisst og liker å jobbe med mennesker.

  • utviklende og spennende arbeidsoppgaver

Nordre Follo er landets 14. største kommune, med over 65 000 innbyggere og over 5 500 ansatte. Vi er et samfunn i vekst og utvikling med store investeringer i nye boliger, infrastruktur og næringsliv. Med visjonen «nær og nyskapende» skal vi være en god kommune å bo og jobbe i både nå og i fremtiden.

Hos oss kan du velge om du vil bo landlig, bynært eller urbant. Natur og friluftsliv er uansett aldri langt unna. Vi er nærmeste nabo til hovedstaden, og med toget er det bare 12 minutters reisevei fra Oslo fra både Kolbotn og Ski.

title: Elkjøp Arendal søker Selger (deltid)
description:
Bli med og skap resultater hos Elkjøp Arendal

Vi søker:

  • 3 selgere 
  • Stillingsprosent: 10 

Stillingene passer perfekt for deg som studerer eller har en annen deltidsjobb.

Hos Elkjøp handler alt vi gjør om å finne de beste løsningene for kundene våre.

Vi ser etter deg som drives av å skape resultater og som motiveres av å levere kvalitet i alt du gjør. Enten du hjelper en kunde med å finne riktig produkt, eller sørger for at lageret fungerer sømløst, er målet det samme: 
å levere den beste kundeopplevelsen og de beste resultatene.

Hva du vil gjøre:
  • Bidra til at kundene våre får løsninger som dekker deres behov.
  • Sørge for orden, struktur og effektiv drift i din avdeling.
  • Jobbe målrettet for å nå både individuelle og felles mål.
  • Samarbeide tett med kollegaer for å løfte hverandre og skape suksess sammen.
Hva vi tilbyr:
  • Faglig utvikling gjennom opplæring, kurs og trening, slik at du kan vokse og prestere på ditt beste.
  • Et inkluderende og energisk arbeidsmiljø hvor vi spiller hverandre gode.
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn, bonusordninger og gode personalrabatter.
  • Verdifull erfaring fra en av Nordens ledende retail-aktører.
Hvem vi ser etter:

Du er en person som:

  • Er løsningsorientert og trigges av å finne smarte måter å nå mål på.
  • Har pågangsmot, er strukturert og tar ansvar.
  • Er nysgjerrig, engasjert og har god formidlingsevne.
  • Trives med å jobbe i team og bidra til fellesskapet.
  • Er over 18 år og har interesse for teknologi og elektronikk.
Hvorfor Elkjøp?

Hos oss får du ikke bare en jobb, du får en mulighet til å utvikle deg, bidra til noe større og være en del av et lag som alltid jakter på bedre løsninger og sterkere resultater.

Interessert?

Send inn din CV via søknadsknappen. Kun elektroniske søknader via søknadsportalen vil bli vurdert.

Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og avslutter prosessen når vi har funnet de rette kandidatene.


Hos oss er det gøy å være på jobb! Det er utfordrende og fartsfylt, og som ansatt hos oss er du en del av Norges største elektronikkaktør. Vi tror på å gi muligheter til våre ansatte, og med stor innsats og pågangsmot kan du nå langt hos oss. Vi setter stor pris på verdien av mangfold, og mener at vi utnytter våre styrker best når vi er forskjellige sammen. Derfor ønsker vi alle velkommen på laget. Vi er også dedikerte til bærekraft og jobber kontinuerlig for en grønnere fremtid – både for våre kunder og for planeten. Hos oss tilbyr vi konkurransedyktige betingelser og muligheter for karriereutvikling i et spennende og dynamisk arbeidsmiljø. Vi ønsker å informere deg om at din søknad og CV vil bli skannet av AI-teknologi. Vær oppmerksom på at AI ikke tar noen beslutninger – det er det mennesker som gjør. AI skanner CV og annen dokumentasjon som ligger i søknaden og vurderer egnethet opp mot annonseteksten. Dette er kun et ekstra hjelpemiddel for at våre rekrutterere skal kunne ta en enda mer informert beslutning. Er du interessert i å bli en del av Elkjøp-teamet? Send oss din søknad i dag! Vi gjør oppmerksom på at vi bruker evne- og personlighetstester i rekrutteringsprosessen. Vil du vite mer om oss? Klikk her: https://www.elkjop.no/om-elkjop

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hos Elkjøp vil du jobbe i en dynamisk og spennende arbeidskultur som gir deg muligheten til å jobbe med de nyeste og mest innovative teknologiene. Vi er stolte av å fremme mangfold i alle ledd og skape en inkluderende arbeidsplass der ulikheter verdsettes. Elkjøp er også dedikert til bærekraft og jobber aktivt for en grønnere fremtid. Vi investerer i våre ansatte, tilbyr gode karrieremuligheter og utviklingsprogrammer, og hjelper deg med å nå ditt fulle potensiale, samtidig som vi sammen bygger en mer bærekraftig verden. Vi selger ikke bare teknologi – vi løser kundenes hverdagsproblemer. I en verden som stadig forandrer seg, må vi hele tiden finne nye løsninger.

title: Forskingssjukepleiar
description:
Helse Førde søkjer forskingssykepleiar til det regionale forskingsprosjektet NorPEPS II (The Norwegian Prednisolone in Early Psychosis Study II).

NorPEPS II er eit samarbeid mellom Helse Bergen, Helse Førde og Helse Stavanger. Prosjektet skal undersøkje om prednisolon som tillegg til standard behandling kan bidra til raskare betring ved akutt psykose hos personar med schizofreni.

Studien byggjer på lovande resultat frå ein tidlegare pilotstudie og har potensial til å gi ny kunnskap som kan bidra til å utvikle behandlingstilbodet til pasientar med  psykose.

Stillinga er knytt til inkludering og oppfølging av studiedeltakarar ved Helse Førde, i tett samarbeid med forskarar og klinikarar ved dei deltakande helseføretaka.

Stillingsprosent: 50 % prosjektstilling i 36 månader (med atterhald om endeleg finansiering).
Arbeidsstad:       Helse Førde
Oppstart:             Snarast


Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Rekruttering og inkludering av studiedeltakarar
  • Koordinering av studieforløp og avtalar
  • Gjennomføring av studievisittar og oppfølging av deltakarar
  • Innsamling, registrering og kvalitetssikring av forskingsdata
  • Prøvetaking og handtering av biologisk materiale
  • Oppfølging av studieprotokoll og dokumentasjon i tråd med Good Clinical Practice (GCP)
  • Samarbeid med prosjektleiarar, behandlarar og andre forskingsmedarbeidarar

Vi tilbyr

  • Deltaking i eit regionalt og tverrfagleg forskingssamarbeid
  • Nært samarbeid med leiande fagmiljø innan psykoseforsking
  • Moglegheit til å bidra til utvikling av framtidas behandlingstilbod innan psykisk helsevern
  • Fagleg utvikling og opplæring innan klinisk forsking og GCP

Vi oppfordrar alle søkjarar til å nytte Vitnemålsportalen for å laste opp verifiserte vitnemål og karakterutskrifter, der det er mogleg. Har du utdanning frå utlandet, legg ved godkjenning frå Direktoratet for høgare utdanning og kompetanse.

Helse Førde HF har ansvar for spesialisthelsetenestene i Sogn og Fjordane. Føretaket arbeider for å gje pasientar og brukarar eit godt og heilskapeleg tilbod innanfor gjeldande rammer.
