title: Logistikmedarbetare till Saab Dynamics i Linköping
description:
Om företaget Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som logistikmedarbetare blir du en viktig del av Saabs verksamhet och ansvarar tillsammans med ditt team för att säkerställa effektiva materialflöden och en välfungerande lagerverksamhet.

Arbetet är varierande och innefattar bland annat:

    

Ankomstregistrering och godsmottagning

    

Truckkörning

    

Materialplock och lagerläggning

    

Inventering och lagerhantering

    

Dokumentation i affärssystem

Här blir du en del av ett engagerat team med god gemenskap och en kultur där man hjälper varandra. Rollen erbjuder en varierad vardag där du arbetar med både praktiska och administrativa uppgifter inom logistikflödet. Utöver traditionell lagerhantering innehåller arbetet även systemarbete och problemlösning, vilket ger dig en bred förståelse för verksamheten. Genom introduktion och upplärning i både lagerstruktur och affärssystem får du goda möjligheter att utvecklas och bygga värdefull kompetens inom logistikområdet.

Tjänsten är förlagd på dagtid.

Din profil

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är en person som uppskattar samarbete och bidrar med en positiv inställning i gruppen. Du är lyhörd, hjälpsam och har ett naturligt servicetänk i ditt arbete.

Vi ser också att du:

    

Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten

    

Tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter

    

Är flexibel och trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter

    

Har lätt för att samarbeta med andra

För tjänsten ser vi gärna att du har erfarenhet från lager, logistik eller materialhantering, men vi välkomnar även dig som är i början av din karriär eller vill byta bana och har rätt inställning samt vilja att lära.

Krav för tjänsten:

    

Truckkort A+B

    

Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

    

Datorvana

Meriterande:

    

B-körkort

    

Erfarenhet i IFS eller andra lagerhanteringssystem

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Ansökningsförfarande Detta är initialt ett konsultuppdrag via Skill med chans till direkt anställning hos kund efter en tids inhyrning. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vid frågor angående tjänsten vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Daniella Nygren på daniella.nygren@skill.se

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: R&D Manager  - Surgical Tables
description:
Take the lead in shaping the future of surgical tables, combining hands-on product development with leadership of a skilled R&D team to deliver innovative solutions for operating rooms worldwide. Ready to make an impact? Join us.

Stille AB is a Swedish medical device company with a long heritage in precision-engineered surgical instruments and operating tables, sold globally through leading distribution partners including GE HealthCare, Ziehm, Philips and Siemens Healthineers. Our Surgical Tables business unit designs and manufactures advanced OR and hybrid imaging tables — including the imagiQ3 platform with True Free Float® technology and the Medstone range — used in hospitals and imaging suites worldwide. Stille’s vision is to empower surgical excellence through products that enable the highest standards of care, fulfilling our promise: “Surgical Perfection. For Life.”

The Role

We are looking for an R&D Manager to lead the product life cycle management of our existing portfolio as well as the development of our next generation of surgical table platforms This is a hands-on role at the intersection of electromechanical engineering, project management and product cost strategy — owning both the technical integrity of our electromechanical systems and the on-time, on-budget delivery of development programs, from concept through design transfer and regulatory submission.

You will lead a small R&D team while also being part of it yourself, with your own deliverables: balancing clinical performance, regulatory compliance, manufacturability and total cost of ownership.

Key Responsibilities

    Lead a small R&D team with senior employees, setting technical direction across electrical, electromechanical, mechanical and software workstreams for surgical table platforms.
    Own project management of development programs: scope, timeline, budget, risk and stage-gate governance
    Drive electrical and electromechanical architecture decisions for motion control, power systems, control electronics and human-machine interfaces used in imagiQ3, Medstone and future platforms.
    Ensure development activity meets medical device regulatory and quality requirements, including IEC 60601-1/-2-46, ISO 13485, ISO 14971 (risk management), EU MDR and FDA design control requirements.
    Champion design-for-cost and design-for-manufacture (DFM/DFA) thinking from the earliest concept stage, working closely with sourcing and operations to hit target cost and margin goals without compromising quality and clinical performance.
    Engage directly with suppliers and contract manufacturers on component selection, make-vs-buy decisions, and design trade-offs that affect cost, lead time and supply resilience.
    Partner with Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Commercial teams to translate market and clinical requirements into robust, manufacturable, cost-competitive designs.
    Manage external partners, test houses and imaging partners on interface and integration requirements.
    Own technical documentation, design history files and verification/validation planning in support of regulatory submissions.
    Report R&D program status, risks and resource needs to senior management and the board as required.

What You Bring

    MSc in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
    Solid experience in electrical or electromechanical engineering for complex, regulated products — motion/motor control, power electronics, embedded systems or similar.
    Proven project/program management experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams through the full development lifecycle, on time and on budget.
    A demonstrated cost-conscious engineering mindset — comfortable making design trade-offs against target cost, and working closely with commercial/sourcing/procurement or suppliers to get there.
    Strong communication skills in English and Swedish
    Genuine interest in both technology and people with strong communication and collaboration skills
    Solution-oriented and results-focused mindset building trust and lasting relationships with colleagues, partners and suppliers

Nice to Have

    Direct sourcing, procurement or supplier-development experience, particularly for mechatronic or electromechanical subassemblies.
    Experience with capital medical equipment (imaging, OR equipment, patient positioning systems)
    Familiarity with PLM/PDM tools, formal DFMEA/risk management processes, and Lean/Six Sigma cost-reduction methods.

What We Offer

The opportunity to hands-on lead technical development of market-leading surgical table platforms used in hospitals worldwide, within a company that combines the agility of a mid-size organization with the reach of global partnerships. You'll have direct visibility to commercial and board-level strategy and a real mandate to shape how we build products — technically and commercially.

At Stille, you will join a skilled and dedicated team where you can influence the future of our surgical table portfolio, contribute to meaningful innovation and grow professionally.

Location: Torshälla/Eskilstuna, Sweden

Reports to: VP Surgical Tables

Apply

Ready to make an impact, contribute to surgical perfection and be part of our exciting future within the Stille Group? If you match the profile above, we would be delighted to receive your application!

Please submit your CV and cover letter through our website: https://stillegroup.careers.haileyhr.app/ by October 4th at the latest.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, and the position may therefore be filled before the closing date. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please note that we kindly decline contact from recruitment agencies and providers of recruitment services.

title: Junior RF Engineer
description:
Sweden Quantum develops and manufactures cryogenic microwave hardware for quantum computing. Our products are used by quantum computing companies and Nobel Prize winning research groups. We design world-class hardware that enables world-class performance.

We're now looking for a Junior RF Engineer to help develop the next generation of our HERD filter technology. If you have a background in RF or microwave engineering and want to work at the forefront of quantum technology, we'd like to hear from you.

About the Role

You'll work with our HERD filter technology, designing, simulating, and validating cryogenic microwave filters and related components for quantum computing systems, taking into account the environment they operate in. This is a hands-on engineering position where curiosity, precision, and ownership is important.

What you'll work on

- Developing the next generation of HERD filters, from simulation to measured product

- Understanding customer and system requirements and turning them into filter designs

- Measuring and characterising filters and comparing the results with simulation

- Supporting production testing together with our production team and manufacturing partners

- Helping customers integrate our filters into their setups

Academic background

Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related field with a focus on high-frequency electronics, or close to completing one.

Technical experience

- RF and microwave fundamentals, such as S-parameters, transmission lines and impedance matching

- Microwave circuit or passive-device design and EM simulation (CST/HFSS or equivalent)

- Hands-on VNA measurements and S-parameter analysis

Nice to have

- CAD design for manufacturability

- Experience with cryogenics or superconducting circuits

- Python for test and automation

Tools used

COMSOL, Fusion 360, VNA, QUCS, Bluefors DR, Python

About You

You're hands-on, self-driven, and eager to learn. You take ownership and care about quality. You're curious about quantum technologies and want your work to directly advance real, deployable quantum systems.

At Sweden Quantum, you'll work with experienced engineers, have direct influence on design decisions, and access modern lab facilities and equipment. We provide mentorship, autonomy, and the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on how quantum hardware is built.

What We Offer

You'll join a small, skilled team working with leading international partners across the quantum industry. Our customers range from major quantum computing companies to academic labs at the forefront of science. You'll gain deep experience in both RF and cryogenic engineering and see your designs deployed in world-class quantum systems.

title: Technical Project Manager BOP / Technical Project Manager QA QC
description:
Technical Project Manager – Mechanical & Piping (BOP) and Civils

The Technical Project Manager (TPM) is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the mechanical and piping discipline and civils within Balance of Plant (BoP) systems, including water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, fire protection systems, compressed air plants, and other supporting facilities. The role may also cover additional construction areas as required by the project.

The Technical Project Manager ensures that all discipline-related activities comply with design specifications, applicable technical standards, and overall project requirements, while meeting cost, schedule, quality, and safety objectives. The role works in close collaboration with Plant Unit Project Managers, Construction Managers, and other cross-functional Technical Project Managers to ensure seamless integration of mechanical and piping activities across the project.

Key responsibilities include managing contractors and suppliers, monitoring progress and costs, mitigating technical risks, and ensuring that quality and documentation requirements are fulfilled. The Technical Project Manager also supports procurement activities with technical expertise, evaluates change requests, and drives continuous improvement through the application of lessons learned.

Key Responsibilities

Technical & Project Execution

    Manage all activities related to the mechanical and piping discipline, ensuring compliance with design specifications, technical standards, and project requirements.
    Ensure discipline-related work aligns with design-to-cost principles and agreed project schedules.
    Integrate mechanical and piping scope into the overall plant unit in close coordination with Plant Unit Project Managers and Construction Managers.
    Provide regular updates on discipline progress and escalate issues when required.
    Review and approve all discipline deliverables to ensure quality, completeness, and compliance.
    Quality Reviews

Contractor & Supplier Management

    Oversee contractors and suppliers (engineering partners, OEMs, construction partners, and consultants), ensuring work is delivered on time and meets quality standards.
    Assess resource needs and adjust team activities to meet project objectives and timelines.

Risk, Quality & Documentation

    Identify technical risks and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to mitigate and resolve issues.
    Ensure all technical work is properly documented and that reporting is accurate and timely.
    Provide guidance on discipline-specific methodologies, standards, and best practices.

Cost, Schedule & Change Management

    Track discipline progress and report status to the Construction Area Project Manager.
    Monitor expenses, manage costs, and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality or safety.
    Report financial performance and cost control updates to relevant project stakeholders.
    Review and evaluate change requests, assessing impacts on scope, schedule, and budget.
    Implement approved changes effectively while maintaining project integrity and alignment.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

    Facilitate collaboration with other Technical Project Managers to ensure cross-discipline integration.
    Identify opportunities for process improvements within the discipline.
    Capture and apply lessons learned from previous projects to improve future performance.

or

Technical Project Manager QA QC

The Technical Project Manager – QA/QC is responsible for managing, monitoring and coordinating project quality assurance and quality control activities, ensuring compliance with approved designs, technical specifications, quality requirements, project schedules and applicable standards throughout project execution.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Quality Control

    Manage and monitor compliance with project QA/QC requirements.
    Verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, quality procedures and applicable standards.
    Identify and report quality deviations, defects and non-conformities.
    Support inspections, testing and commissioning activities.
    Monitor the quality of materials, equipment, workmanship and installation activities.

Contractor & Stakeholder Management

    Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors and suppliers on QA/QC matters.
    Monitor contractor performance and compliance with project quality requirements.
    Follow up on outstanding quality activities, non-conformities and corrective actions.
    Participate in quality and project coordination meetings.

Quality & Compliance

    Monitor implementation of project quality plans, procedures and Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs).
    Review inspection and test results against project requirements.
    Support the resolution of technical and quality-related issues.
    Ensure quality documentation and records are properly maintained.



Progress & Risk Management

    Monitor quality performance in relation to project progress and schedules.
    Identify quality risks, delays and potential impacts on project delivery.
    Support mitigation and corrective actions.
    Escalate critical quality and compliance issues where appropriate.

Reporting & Documentation

    Prepare QA/QC and quality progress reports.
    Maintain inspection, testing, non-conformance and corrective action records.
    Provide quality status updates to project management and clients.
    Support the preparation and verification of project handover and quality documentation.

Qualifications

    Degree or technical qualification in Engineering, Quality Management, Construction Management, Project Management or equivalent.
    Minimum 5 years of relevant industrial, construction or infrastructure project experience.
    Experience in QA/QC, quality inspection, construction supervision or project execution.
    Experience working within EPC, industrial or infrastructure projects.
    Strong communication, coordination and reporting skills.
    Good knowledge of quality management systems, technical documentation, inspection procedures and site HSE requirements.

title: Synthesis Engineer
description:
Company description:

Ericsson AB

Job description:   Join our Team  

About this opportunity:

    

Join Ericsson’s cutting-edge journey to shape the future of 5G networks! As an ASIC Synthesis Engineer, you’ll work on pioneering digital ASIC designs vital to Ericsson’s mobile network infrastructure. Our team, responsible for the final critical stage of chip design before fabrication, thrives on Lean and Agile principles, promoting close collaboration, daily progress-sharing, and continuous improvement. If you’re passionate about advanced technology and ready to make a meaningful impact in telecom, this role is crafted just for you.



At Ericsson, we support your growth, offering opportunities to advance your skills while contributing to game-changing 5G/6G technologies. Here, you’ll find a supportive, innovative environment focused on quality, teamwork, and career development. Join us and help shape the future of telecom!

  





What you will do:

  


    Engage in all backend development tasks, including synthesis, constraints development, equivalence checking, and place-and-route to deliver high-quality digital ASICs.
    Run Static Timing Analysis, timing sign-off, and optimize timing/area/power using Synopsys tools (Design Compiler, PrimeTime, ICC2/FC/Innovus).
    Work extensively with EDA tools and develop scripts (Python, TCL, Linux Shell) to automate processes and enhance project efficiency.
    Drive innovations in low-power design using UPF and provide input on physical implementation and floor planning.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a supportive, knowledge-sharing environment, ensuring seamless integration and execution.  

  



  

The skills you bring:

  


    Expertise in backend development, specialising in synthesis, STA, and power optimisation in semiconductors. 5+ years of development experience through multiple successful ASIC tape-outs.
    Hands-on Knowledge and proficiency in EDA tools (Synopsys Design Compiler, Fusion Compiler, PrimeTime, ICC2/Innovus, Formality/LEC ) for timing, area, power closure on advanced technology nodes.
    Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Perl, TCL, and Linux Shell) to automate and streamline workflows.
    Comfortable in UNIX/Linux environments, essential for efficient and effective backend operations.
    Commitment to Quality is a keen eye for detail and experience maintaining high standards in complex, high-impact projects.
    Extensive experience in low-power design techniques, including UPF application and VHDL/System Verilog for RTL2GDS flows.
    Looking for a skilled professional experienced in crafting timing constraints to effectively manage and control the timing aspects of complex design projects.
    A collaborative mindset with a strong focus on innovative solutions and continuous improvement in fast-paced environments.
    Solid communication skills, able to explain technical topics clearly and collaborate effectively across teams.  







Bonus Skills:




    It is nice to have experience in leading technical teams and working with Multi/Many-Core CPU architectures.  
    Proficient in Clear Case, Git, and Synopsys tools like Spyglass, Design Compiler, and Formality for optimised backend development.  
    Familiarity with mobile communication standards, telecom, floor planning, and physical implementation to enhance ASIC design effectiveness.

title: Senior Data Engineer to Sergel Group
description:
Sergel Group is one of the leading providers of credit management services in the Nordic region. We offer services within credit scoring, debt collection, debt purchasing, as well as messaging and payment solutions. Sergel is part of Marginalen Group and has just over 150 employees across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.

About the role

Sergel is on an exciting journey to strengthen its inhouse capabilities, bringing more competence and ownership closer to the business. This means several ongoing development areas and new projects where data plays a central role, and the people who work with it are central to Sergel's ability to compete and grow across the Nordic market.

In this role you will drive the development of scalable, efficient and compliant data solutions, with a strong focus on operational excellence and exploring new opportunities for innovation. You will have significant autonomy and a broad mandate to influence technical direction, make key decisions and ensure they are executed with real impact. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership and move things forward. Over time, you are motivated by the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and a more leading position within the area.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Defining and enforcing data modeling standards, best practices and governance policies.

    

Designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and optimizing ETL processes.

    

Building and maintaining applications and integrations for data ingestion, transformation and delivery.

    

Driving the shift from external-dependent delivery toward strong in-house capability.

    

Setting the technical direction and owning key architectural decisions.

    

Ensuring that BI is an integral part of the data platform, enabling trusted reporting, analytics and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Qualifications and experience

You are someone who combines deep technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership. You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders and thrive in environments where you can shape and improve things rather than just maintain them.

You enjoy working closely with others, sharing knowledge and helping the team grow through collaboration, curiosity and mutual respect. You are humble enough to listen and confident enough to challenge when needed.

You also bring:

    

Solid experience as a data engineer and experience with designing, modeling and implementing data-intensive systems.

    

Strong proficiency in SQL and C# .NET/Python.

    

Experience with ETL tools, data pipeline frameworks and orchestration tools.

    

Understanding of CI/CD principles.

    

Knowledge of data governance, GDPR compliance and security best practices.

    

The ability to drive technical decisions and set standards.

    

Fluency in English.

    

Valid work permit.

You don't need to be senior in every area listed above, if you bring strong fundamentals and the right mindset, there is room to develop and grow into the full scope of the role.

Meriting experience:

    

Experience from financial services, credit or similar data-intensive industries.

    

Knowledge in one of the nordic languages.

    

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

About the company

In Sergel we care about the people we meet. We are a company with a culture based on trust and learning, where we work towards strengthening individuals through competence, compassion and a high level of engagement. Together we work with clear ownership and shared responsibility towards our stakeholders, which creates long-term and loyal business relations. We always try to find new ways of working and challenging the market. We want our employees to develop with the company and have fun with their colleagues on the way.

Additional information

    

Start: By agreement

    

Location: Central Stockholm

    

Extent: Full-time

    

Salary: By agreement

We apply ongoing selection in this recruitment process, which means the position may be filled before the final application date. We therefore recommend submitting your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions regarding Asta Agency’s recruitment process, please do not hesitate to contact us at alice@astaagency.se.

About Asta Agency

Asta Agency is a recruitment and staffing company helping businesses across Sweden find the right professionals, with a primary focus on Stockholm, Gothenburg, and Malmö.

We recruit and provide consultants within sales, marketing, HR, customer service, finance, administration, IT, and tech – both specialists and generalists. With a strong focus on quality, long-term partnerships, and smart solutions, we support both companies and candidates in taking the next step.

Learn more about how we work with recruitment, staffing, and temp-to-perm solutions at astaagency.se.

title: Lead Risk Model Specialist
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will take a key role in strengthening transaction monitoring models within a large Nordic banking environment. The focus is on financial crime prevention, where robust model development, validation, and governance are critical to how suspicious activity is identified and managed.

In this role, you combine analytical depth with practical judgment. You will help set the direction for model design, validation, and governance within the Transaction Monitoring Unit, while working closely with analytics specialists and stakeholders across the organisation. The role suits you if you enjoy turning complex quantitative work into clear, well-documented, and well-governed models that stand up to scrutiny.

It is an exciting opportunity to influence how model governance evolves in an important AML context with both strategic and hands-on impact.

Job Description

    You will own the development and validation of transaction monitoring models, with a strong focus on model documentation, review, and governance.
    You will drive governance activities within the Transaction Monitoring Unit, including validation assessments and implementation of second line feedback.
    You will set and execute the direction for model development and experimental design, balancing analytical rigor with practical constraints.
    You will document model design and outcomes, and work closely with the analytics team to ensure assumptions, limitations, and weaknesses are clearly analysed and described.
    You will provide hands-on support in prototyping tests and analytical methodologies.
    You will mentor and collaborate with the analytics team to design, test, and implement model SOPs, including data lineage and governance, tuning and calibration, and monitoring of model operations and outcomes.
    You will represent the organisation professionally in collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.

Requirements

    Extensive experience in model risk management, model governance, and validation.
    Strong background in data science, statistics, and quantitative methods.
    Experience in academic or technical writing, particularly related to model documentation.
    Advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or equivalent.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
    You work in a structured and professional way, take initiative, and are comfortable working proactively under your own direction.
    You communicate clearly and confidently, and can set direction and create results in a dynamic environment.

Nice to have

    Experience in Financial Crime or AML, for example transaction monitoring or work with technology suppliers in the area.
    Experience with transaction monitoring platforms such as Quantexa.
    Experience as a model validator or quantitative risk analyst.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Intertalents Consulting AB is looking for a Software Engineer Consultant to work on assignment with one of our clients. You will be employed by Intertalents Consulting AB and work closely with the client’s development, product, and business teams.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer Consultant, you will develop, test, and maintain software applications and services based on the client’s technical and business requirements.

You will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and developing technical solutions to testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. The specific assignment and technical environment may change depending on the client’s needs, but your role will remain focused on software and systems development.

Your Key Responsibilities

    Develop, test, and maintain software applications and services
    Build backend systems, APIs, integrations, and data-driven solutions
    Translate business and product requirements into technical solutions
    Troubleshoot technical issues and improve existing systems
    Participate in code reviews, automated testing, and deployment processes
    Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders
    Deliver software solutions according to agreed requirements and timelines

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer with an analytical and solution-oriented mindset. You are comfortable working independently, taking responsibility for your assignments, and collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a consulting environment.

We Believe You Have

title: Lead Engineer, PV&T
description:
We are currently looking for two Lead Engineers, Pressure Vessels and Tanks, for our office in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Valmet in Gothenburg delivers evaporation plant solutions to the pulp and paper industry and provides services for recovery boilers as well as environmentally friendly power and heating boilers designed for technically demanding fuels.

As a Lead Engineer, Pressure Vessels and Tanks, you will primarily work with customer delivery projects. You will take a leading role within the mechanical discipline, working closely with other disciplines such as piping, structural engineering, and process design engineering within the project team.

Area of responsibility and tasks:

    Lead and coordinate the discipline team in delivery projects.
    Keep track and be responsible for the discipline budget.
    Preparing technical documentation for the procurement and manufacturing of equipment by our suppliers, project schedules, specifications, and drawings for pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and storage tanks.
    Follow up on the manufacturing process through drawing reviews and daily communication with suppliers.
    Support installation work at the customer’s or workshop site, both remotely and on site when needed.
    Support pre‑projects and sales work when needed.
    Contribute to the development of work processes and continuous improvements.
    Occasionally travel to suppliers or customer sites during project execution.

The scope of the projects varies, which means that the size of your discipline team will also vary. Therefore, we place equal importance on your ability to collaborate and lead, as well as your capability to perform engineering and design work independently. Working in global teams is part of our delivery projects execution setup.

We operate within a global multi technology organization. Daily work involves contact with colleagues and partners in many parts of the world and also with other technologies. The role therefore includes some planned short-term business travel.

Who you are

To be successful in this role, you should hold a Masters or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or possess an equivalent qualification.

You are accustomed to taking initiative and enjoy working collaboratively in a global environment. Furthermore, you have extensive experience (more than 10 years) in a similar industry, involving engineering design, drafting, and supplier interactions.

You have the below skills and knowledge:

    AutoCAD 2D
    Microsoft Office applications
    Solid works (desirable)
    E3D (desirable)
    Knowledge in norms and standards such as EN, ASME and GB
    Working in global project teams
    Expericence from Evaparation plants or other pulp and paper process areas
    Site experience from Pulp & Paper industry (desirable)

Excellent English language skills, both written and spoken, are required.

We offer

We offer a collaborative and dynamic work environment with meaningful projects that support industrial efficiency. The global presence fosters cultural exchange, professional growth, and a shared commitment to excellence. You will also benefit from competitive compensation, bonus plan, health insurance, flexible work arrangements, continuous learning opportunities and many other wellness and leisure benefits.

Want to know more?

Please submit your application through the link provided no later than September 24, 2026. We review applications continuously.

For additional information, please contact Kristoffer Mohlin, Manager Pv&T at kristoffer.mohlin@valmet.com or Marcus Lindén, Team Leader Pv&T at marcus.linden@valmet.com. Please note that we will not accept applications via e-mail.

We perform background checks and alcohol and drug testing for all employees, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.

We look forward to hearing from you!

When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.

Join the team and lead the way with us!

www.valmet.com/careers

title: Product Owner
description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!

Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:

    We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
    We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
    We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.

The role

As a Product Owner, your role sits at the intersection of product and clients: you run advertiser onboarding end-to-end, own the delivery and optimization roadmap for the Perform product, and are the person who knows exactly where every campaign, integration, and attribution flow stands. The demand side of this product sits in India - you will work daily with advertisers, agencies and the India commercial team while building with the engineering team in Stockholm.

What you'll do

    Own advertiser onboarding end-to-end - integration requirements, event and attribution setup, campaign configuration, launch readiness and the first weeks of live delivery.
    Run the delivery and optimization roadmap for the Perform stack: campaign delivery intelligence, conversion optimization, pacing and pricing.
    Be the product counterpart for enterprise advertisers and agencies - requirements, timelines, escalations and performance reviews.
    Own attribution and measurement quality - the integrity of the numbers advertisers see is the product.
    Work daily with engineering and data science in Stockholm to turn client needs into shippable, reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off fixes.
    Track and report the commercial funnel: pipeline status, live campaign performance, and revenue against targets.

What you bring in

    Hands-on experience with the adVantage Perform stack or an equivalent performance advertising product - campaign delivery, conversion optimization, and attribution.
    Deep familiarity with the India advertising market - advertisers, agencies, measurement conventions and commercial dynamics.
    Strong execution instincts: you keep many threads moving at once, close loops, and communicate status without being asked.
    Comfort with data - you can query, chart, and sanity-check campaign performance yourself.
    Clear written communication with both technical teams and client stakeholders.
    Willingness to work across Stockholm and India time zones with regular client-facing hours.

Great to have

    Experience inside an ad network, DSP or retail-media platform.
    Exposure to real-time ML systems - bandits, ranking or conversion models - and what it takes to run them for paying customers.
    Experience growing into product ownership from an engineering, data, or analyst background.

What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:                                                                                                                                                        

    A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
    Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
    A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
    Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.

Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code:  https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/

Sounds like a great opportunity?

We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.

We only accept applications in English.

title: QA/Tester
description:
Natural Cycles° is a leading women’s health company that developed the world’s first birth control app, used by millions globally. We are a fast growing startup, and we promote an international working environment filled with smart and ambitious colleagues based in Stockholm, Geneva, New York, and remotely. Our mission is to pioneer women’s health through research and passion, empowering every woman with the knowledge she needs to take charge of her health.

We are looking for a committed QA/Tester with a passion for quality and a keen eye for detail. You thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced, and agile environment, where you enjoy working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to build high-quality user experiences. You are curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by identifying risks, validating solutions, and providing quality insights that help teams make informed decisions.

As part of the Product Team, you will work on app features designed to support and guide users throughout their reproductive journey through AI tools, feedback loops, and personalised in-app content. You will also contribute to the Natural Cycles customer support chatbot, helping ensure a reliable, compliant, and high-quality experience across both user-facing and AI-powered features.

Please note that we are hiring for this role in Sweden.

What you will be doing

    

Design, execute, and document testing activities for new and updated features, prioritising test coverage based on customer impact, product risk, and regulatory requirements.

    

Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering throughout the development process, contributing to planning, requirements discussions, and feature validation to build quality into solutions from the start.

    

Identify quality risks, investigate defects, perform exploratory and regression testing, and provide timely, actionable feedback to support product and release decisions.

    

Maintain clear test evidence and medical device documentation, contributing to requirements reviews, risk assessments, and validation activities as needed.

    

Contribute to improvements in testing approaches, automation, tooling, and datasets to increase product quality, release confidence, and team effectiveness.

What skills and experience we think you have

    

2+ years of experience in QA and software testing within a cross-functional product development environment.

    

Experience designing, executing, and documenting test cases using functional, exploratory, regression, and risk-based testing techniques.

    

Hands-on experience testing one or more of the following: web applications, mobile applications, APIs, or applications integrating LLMs.

    

Proficiency with testing and debugging tools to investigate issues, analyse failures, and support defect resolution.

    

Experience contributing to automated testing and a solid understanding of modern software development practices, including version control, CI/CD, and release processes.

    

Strong communication, problem-solving, and organisational skills, with the ability to provide clear feedback, maintain documentation, and manage multiple priorities.

    

While not required, it is a plus if you have experience working in a regulated environment or with documentation-heavy quality processes.

What we offer

    

Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location

    

Professional development - you will collaborate with industry leading developers, promoting continuous growth and skill enhancement

    

Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work

    

Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value

    

Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development

Location

We are remote-friendly, but we find great value in being able to connect with our teams in person. Most of the Product team you will work with is located in Stockholm, and the team occasionally meets in the office for collaboration and face-to-face time.

Sounds interesting?

If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

How to apply

To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.

At Natural Cycles we value diversity and inclusion because we know that teams with people from different backgrounds and experiences are stronger. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Note: We are not looking for consultants or help from recruitment agencies

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
What makes Cognizant a unique place to work? The combination of rapid growth and an international and innovative environment! This is creating a lot of opportunities for people like YOU — people with an entrepreneurial spirit who want to make a difference in this world.

At Cognizant, together with your colleagues from all around the world, you will collaborate on creating solutions for the world's leading companies and help them become more flexible, more innovative and successful. And this is your chance to be part of the success story: we are looking for an Informatica Architect to join our team in Sweden.

About the team

Cognizant Sweden boasts a robust team of professionals spread across various cities. Our local team includes experts in AI, data analytics, cloud services, and software development, ensuring we provide top-notch, localized support to our clients. The team is led by a seasoned professional, who brings extensive experience in cloud, AI and analytics and building high performing teams. Learn how Cognizant helps clients lead with digital at www.cognizant.com or follow us Cognizant.

Cognizant collaborates with all major hyperscale’s and relevant software vendors in the data and AI space. This includes partnerships with industry leaders such as AWS, Microsoft, Google, Snowflake, and Databricks. Our comprehensive approach ensures that we leverage the best tools and technologies to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient solutions. Additionally, we are supported locally by our dedicated Centres of Excellence, which operate both nearshore and offshore. These centres provide specialized expertise and resources, ensuring that we can meet the unique needs of our clients and drive innovation in AI and data cost effectively.

About the role

    3+ years of hands-on experience working with requirements and design to deliver complex data solutions.
    Preferably background from Banking, with understanding of bank data and data delivery in a regulated environment
    Very good communication and presentation skills (both written and oral) with proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams and drive discussions with architects and engineers to jointly design solutions and solve problems
    Has experience from working with data related topics such as data sourcing, transformation rules, data quality rules, data privacy considerations and data delivery agreements.
    Can take on and independently drive their own subset of activities
    Experience from testing and quality assuring data deliveries
    Quick to grasp new concepts, fast learning curve will be needed
    Structured work approach

Technical Proficiencies

    Languages: SQL
    Tools & Platforms: AbInitio metadata hub or other Data Catalogue tool
    Experience from data warehousing or analytics tools is meriting

What you can expect

    Become part of a ‘flag ship’ success story - We go through enormous growth!
    Organization driven by technology – We have a tremendous technology backbone
    Environment where you can make your own ideas reality
    Drive your own career
    Market conforms benefits

The Cognizant community

We are a high caliber team who appreciate and support one another. Our people uphold an energetic, collaborative and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

    Cognizant is a global community with more than 300,000+ associates around the world.
    We don’t just dream of a better way – we make it happen.
    We take care of our people, clients, company, communities and climate by doing what’s right.
    We foster an innovative environment where you can build the career path that’s right for you.

title: Site Integrated Planning Sr Specialist
description:
Join us to deliver a smoke- free future as Site Integrated Planning Sr Specialist!  

At Swedish Match we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and have been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.  

In the Nordic region, we are 1,600 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.  

Role summary:  

In this role you will be responsible for executing and maintaining integrated production scheduling across all manufacturing processes, from primary to secondary, ensuring the delivery of the Best Executional Production Plan. Your work will balance cash, cost, and service targets while navigating constraints like capacity, material availability, and operational realities.  

Main responsibilities:  

    Prepare rolling, integrated, and synchronized production schedules aligned with planning cycles and volume forecasts.  
    Ensure and control the execution of production schedules, taking corrective actions when deviations occur.  
    Adhere to stock policies while optimizing human and machine resources within operational constraints.  
    Manage exceptional situations such as machine breakdowns, material delays, and urgent production requests with sound judgment and stakeholder alignment.  
    Lead and participate in cross-functional supply chain projects focused on productivity and efficiency.  
    Identify and propose improvements to planning processes to enhance performance and reliability.  
    Build strong partnerships with key stakeholders including supply planning, capacity planning, manufacturing, material requirements planning, transportation, and warehouse teams.  

Who you are:  

    University degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management or Engineering field.  

    Minimum 2 years’ experience in Supply Chain (demand planning, logistics, production planning) in a global/multinational FMCG companies.  
    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including functions, pivot tables, and data analysis tools.  

    Demonstrated proficiency in supply chain / production planning (site integrated planning).  

    Experience in structured way of working, ideally with defined planning process cycle.  

    Track record as team player connecting well with peers and other key stakeholders outside of team.  

    Proficiency in in written & spoken English. Swedish is meritorious.  

    Working knowledge of Supply Chain Planning Solutions and Forecasting Solutions (E2OPEN suite is a strong plus).  

Please note that relocation support is not available for this job.  

What we offer:  

Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can

• Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.  

• Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.  

• Enjoy flexibility of a hybrid way of working between the office and your home.

• Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.  

• Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.

title: Senior Embedded Developer
description:
At Manta Marine Technologies, we are committed to advancing greener shipping through intelligent technologies — supporting operational efficiency, reduced carbon emissions and fuel consumption as well as simplifying emissions reporting. We provide a wide range of innovative and intelligent maritime technologies, including Vessel Optimisation solutions, Marine Electrification systems and comprehensive Lifecycle Services for all our products. Manta Marine is headquartered in Oslo, Norway, with offices in Sweden, Poland, and China.

Do you want to help us to promote a healthy planet for future generations? We are currently seeking a Senior Embedded Developer to enhance our Vessel Optimization team.

Main responsibilities

As part of Manta Marine Technologies Vessel Optimization business line, you’ll work with FuelOpt, our onboard fuel optimisation system installed on more than 500 vessels worldwide. FuelOpt helps ship owners improve operational performance, reduce fuel consumption, and lower emissions through real-time propulsion optimisation.

As a Senior Embedded Developer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining embedded applications running on our proprietary hardware platform. You will work closely with other developers, application engineers, and adjacent product teams to deliver reliable and high-quality solutions for vessel operating worldwide.

The role combines software development, troubleshooting, product improvement, and technical collaboration across the organization.



Key responsibilities

    Develop and maintain embedded software in C running on real-time embedded kernel, on in-house hardware
    Contribute to the ongoing development and improvement of our proprietary hardware platform
    Diagnose and resolve issues across hardware, operating system, and application layers
    Participate in concept development and implementation of new product features
    Develop and maintain internal tools that support system configuration and deployment
    Integrate software with operator-facing HMI solutions
    Review, test, and improve code quality and development practices
    Collaborate with adjacent engineering teams on shared solutions
    Provide technical support and expertise to internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams when needed



Background and skills

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Developer with at least six years of professional experience in embedded software development. You hold a BSc or MSc in Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent. You have strong programming skills in C and experience working in complex embedded environments.

Furthermore, you have:

    Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) or real-time embedded kernels
    Experience developing software on custom or non-standard hardware platforms
    Strong debugging skills across hardware and software boundaries (e.g., JTAG)
    Experience with industrial and embedded communication protocols such as TCP/IP, Modbus, serial communication, or similar
    The ability to work independently and take technical ownership of solutions
    Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

Meriting experience

Experience in one or several of the following areas is considered an advantage:

    Experience with HMI integration (e.g., Beijer Electronics or similar industrial HMI platforms)
    Familiarity with C# for scripting/configuration tooling
    Familiarity with Python for internal tooling/automation
    Practical understanding of digital/analog I/O and basic electronics
    Experience in maritime and/or industrial automation
    Exposure to cybersecurity practices, especially in embedded/connected systems
    Experience with IoT devices and cloud platforms (Azure or AWS)

Personal qualities

We believe you are a curious and technically driven person who enjoys solving complex problems. You are analytical, structured, and take ownership of your work. As a senior developer, you are comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues across different teams. You enjoy sharing knowledge, contribute to a high-quality engineering culture, and take a pragmatic approach to solving technical challenges.

What we offer

We offer an opportunity to be part of a market leading innovative global company in the forefront of green technology for ships. An open and inspiring environment where your energy will make a difference. We provide great potential for personal and professional development.  

Manta Marine is committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is not only the right thing to do, but also the smart thing to do. Let’s make the world a greener place!

Application

When submitting your application, please include "Application – Senior Embedded Developer" in the subject line of your email. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Electrcal Project Manager
description:
Why RLB?

At RLB, we live by four simple ideas: Truth, Trust, Together, Tomorrow. Four values that live at the heart of RLB. A place where People Make Progress.

We value your skills, talents and unique perspectives – we think they are priceless.  

Bring them to RLB and you'll be empowered to shape our future and your career in new and meaningful ways.

We'll give you opportunities to work on some of the most ambitious and exciting projects currently being designed and developed in the built environment sector.

You'll continue to learn and advance as everyone who works for us is provided with a tailored training programme. Our mentoring and reverse mentoring schemes will enable you to share your expertise while gaining fresh insights.

What makes RLB unique is our inclusive culture. As an independent, employee-owned business, teamwork and collaboration lies at the heart of everything we do. Hybrid and flexible working arrangements are just some of the ways we invest in employee wellbeing. 

Join us and you will thrive personally as well as professionally. 

Role Overview

We are currently recruiting a Senior Project Electrical Manager with consultancy Data Centre experience to join a client focused team in Sweden to help develop and drive our Data Centre capability.

This is an exciting opportunity to join and strengthen our team. RLB's Data Centre team works on wide range of projects including new build, fit out, refurbishment and capacity upgrades. This role presents an excellent opportunity to take responsibility for providing all services relating to project management on Data Centre project.

Role Responsibilities

    To lead and oversee the successful delivery of Data Centre projects with a view to securing repeat business.
    Lead on Electrical project management projects
    Proactive management of multi-disciplinary internal and external teams.
    Implementation and management of a change control process.
    Coordination of the testing and commissioning process prior to handover.
    To assist in the management of the Data Centre Project management team including line management duties where applicable.
    To support development of targeted marketing material, bid documents, capability statements and attend networking events relating to Data Centres.

Candidate Profile

Qualifications

    Construction related degree or a similar construction related qualification  

Experience

    Construction Industry Experience required. 
    Data Centre experience
    Ability to manage a project from inception to post completion with senior management support, obtaining positive written client feedback.  
    Understandinging technical aspects of project delivery from inception to post-completion and is able to identify and promote solutions.

Behaviours

    Recognised as a positive collaborator who shares knowledge freely and offers support. Recognised as a team player with a strong willingness to learn.  
    Demonstrates a positive and proactive approach to the role, and will be committed to delivering customer service excellence, with good commercial results.

RLB Employee Benefits

Our culture is built around enabling you to fulfil your potential, so you can look forward to benefits that include:

Hybrid Working - Working patterns to support your work-life balance. As well as competitive maternity and paternity packages.

Well-Rewarded - A competitive salary and generous holiday entitlement. As well as the opportunity to purchase up to five extra days.

Personal Development - A continuous learning and development programme, including in-house mentoring schemes.

Additional Benefits - We offer a wide range of benefits including professional membership subscriptions.

Exceptional Exposure - You'll have the opportunity to work on diverse projects across different sectors and regions.

Social Responsibility - We hold team and social events as well as charity fundraising and volunteering activities.



Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Promise

We believe in building a diverse and inclusive environment where each person can be themselves, feel valued for their contribution and be challenged and supported to reach their full potential. We have a responsibility to support the communities in which we live and work, and that our workforce should reflect these communities and our clients. Our talent strategy should enable us to overcome bias in the construction industry by recruiting, retaining, developing, and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce. Find out more here: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion - RLB | Europe

If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during any stage of the application or interview process, please contact our recruitment team at: recruitment@uk.rlb.com

title: President Machining, Sandvik Group
description:
We are looking for an exceptional business leader to join us as President of business area Machining at Sandvik. As President, you lead one of the world's most respected industrial businesses and play a pivotal role in delivering Sandvik's Advancing to 2030 strategy through growth, innovation, digitalization and operational excellence.

‍Business area Machining is the global leading manufacturer of tools and tooling systems for advanced industrial metal cutting, as well as metal powder. In 2025, sales were approximately SEK 44 billion with about 18,700 employees. Our portfolio includes market leading brands like Sandvik Coromant, Seco, Walter and Dormer Pramet. Together, these businesses combine industry-leading technology, deep application expertise and strong customer partnerships to help manufacturers improve productivity, efficiency and sustainability.

About the job

With overall responsibility for the business, you set the direction and lead the execution of business area Machining's strategy and performance agenda. Machining consists of a portfolio of leading divisions and businesses, each with its own market position, strategy and profit and loss responsibility. title: PhD Student in Cyber-Physical Systems
description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.

Do you want to build the next generation of electronics?



Europe is racing to regain ground in semiconductor technology, and chiplets – several small dies packaged together into one working system – are one of the keys. The hard part is not the dies, but the interconnects between them.



We are looking for a PhD student to create those interconnects in a fully additive way: laser micromachining, selective metallisation and new photosensitive materials, without high-temperature sintering and with minimal material waste. The work is experimental, carried out in our own laboratories together with European industry.



The EISLAB division at Luleå University of Technology conducts research in electronic systems design, sensor systems, cyber-physical systems, the Internet of Things and machine learning, and works on electronics from material and process to a finished, verified component.



We work in close cooperation with companies such as Bosch, Ericsson, Volvo, Infineon, Boliden, LKAB and SKF, with leading international universities, and in large European research programmes such as Arrowhead Tools, coordinated by LTU.



This position belongs to our growing work on additive manufacturing for chiplet packaging, where EISLAB is responsible for the packaging part within a European consortium.



Subject description



Cyber-Physical Systems focuses on integrated software and application architectures with implementations of massively distributed embedded systems that interact with each other and their environment to enable secure, goal-driven, autonomous and evolvable solutions.



Project description



E2PACKMAN is a €93.7 million European flagship project building the next generation of semiconductor packaging – the part of chip making that decides how small, fast and powerful electronics can get. You will join a team that works with 60 partners from 13 countries, including Europe's leading semiconductor manufacturers and research institutes, to develop new materials, equipment and processes and prove them out on real industrial use cases. EISLAB is responsible for the packaging technology developed here.



Duties



Your main tasks are to:

    develop additive techniques for patterning micro- and nanoscale metal interconnects in multilayer devices
    identify and optimise polymers and photosensitive materials for additive manufacturing
    establish femtosecond or picosecond laser micro-drilling and selective metallisation for high-aspect-ratio vertical interconnects
    characterise the results (SEM, AFM, XCT, optical microscopy) for geometric accuracy, durability and interfacial strength
    validate scalability and sustainability: less material waste, better energy efficiency, no high-temperature sintering, compatibility with industrial HDI packaging



You will publish in scientific journals, present at international conferences and collaborate with academic and industrial partners across Europe as well as with researchers and PhD students at LTU. The work is largely independent, but you will receive continuous supervision.



As a PhD student you work towards a doctoral degree in accordance with the Swedish Higher Education Ordinance: most of your time is devoted to research, and you also take doctoral courses. Both are planned and documented in your individual study plan.



Qualifications



We are looking for an analytical and motivated colleague who can drive experimental research both independently and in a team.



Requirements:

    A master's degree (or equivalent) in electrical engineering, electronics, materials science, nanotechnology, microelectronics, engineering physics or a related field
    Experience of experimental laboratory work in micro- or nanofabrication, materials processing or electronics manufacturing
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to work in interdisciplinary teams
    Excellent spoken and written English



Desirable:

    Micro- and nanofabrication techniques such as laser direct writing, electroless plating, photolithography or additive manufacturing
    Characterisation tools such as XCT, SEM or AFM
    CAD and simulation tools such as CLEWIN, ANSYS or COMSOL
    Electronics packaging, HDI substrates or chiplet architectures
    Cleanroom experience



Do you not meet every desirable point? Apply anyway. We do not expect anyone to tick every box – much of this expertise is built during the doctoral studies themselves.



For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en



Further information



Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: by arrangement.

title: Mechanical Engineering Manager
description:
Mechanical Engineering Manager

Do you want to help create the future of urban heating and cooling? 

Driven by a deep sense of purpose and sky-high ambitions, we think differently at Qvantum. Entrepreneuring together, we take pride in being disruptable and constantly learn, re-learn and un-learn. Here, the best idea always wins – brilliance eats hierarchy for breakfast. Our vision is to build a more resilient society by electrifying indoor heating and cooling, across Europe and beyond. Join us! 

Qvantum is a fast-growing Swedish energy-tech company accelerating the transformation of urban heating and cooling through intelligent heat-pump-powered energy systems. As a hardware-enabled software business, our technology powers modular heat pumps that we design and produce at speed and scale, built to integrate with local energy grids and electricity markets. Our heat pumps are flexready®, meaning they automatically can use electricity when it is cheapest and store the heat for later, enabling electrification, optimising the overall energy system, and saving money. All without compromising indoor comfort. The heat pumps are easy to install, monitor and maintain, and come in four categories: air/water, ground source, exhaust air and complete system solutions. Together, they target every home, whether a single-family house, an apartment building or an entire district.

Qvantum is headquartered in Åstorp, Sweden, with sales offices and distributors across Europe. The company has two European manufacturing facilities.

Backed by long-term blue-chip investors, including Thomas von Koch (ex EQT) and the IMAS Foundation (sister foundation to the INGKA Foundation, owning most of the IKEA stores globally), Qvantum has a vision to create a more resilient society by disrupting how we heat and cool buildings.

About the role

We are looking for a Mechanical Engineering Manager to lead and coordinate our team of Mechanical Design Engineers within heat pump product development. This is a hands-on leadership role combining engineering, coordination, technical leadership, and team development while remaining close to the products, technology, and daily engineering work. The team consists of experienced engineers, meaning your role is less focused on enabling successful delivery, providing technical guidance, removing obstacles, and ensuring alignment across projects and engineering disciplines.  

You will work closely with System Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Refrigeration, Electronics, Software, Project Management, Quality, Manufacturing, and external suppliers to ensure successful development and industrialization of next-generation heat pump solutions.

Key responsibilities

    Lead and coordinate the Mechanical Design Engineering team across ongoing development projects and assignments.
    Drive the end-to-end product development process from concept and design through validation, industrialization, and commercial launch.
    Provide technical guidance and support in mechanical design reviews, engineering decisions, and problem-solving activities.
    Collaborate closely with System Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, and external suppliers.
    Ensure designs meet requirements for performance, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and quality.
    Support continuous improvement of engineering methods, tools, standards, and ways of working.
    Act as mentor and technical coach to team members.
    Support competence development, recruitment, and onboarding activities when needed.

Desired qualifications & experience

    B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
    10+ years of experience in mechanical product development in heat pump, HVAC, refrigeration, or similar products
    Minimum 3 years of experience in a managerial, team leader, or technical leadership role.
    Proven experience in mechanical design engineering for industrialized and mass-produced products.
    Experience leading development projects from concept phase through industrialization and product launch.
    Knowledge of CAD and PLM systems.
    Pragmatic and hands-on leadership with strong technical credibility.
    Solution-oriented communicator with the ability to drive progress in a fast-paced environment.
    Experienced collaborator with the ability to align cross-functional teams towards common goals.
    Fluent in English, written and spoken.
