title: Postdoc position in Process Metallurgy
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural Resources Engineering (SBN) at Luleå University of Technology conducts research and education within sustainable societal development, including infrastructure, environmental engineering, natural resources, and energy systems. More information can be found https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/organisation/department-of-civil-environmental-and-natural-resources-engineering.

Within SBN, the Division of Minerals and Metallurgical Engineering focuses on the sustainable extraction, processing, and recycling of minerals and metals.

Take the opportunity to work in a dynamic, international research environment in close collaboration with industry and leading universities worldwide.

Subject description

Process Metallurgy is concerned with the sustainable extraction of metals from primary and secondary raw materials using both pyrometallurgical and hydrometallurgical processes. More information can be found https://www.ltu.se/en/research/research-subjects/process-metallurgy.

Project description

You will join a research team working at the forefront of the green transition, with a particular focus on transforming mining and metallurgical residues and by-products into high-value products. In this project you will combine advanced modeling with experimental work to understand and optimize the thermochemical conversion of gypsum into lime.

As part of a collaborative initiative with leading industrial partners, you will contribute to the development and optimization of innovative routes for gypsum valorization, with particular emphasis on its thermochemical conversion into high-quality lime.

Duties

As a postdoctoral researcher, you are expected to independently conduct both experimental and theoretical work related to gypsum valorization, including evaluation and reporting of results.

The work includes laboratory-scale experiments (e.g., thermochemical conversion of gypsum) as well as thermodynamic and kinetic modeling. Materials characterization using techniques such as XRD, SEM, and LOM will be an integral part of the research. The role also involves collaboration with industrial partners, participation in joint investigations, and contributions to scientific publications and research proposals.

The position is based at Luleå University of Technology in Luleå, with opportunities to engage in experimental work and trials in collaboration with industrial/international partners.

Qualifications

In order to be eligible for employment as post doctor you must have a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in Metallurgy, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field. A doctoral degree awarded no more than three years before the application deadline provides a useful qualification. Candidates who have been awarded a doctoral degree at an earlier date may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example, different types of statutory leave of absence.

Strong knowledge of pyrometallurgy, particularly gypsum valorization and high-temperature processes, is required. Experience with experimental work related to gas–solid reactions or high-temperature processing is highly desirable. Hands-on experience with analytical and characterization techniques such as X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Thermogravimetric Analysis (TGA), and related methods are considered an asset. Familiarity with thermodynamic and kinetic modeling tools is also beneficial.

As the project involves close collaboration with academic and industrial partners, strong teamwork and communication skills are essential. Applicants must have good proficiency in written and spoken English.

Further information

Full-time fixed term employment for two years with placement in Luleå. Starting: December 2026.

title: Planning & Scheduling Lead
description:
At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

This role requires a strong on-site presence in Boden, as the work is closely connected to the day-to-day execution of the project. The role is best suited for someone who can maintain a consistent presence on site throughout the assignment, whether you already live in the region, have ties to Northern Sweden, or are prepared to make Boden your base during the project.

Type of employment: Direct temporary employment with Stegra for 12 to 24 months OR consultancy through one of our consultancy-partners.

Placement: Boden

What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Planning & Scheduling Lead for our Central Planning team. A lead to us is an experienced person similar to a senior role. In this role you will report to our Planning leadership and sit within our Project Delivery function. The team is responsible for driving planning excellence, schedule assurance, and project-wide coordination across one of the largest industrial projects in Europe.

As Planning & Scheduling Lead, you will act as the Owner's representative for planning and scheduling within your assigned project area. You will work closely with Construction, Engineering, Commissioning, EPCM partners, and contractors to ensure schedules are realistic, integrated, and aligned with project objectives. This is a site-based role with a strong focus on schedule assurance, progress validation, forecasting, and delivery performance.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

    Act as the planning and scheduling focal point for an assigned project area
    Review and challenge EPCM and contractor schedules to ensure quality, logic integrity, and compliance with project standards
    Develop, maintain, and manage the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for the assigned area
    Integrate schedules from contractors, EPCM partners, and stakeholders into a single aligned plan
    Monitor progress, perform schedule analysis, and provide forecasting based on actual site conditions
    Identify schedule risks, constraints, and opportunities, and support mitigation and recovery planning
    Participate in site reviews, coordination meetings, and planning workshops with project stakeholders
    Produce weekly and monthly schedule reports to support project controls and management decision-making

What you’ll bring

You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

    Experience in project planning and scheduling within large-scale industrial or infrastructure projects
    Strong experience managing Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) in complex project environments
    Good understanding of planning methodologies, schedule assurance, and forecasting techniques
    Experience reviewing and challenging contractor and EPCM schedules
    Understanding of schedule risk analysis and QRA processes
    Strong analytical and reporting skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
    Experience coordinating across multiple stakeholders, disciplines, and delivery areas
    Ability to work effectively in a site-based, fast-paced construction environment

Benefits at Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Boden Site

Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

title: Fulfilment Leader Europe
description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.

And we need people like you to make it happen.

We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

Job Summary



As a Fulfilment Leader Europe you’ll manage day-to-day operations within the regional fulfilment team which is part of the Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) at Business Unit Processing Solutions & Equipment (PSE).

The role oversees a team of Shipping Coordinators and Sales Order Owners, ensuring efficient execution of capital equipment orders—from order creation to final delivery.

You will drive visibility, compliance and continuous improvement for the Order to Fulfil process in close interaction with markets.

This is a temporary position in Lund, Sweden, for 6 to 12 months.

What you will do



    Lead, develop, and engage a regional team of approximately 20 Shipping Coordinators and Sales Order Owners based in Sweden, Denmark, and Italy.
    Ensure smooth execution and real-time tracking of customer orders with timely exception handling.
    Oversee outbound logistics from internal and external factories, ensuring timely, compliant and cost-effective shipping.
    Ensure adherence to safety, compliance, and export regulations.
    Act as the first point of equipment escalations, ensure structured, timely, and effective resolution of customer delivery issues that impact delivery performance.
    Ensure the Fulfilment team acts as a control tower by continuously monitoring order execution, providing visibility to stakeholders, maintaining plan accuracy and communicating exceptions promptly.
    Monitor and report on KPIs such as order fulfillment rate, on-time delivery and visibility metrics.
    Drive continuous improvement and support digital transformation in fulfilment processes.
    Foster strong collaboration across ISC functions, project centers, and Market Operations.

We believe you have



    At least 5 years of experience as a people leader.
    Master’s degree or equivalent in Engineering or Business Administration.
    Proven experience in supply chain, logistics and/or order fulfilment leadership roles.
    Experience managing 3PL providers and understanding of trade flow across global operations, export regulations, compliance, and safety standards.
    Strong leadership skills with a track record of team development and engagement.
    Proficiency in ERP systems and digital tools for order tracking and reporting.
    Strong understanding of process design and operational optimization.
    Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to make decisions and prioritize under pressure.
    Strong communication and collaboration skills across functions and regions with proficiency in English.



Furthermore, we believe that you have the ability to ensure a high order fulfillment rate and excellent customer experience through strong end-to-end visibility, timely and complete delivery of capital equipment and rapid issue resolution supported by effective stakeholder collaboration.

We Offer You

    A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
    A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
    An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
    Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements



Apply Now

If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/.

A background check may be performed on the final candidate as part of the recruitment process.

This job posting expires on 2026-09-25

To know more about the position contact Märta Morand at +46 46 362652

Questions about your application contact Hanna Edström at +46 46 365880

For trade union information contact Unionen/Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320 or Sveriges Ingenjörer/Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533

We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

title: Workforce Management Expert
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.

You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.

You will:

    Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
    Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
    Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
    Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
    Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
    Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
    Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
    Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
    Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
    Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
    Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
    Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.

We are looking for people with:

    Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
    Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
    Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
    Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
    Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
    Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
    Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
    Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

An example of our benefits:

    25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
    H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

This is a permanent position based in Stockholm, please send your CV in English as soon as possible.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Business Consultant within digital services for patients
description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.

The position

At Cambio, we are expanding our digital patient services portfolio and are looking for a Business Consultant who wants to help healthcare organizations successfully implement and develop solutions such as e-Referral, Patient Remote Monitoring and other digital services which will contribute to a better patient experience. In this role, you will play an important part in enabling healthcare providers to adopt and maximize the value of digital services that improve communication, accessibility and patient engagement throughout the care journey.

As a Business Consultant, you will work closely with healthcare organizations, supporting them throughout implementation, adoption and continuous development of Cambio's solutions. You will lead customer implementations and coordinate customer rollouts, facilitate workshops and training sessions, configure solutions, and help customers optimize their workflows and processes.

Much of your work will be conducted directly with customers, both remotely and on-site, but you will also collaborate extensively with internal stakeholders such as Product Management, Customer Success Managers and delivery teams.

We offer:

    

The opportunity to improve everyday healthcare through innovative digital services, while playing an important role in how we develop and deliver value to healthcare providers across Sweden.

    

A varied role where you combine customer interaction, workshops, implementations, project coordination and service development.

    

The chance to help shape and grow service areas that are still evolving, where your ideas and contributions can make a real difference.

    

Colleagues who are not only highly skilled, but also genuinely committed to creating a positive and enjoyable workplace together.

About you

You are a proactive and solution-oriented person who enjoys working closely with customers and turning their needs into practical solutions. You are comfortable leading workshops, training sessions and discussions, and you build strong relationships with both customers and colleagues.

Several of the service areas you will work with are growing and evolving, which means there is not always a clear roadmap or predefined answer. To thrive in this role, you enjoy exploring new challenges, engaging the right stakeholders and finding solutions that create value for both customers and Cambio. At Cambio, we value Trust, Care and Together, and it is important to us that you share these values.

Requirements 

    

Experience working with COSMIC or a similar EHR system, either as a key user, application specialist, consultant, trainer, or through implementation and configuration projects.

    

Experience leading implementation, rollout, or digital transformation projects within healthcare, healthcare IT, or digital health services.

    

Strong communication skills and experience leading workshops, training sessions, presentations, or change initiatives.

    

Proficiency in Swedish is a prerequisite for this position, as our client in the public sector specifically requires Swedish language skills.

It's a bonus if you

    

Understanding of national guidelines, regulations, or standards within the healthcare sector.

Place of employment: Linköping or Stockholm

Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)

Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period

Additional Information: Willingness and ability to travel as required for the role

During the process we will conduct tests from our partner Alva Labs

The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.

We look forward to receiving your application!

CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW

Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life. Read more about us here!

A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible -explore our employee benefits

Learn more about our recruitment process here

Are you interested in Cambio but you don’t feel that this position is the perfect match? Check out our other open positions at our career site.

title: Junior Operator
description:
Junior Operator – Help Build the Future of Battery Technology

Are you hands-on, interested in technology, and curious about how the batteries of the future are made? Perhaps you have recently graduated from a technical upper secondary school programme, worked for a year or two as an operator, or gained experience in a warehouse or production environment – or simply want to take your first step into the manufacturing industry? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

Vanadis Energy is developing the future of energy storage through innovative battery technology. Our proprietary Vanadium Solid-State Battery (VSSB) represents a new generation of safe, high-performance energy storage systems, with a manufacturing model designed for rapid global scale-up. In parallel, we are also developing innovative zinc-ion batteries for a range of applications.

We are now growing and looking for several Junior Operators to join our facility in Rosersberg.

This is an opportunity to enter an exciting and fast-growing industry and be part of building and developing our production from an early stage. You do not need to know everything from day one. For us, the right attitude, a strong safety mindset, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn are just as important as previous experience.

About the role

As a Junior Operator, you will be an important part of our production team and work hands-on with the manufacturing of our batteries. Your work will include operating production equipment, handling materials, assembly, quality control and testing.

As we are in a growth phase, you will join an environment where things develop quickly. You will work closely with other operators, technicians and engineers, giving you the opportunity to learn more about both production processes and battery technology.

We are looking for someone who enjoys practical work, takes responsibility and is not afraid to ask questions when something is unclear. Safety and quality always come first.

What will you do?

Your responsibilities will include:

    Operating and monitoring production equipment.
    Manufacturing, assembling and testing battery cells and battery components.
    Handling materials, components, tools and finished products according to established procedures.
    Performing quality checks and documenting production results.
    Preparing, setting up and cleaning production equipment.
    Carrying out basic troubleshooting and identifying when something is not working as expected.
    Contributing to a safe, clean and well-organised workplace in accordance with 5S principles.
    Reporting deviations, safety observations and improvement suggestions.
    Working closely with colleagues and supporting different parts of the production process when needed.

Who are we looking for?

Your background can look different. Perhaps you:

    Have recently graduated from a technical, industrial, electrical or other practical upper secondary school programme.
    Have worked for a year or two as a Production Operator, Machine Operator or Assembler.
    Have experience from warehouse, logistics or another hands-on environment and would like to develop your career within manufacturing.
    Have a strong interest in technology and are looking for an opportunity to learn manufacturing from the ground up.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who:

    Is hands-on and genuinely interested in technology and manufacturing.
    Is responsible, detail-oriented and quality-conscious.
    Has a strong safety mindset and understands the importance of following instructions and procedures.
    Enjoys working as part of a team and contributing to a positive working environment.
    Is curious, eager to learn and comfortable asking questions when unsure.
    Is flexible and comfortable working in a growing and changing environment.
    Can communicate effectively in English. Swedish is considered an advantage.

Previous experience from manufacturing, process industry or another production environment is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Why Vanadis Energy?

At Vanadis Energy, you will get more than a traditional operator role. You will have the opportunity to enter the battery industry at an exciting stage and develop your skills as our production and company continue to grow.

You will become part of an international team where operators, technicians and engineers work together to solve problems, improve processes and bring new battery technology from development into production.

We are not only building batteries – we are building the team and the factory that will produce them. Would you like to be part of it from the beginning?

What we offer

In addition to an exciting and international working environment, we offer secure employment conditions and benefits, including:

    Collective Bargaining Agreement – providing clear and secure employment terms and conditions.
    Occupational pension and insurance in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 4,000 per year.
    25 days of annual vacation.
    Opportunities to learn, develop and grow as our production and organisation expand.

As part of the recruitment process, the final candidate may, depending on the responsibilities and safety requirements of the position, be required to undergo a drug test and provide an extract from the Swedish Police criminal records register.

Please submit your application through our website. We do not accept applications via email.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Position at LeoVegas Group

ABOUT THE ROLE

Join our team as a Senior Software Engineer and play a crucial role in driving our organisation's growth through the development of outstanding products.

LeoVegas Group is building something special – a world-class team dedicated to creating the best Sportsbook platform in the market through cutting-edge technology and innovative gaming experiences.

This is a dynamic team that will be working on creating new cool features and integrating them into LeoVegas platforms.

We’re seeking a dynamic individual who can deliver state-of-the-art code while prioritising performance and scalability.

We are recruiting for our Tiger Sportsbook Team!

In Sportsbook we work in a high-volume, real-time environment, integrating data feeds with our modern trading system and transactional betting platform (UI/Backend). Your contributions will cover maintaining/expanding our current Betting/Trading services as well as building new services and capabilities for our users.

As a key member of our team, you’ll collaborate effectively while also demonstrating initiative and a passion for sharing innovative ideas.

YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

● Taking ownership, problem-solving and collaborating with other teams.

● Designing and implementing from idea to production.

● Building for scale, availability, performance and security across the stack.

● Working with product managers, architects, QA engineers and other developers in a highly collaborative agile environment.

● Integrating new products and building internal services to support our ecosystem.

● Conducting code reviews and mentoring team members.

● Ensuring services are production-ready, observable, and maintainable through monitoring, alerting, and on-call participation.

OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

ESSENTIAL SKILLS:

● 6+ Years of software development experience with Java, Spring Boot and Event-Driven Architectures.

● Experience designing microservices, K8s, containerization (Docker) and Kafka messaging systems.

● Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases and caching.

● Implementing resilience patterns (e.g., retries, circuit breakers, graceful degradation).

● Designing and maintaining monitoring dashboards (e.g., metrics, logs, traces) and alerts to proactively detect issues.

● Hands-on experience developing highly scalable RESTful end-to-end microservices.

NICE TO HAVES:

● Familiarity with Reactive Programming (e.g. RxJava) and Vert.x would be a big plus.

● Experience in platforms like AWS and Google Cloud Platform.

● Online gaming and gambling experience

    

WHO WE ARE

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

BENEFITS

    Hybrid work policy
    4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
    30 annual vacation days
    Occupational Pension
    5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
    Parental Leave Top-Up
    Possibility to enroll in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner
    1,500 SEK equipment allowance
    Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts
    We offer a relocation package with accommodation and flights.

JOIN US!

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!



Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!

title: German-speaking Customer Success Specialist
description:
Are you a person who wants to be challenged and develop within a company that is on an exciting growth journey? Do you want to be part of a great team and be the first point of contact for our customers in Germany and the UK? If yes – keep reading!

Verendus was founded in 2010 in Jönköping, Sweden, with the aim of digitally revolutionizing the leisure vehicle industry. With our eponymous web-based software for recreational vehicle dealers, we already have over 700 customers in Sweden, Norway, Germany, the UK and Denmark. Now we are looking for you, who wants to help us to keep giving great service and support to our customers in Germany and the UK!

About the role

You will be the first point of contact for our customers when they have questions about Verendus and you will quickly become an indispensable part of our success story, which is based on exceptionally good service.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Accepting all incoming customer support requests in Germany and the UK via phone, email or instant messages

    

Answering the support requests directly or coordinate with your colleagues to ensure high-quality customer experience.

    

Identify areas for improvement and actively contribute to taking our customer support to the next level

About you

You have a service-oriented attitude and experience from customer service, preferably in an IT-oriented environment or in the automotive or recreational vehicle industry. You know how to deal with corporate customers and how to work with merchandise management systems. You work in a solution-oriented manner and have the "grit" to assert yourself even in difficult situations

You bring ambition, curiosity and commitment - three personal qualities that we particularly value at Verendus!

Apart from this, you have:

    

Fluent knowledge of German

    

Good English knowledge

    

Good technical skills

Interested?

We look forward to reading your application! If you have any questions about the position, the team or the company, please contact our Head of Customer Success, Arvid Jägenstedt (arvid.jagenstedt@verendus.se). Feel free to read more about Verendus on our website or here on our career site.

About Verendus

Verendus is the market-leading business system in Europe for leisure vehicle dealers. Our customers are dealers within motorhomes, caravans, boats, ATVs, jet skis and motorcycles, located in Sweden, Norway, Germany, UK and Denmark. We are a team with 40 colleagues working in either product management, development, sales or customer service.

Verendus mission is to help our customers reach their full potential and improve everyday life in the industry, through smart and user-friendly system solutions. We want to make it easier for our customers to provide great service so that more consumers can enjoy leisure adventures on the roads, at sea or in the mountains.

Verendus is a part of Movement Software

Verendus is a part of Movement Software - a Nordic software group with about ten entrepreneurial companies in the automotive, e-commerce / logistics and travel industries. We are driven by technological innovation, with the requirement that customer value is always at the center. Since 2023, Movement Software has been part of Axcel, a Nordic private equity firm with a strong focus on the technology sector.

Movement Software means increased opportunities for development both for us as a company and for you as an employee. It also means greater security as investments are made in the long term and with perseverance.

If you are like us, we believe that you want to feel meaningful at work and be part of making Verendus an even better and more fun place to work. To have fun is important – there is more to life than just work.

title: Lager och logistikmedarbetare Getinge Disinfection Växjö
description:
Company description:

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that contribute to quality enhancement and cost efficiency within healthcare and life sciences. We employ more than 10,000 people, and have operations in more than 40 countries. Saving lives is the greatest job in the world. Everything we do, from architectural planning to the equipment, therapies and solutions aim to secure the safest and most reliable care. As a leading medtech company, we focus every talent and resource towards helping our customers save as many lives as possible.

Job description:

På Getinge är vi engagerade i att hjälpa våra kunder att rädda liv och säkerställa utmärkt vård. Vi erbjuder innovativa lösningar för operationsrum, intensivvårdsenheter, steriliseringsavdelningar och för Life Science och institutioner. Ett jobb hos Getinge kommer att ge dig karriärmöjligheter som både inspirerar och utmanar.











Om rollen  







På Getinge i Växjö arbetar vi med lösningar för sterilisering och desinfektion till sjukvården. Nu söker vi en Lagerarbetare till vårt lager- och Supply Chain-team. I rollen samarbetar du nära produktion, produktionsledning samt inköp/Supply Chain för att säkerställa att rätt material finns tillgängligt i rätt tid.







Som lagerarbetare tar du emot och hanterar inkommande material samt lagrar det på rätt platser för att säkerställa materialtillgång till produktionen. Du bidrar till hög lagernoggrannhet och god lagerstyrning genom att genomföra cykelräkningar och lagerinventeringar enligt våra rutiner, och är med och utvecklar vårt lager- och materialhanteringsarbete.











Dina arbetsuppgifter








    Ta emot och hantera inkommande material samt lagra det på rätt platser
    Säkerställa att material finns tillgängligt för produktionen
    Upprätthålla hög lagernoggrannhet och god lagerstyrning
    Genomföra cykelräkningar och lagerinventeringar enligt företagets rutiner
    Bidra till att utveckla och förbättra lager- och materialhanteringsarbetet
    Samarbeta med produktion, produktionsledning och inköp/Supply Chain
    Rapportera avvikelser och säkerhetsrisker till närmaste chef







Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placering i vårt lager i Växjö.















Vad du har med dig







I den här rollen ser vi att du har följande med dig:








    Goda kunskaper i svenska, i tal och skrift
    Engelska är meriterande men inget krav
    Truckkort samt minst AM körkort
    Vana vid att arbeta i affärssystem (ERP), ritningsprogram och andra IT-system
    Samarbetsinriktad och kommunikativ, och trygg i att lyfta frågor till andra funktioner vid behov
    Säkerhets-, kvalitets- och kundfokuserad
    Strukturerad och noggrann, samtidigt öppen för nya idéer och arbetssätt







Förutom dina kunskaper och erfarenheter värderar vi din personlighet högt. Som person tror vi att du är strukturerad och noggrann men samtidigt öppen för olika tankar, idéer och input från dina kollegor. Vi ser att du är engagerad och driven i ditt arbete och att du trivs med att samarbeta med andra delar av verksamheten, inklusive produktionen. Du är van att kommunicera med olika intressenter i en organisation och att samarbeta både i och utanför teamet.







På Getinge omfamnar vi en lärandekultur där vi tar ansvar för vår utveckling och sätter stort värde på kvalitet och samarbete. Framför allt bryr vi oss om varandra för att vi som team och bolag ska kunna fortsatta utveckla världsledande produkter. Vi är Team Players, Forward Thinkers och Game Changers!







Vi erbjuder



Vi erbjuder ett konkurrenskraftigt kompensations- och förmånspaket, inklusive friskvårdsbidrag, familjeförmåner och gemensamma aktiviteter och föreningsliv. Allt detta för att säkerställa att vi stöder ditt välbefinnande och dina mål.







Vi har en öppen dialog mellan ledare och medarbetare, samt mellan teamen. Vi fokuserar på att utveckla människor och tillsammans skapar vi en plan för lärande och kompetensutveckling när du börjar din karriär hos oss.







Ansökan



Ansökningar kommer att granskas löpande och vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 30 september 2026. Vi ber dig att skicka in din ansökan i vårt rekryteringssystem genom att klicka på knappen "ansök nu". På grund av GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via e-post.







Om du har några frågor angående rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Amir Curan på email: amir.curan@getinge.com.







Vi ser fram emot din ansökan. Vi hoppas att du vill följa med oss på vår resa mot att bli världens mest eftertraktade medicintekniska företag.

title: System Support Technician, Lund
description:
Are you the person colleagues are glad to reach when a system stops cooperating? We're looking for a System Support Technician with Salesforce experience to join our System Support team at our HQ in Lund - a role where technical problem-solving and genuine service go hand in hand.

Who is your future team?

You'll join our System Support team, ten technicians who maintain and provide first line support for a range of Axis systems, including Salesforce, our own in-house CRM, our intranet, Microsoft 365 and access management. We're part of the internal IT Helpdesk, which supports Axis employees globally.

We're a down-to-earth team where no one is too senior to pick up a ticket. We help each other out without worrying too much about who does what, and we'd rather solve the problem together than protect our own patch.

What you'll do here as System Support Technician

Your day is built around helping colleagues around the world get past whatever is standing in their way. You'll be the first line of support for our own CRM and for Salesforce, and you'll keep access management running smoothly across a range of our systems. Beyond solving what lands in your queue, you'll help make sure fewer problems land there in the first place.

    Support colleagues globally through our case management system, ServiceNow
    Handle access management across a range of Axis systems
    Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the systems we support
    Create and maintain knowledge articles and workflows
    Collaboration with other teams on systems that connect to ours

Who are we looking for?

title: Student ambassador for Orange Cyberdefense!
description:

You must live up to the following requirements:

    

You want to contribute to our vision and help junior cybersecurity talent grow.

    

You are currently a student at a Swedish university or higher vocational school in Gothenburg, or near Gothenburg.

You are capable and willing to take initiatives and drive projects forward.

You are fluent in both Swedish and English

Cybersecurity or a related topic is your main field of study.

title: Product Portfolio Manager  Chemical Gloves
description:
Ejendals is a Swedish family-owned company that has specialized in high-quality products that protect hands and feet since 1949. Through the product brands TEGERA® and JALAS®, Ejendals combines expertise, innovation and real-world understanding to help prevent injuries and create safer workplaces across Europe and beyond.



Ejendals is looking for

Product Portfolio Manager – Chemical Gloves

Do you want to combine chemical expertise with commercial portfolio development and help sales teams succeed in a segment with significant growth potential?



Why you should choose Ejendals

As Product Portfolio Manager for Chemical Gloves, you will take a key role in shaping and strengthening Ejendals portfolio of chemical gloves. You will manage and develop the existing assortment, identify portfolio gaps and new opportunities, and turn technical product properties into clear customer value, sales arguments and commercial strategies.

You will join an international and innovation-driven company with strong product brands and a clear purpose: protecting hands and feet in demanding working environments. The role offers broad cross-functional collaboration, commercial influence and the opportunity to help increase sales in a strategically important product segment.

We offer you

• Overall responsibility for a strategically important chemical protection glove portfolio

• An influential role at the intersection of product management, chemistry, market insight and sales

• The opportunity to develop portfolio strategy, lifecycle management and long-term roadmaps

• Close collaboration with sales, marketing, product development, sourcing, supply chain, finance and external partners

• The opportunity to strengthen sales confidence through clear product positioning, tools and training

• An international working environment with strong brands and substantial growth ambitions

About the role

As Product Portfolio Manager, you are responsible for maintaining and developing a competitive, profitable and well-balanced product offering within chemical gloves. You will manage the products throughout their entire lifecycle and ensure that the portfolio meets customer expectations and supports sustainable growth.

    Lead portfolio development, lifecycle management and phase-in/phase-out planning
    Analyze markets, competitors, customer behavior and portfolio performance to identify gaps and opportunities
    Initiate and lead projects that optimize the portfolio and meet customer needs
    Translate chemical properties, application information and technical product data into compelling value propositions and sales arguments
    Develop go-to-market plans, launch materials and commercial support for sales and marketing teams
    •      Work proactively with market insights and long-term roadmaps
    •      Monitor sales, profitability, pricing and margins, and define actions with sales when performance deviates from plan
    •      Ensure high-quality product information for internal and external users
    •      Support product training for sales teams, customers and partners, together with the Chemical Expert
    •      Develop cross-functional processes, working methods and idea-management practices

You will work closely with the Conceptual Product Manager to align commercial objectives with product concepts and innovation priorities. You will also collaborate with a Chemical Expert, who provides specialist support in technically complex customer cases and contributes expertise concerning chemical protection and regulatory matters. You will own the commercial and strategic messaging, while technical training is shared with the Chemical Expert.

The role belongs to Product Line Gloves and reports to Team Manager Product Management, Carina Hemstrand. The product management team consists of three Product Managers based in Leksand. The position has no direct reports.

What we are looking for

We are looking for a commercially driven product management professional with a solid understanding of chemistry and the ability to connect technical knowledge, portfolio strategy, market insight and sales execution. Knowledge of organic chemistry is particularly valuable for understanding how glove materials react when exposed to different substances.

We believe you have:

    A university degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, organic chemistry or another relevant scientific or technical field, alternatively equivalent relevant experience
    Experience in product management and/or product development, preferably as a Product Portfolio Manager, Product Manager, Category Manager or in a comparable commercially focused role
    Knowledge of product positioning, product and application information, pricing and lifecycle management
    Experience of market and competitor analysis and of working closely with sales organizations
    Strong analytical capability and financial understanding, including profitability, business acumen, budgets and cost control
    Experience of leading cross-functional product or portfolio projects
    Good proficiency in Microsoft 365
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken; Swedish is highly advantageous
    A valid permit to work in Sweden

Experience from PPE, industrial manufacturing, protective gloves or the chemical industry is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are strategic, analytical and commercially oriented. You create stability and trust among key stakeholders, communicate complex information clearly and turn insight into concrete priorities and action. You are comfortable balancing long-term portfolio development with immediate commercial needs and can work effectively in a relatively small organization with broad individual responsibility.

Employment

This is a full-time position based in Leksand. While the role offers flexibility through a hybrid working model, regular on-site presence in Leksand is essential to successfully collaborate with colleagues and support the business.

Travel is expected approximately once a month, mainly within Europe, with occasional travel to Asia.

How we recruit

In this recruitment, Ejendals collaborates with Hansson & Partners. Please submit your application through the Hansson & Partners website no later than 4 October.

Contact info

Martin Ogemar, martin@hnpar.com, +46 72 237 21 30

Anna Hansson, anna@hnpar.com, +46 70 695 64 63

title: HR Manager
description:
We’re looking for an HR Manager for a global company in Falkenberg. Start is ASAP, 10 months limited contract to begin with, good possibility of extension after that. This role is 100% onsite in Falkenberg and occasional travel to Mölnlycke.



We are looking for a Human Resource Manager (HRM) to join our client's People Experience team in Falkenberg and Mölnlycke.

The HRM will be part of a smaller HR team in Falkenberg consisting of the responsible HR manager, the HRM, one HR specialist and two payroll administrators. The focus will primarily be on Falkenberg, but the HRM will also support our Mölnlycke site (estimated 5-10% of the time).

We need this person to be available on-site in Falkenberg but also have the possibility to travel to Mölnlycke when needed.

﻿

MAIN TASKS

    

The HRM supports the delivery of the HR strategy for one or more Hygiene Business Units in a Country/Cluster. The role works in partnership with the business to provide specialist coaching, support and influence that enable Hygiene Business Units in a Country/Cluster to effectively deliver their people plans. The role provides HR services that deliver best practice and commercially focused HR solutions that support the business area in conjunction with other specialist HR functions.

    

Works as HRM partner to assigned local business teams to ensure professional HR support in all operational HR issues related to performance management, organizational and people development and change management.

    

Supports the development and delivery of business unit related topics in the Country/Cluster e.g. development activities, small organization or structure changes, data collection, interpretation, and evaluation of appropriate remuneration issues.

    

Equips key assigned local business teams with appropriate tools and knowledge to effectively manage their people in line with their people plans e.g. performance management, talent management, career management, development of teams etc.

    

Responsible for providing assistance and guidance to line management on a broad and local range of human resource policies programs and practices.

    

Advice on labor law, collective agreement and policy related issues concerning employees to make sure that organization is compliant.

    

Responsible for employee onboarding plan, process, activities and follow up.

    

Prepares job/position descriptions.

    

Initiates recruitment process with Staffing Manager.

﻿

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

We are looking for a competent and experienced HR professional with a broad experience from the HR area, preferably as HRM/HRBP or similar roles. It is preferable that the consultant has experience working in an environment, specifically within a manufacturing setting with a mixed workforce of blue-collar and white-collar employees.

    

Deep knowledge of labor law, preferably within manufacturing environments.

    

Confident and able to stand their ground when needed.

    

Calm, structured, and methodical in approach.

    

Performs well under pressure and remains composed in a fast-paced environment.

    

Reliable and consistent, with a balanced and professional mindset.

    

Demonstrates strong judgment and composure in dynamic environments, remaining focused and methodical under pressure while carefully assessing situations and making well-considered decisions.

﻿

This is a full-time consultant position in Falkenberg through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 10 months limited contract to begin with, good possibility of extension after that. This role is 100% onsite in Falkenberg and occasional travel to Mölnlycke.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

title: Data engineer - Careium
description:
Careium is looking for a Data Engineer to help us shape and build a modern data and delivery platform from the ground up. If you have a strong drive to do things properly and take ownership of your work, then this is the job for you.

About Careium

Careium delivers solutions within personal safety and connected care. We have a global presence but work with a strong local feel, and right now we are in a phase where there is real work to be done - automation, data infrastructure, and smarter ways of building and shipping software are all on the table.

About the Role

As a Data Engineer in the platform team, you will be the driving force behind our data infrastructure. You will work closely with both software developers and the wider organization to ensure that our data is accessible, reliable, and structured for the future.

Day to day you will be working with things like:

    

Implementing and expanding our central data lake and data warehouse, building upon the completed initial design and its main components.

    

Setting up and maintaining robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from various internal and external sources.

    

Continuing the groundwork of our event-driven platform enabling real-time alarm data and user activity.

    

Moving existing data integrations and legacy data streams onto the new modern platform.

    

Getting data documentation, a data catalogue, and data governance frameworks in place.

    

Collaborating with DevOps colleagues in the team to automate data infrastructure deployments and monitoring.

    

Coaching developers and analysts in data engineering best practices and efficient querying.

Who We Are Looking For

You should have solid hands-on experience from a Data Engineering role and a genuine interest in cloud architecture, data modeling, and streaming data. Since you will be part of a platform team, a DevOps mindset regarding automation, containerization, and infrastructure as code is a big plus.

It helps if you have worked with tools like:

    

Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent.

    

AWS, or other cloud providers.

    

Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent.

    

Streaming and event-hub technologies like Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS Kinesis.

    

Data transformation and orchestration tools (dbt, Apache Airflow, or similar) as well as modern data warehousing.

Just as important as the technical side, you communicate well, you are easy to work with, and you bring a calm, structured approach when things get complicated. You follow through on what you commit to, and you are not afraid to flag when something is not working.

Practical Information

Location: Malmö Scope: Full-time Work model: Hybrid, as agreed Employment type: 6-month assignment through A-hub. The recruitment process is managed by A-hub. Questions about the role are answered by the recruiter responsible.

Linux and automation using tools such as Python or Shell scripting

title: Auditor with experience
description:
Do you want to be part of a team that is developing tomorrow's businesses and organizations? At PwC, we strive to be proactive advisors that really make a difference in society. We see that experience and knowledge are invaluable assets, so it's crucial to us that you contribute with your expertise to promote PwC's development. Together, we create a meaningful and rewarding career for you.

As an employee in audit, you work to identify risks, solve complex audit questions, analyze data and draw conclusions about the information presented by our customers. You get to work in inspiring and meaningful assignments where our work affects our customers' business operations, but also contributes to creating trust in society.

The digital development and increased demands for transparency contribute to the fact that the audit of the future will require more multifaceted competence than before, which also provides more opportunities for specialization. At PwC, working as an auditor can look very different and this means that you can create your own career path. You can choose to become a customer manager or immerse yourself in a specialist area such as data analysis, sustainability reporting, internal control or invest in a career as a leader.

Read more about our service areas within auditing

Who are you?

We are looking for you who have:

    At least five years of experience working with auditing and/or Financial Reporting, Internal Controls and Compliance.

    Experience in IFRS reporting, statutory audits and financial statement preparation.
    Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

We attach great importance to your personal qualities and therefore believe that you:

    Is service oriented and motivated by delivering results and meeting our customers' expectations.
    Is adaptable, can read situations and adapt both behavior and communication in building qualitative and diversified relationships.

    Has good analytical skills and is solution-oriented. You enjoy learning new things and are curious about digitization and new technology to be able to solve customers' needs.

    Is structured, efficient and organized.

Recruitment Process

We will review applications continuously, and the position may be filled earlier than the application deadline.

Please attach the following documents to your application:

    CV

title: Become our next Board Director at Scandian!
description:
Scandian is seeking an experienced and strategically minded Board Director to support the Group’s continued international growth and development.

As a full-time executive role, the Board Director will participate in Board meetings, provide strategic guidance and oversight, and support key business decisions while ensuring sound corporate governance across the Group. The position is based in Sweden and carries responsibility for global administration and compliance, while supporting the operations of Scandian’s subsidiaries in Sweden, India, and Africa in accordance with the direction of the Board of Directors.

About Scandian

Scandian is a Swedish infrastructure company that develops and delivers international infrastructure projects. By combining Swedish engineering excellence with global expertise in construction, procurement, project management, and financing, we provide sustainable and innovative solutions for complex projects around the world.

The company originates from Serneke International and was further strengthened in 2025 through the acquisition of Elof Hansson International. Today, Scandian is a leading Swedish EPC partner, delivering projects across Africa, India, and South America. Through long-term infrastructure solutions, we contribute to economic growth, improved living conditions, and sustainable societal development in the markets where we operate.

    Participate in Board meetings and contribute to strategic decision-making.
    Provide guidance on corporate governance, compliance, and risk management.
    Lead and coordinate global administrative and compliance activities from Sweden.
    Ensure alignment with the Group’s long-term strategy, objectives, and Board directives.
    Contribute to the sustainable growth and development of the Group’s international operations.

Qualifications

    Proven experience in senior executive, board-level, or governance roles.
    Strong understanding of corporate governance, compliance, and international business operations.
    Experience working across multiple jurisdictions and cultures.
    Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
    Strategic mindset with the ability to balance operational oversight and long-term business objectives.

What We Offer

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of an international infrastructure group. You will work closely with the Board of Directors and senior leadership while contributing to the growth and success of operations across multiple continents.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege 80-100% für die Region Grabs gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Grabs sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Grabs

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Grabs

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Grabs liegt im Rheintal des Kantons St. Gallen und bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung an. Die Region ist durch die Bahnlinie und das Autobahnnetz gut erreichbar. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Grabs Sie mit einer starken Industrie- und Gewerbebase, günstigen Bodenpreisen und einer hohen Lebensqualität in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Bodensee und Liechtenstein.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege rund um Grabs ist derzeit sehr hoch, da Altersheime und Betreuungseinrichtungen konstant unter Fachkräftemangel leiden. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und können zwischen verschiedenen attraktiven Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum wählen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, passgenauen Stellenvorschlägen und dem Netzwerk zu etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, was Ihnen einen reibungslosen Einstieg garantiert.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Grabs

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Entzugsstation 80-100% für die Region Kaiseraugst gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Kaiseraugst sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Entzugsstation.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Kaiseraugst: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Entzugsstation

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Kaiseraugst

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Kaiseraugst liegt strategisch günstig im Kanton Aargau nahe Basel und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn sowie zu Bahnverbindungen. Die Nähe zu Basel und das Dreiländereck machen die Region für Arbeitnehmende äußerst attraktiv, da Sie von einer stabilen Wirtschaft und vielfältigen Jobmöglichkeiten profitieren. Zugleich bietet Kaiseraugst Ihnen Wohnqualität mit ländlichem Charme und guter Infrastruktur.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Entzugsstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. title: Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval
description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Hombrechtikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege
